plugin_connector_68df33b1a2d081918778431.legacySummary: 创建、审核与编辑设计作品

translation.description:
将您的 Canva 设计工作流纳入 Codex,并通过自然的对话创建、改进和审查设计。

Canva 可以做些什么: 创建设计:将简短、概述或草案复制成演示文稿、文档、海报、通讯、社交帖子、简历等。 创建图像:从提示中创建照片、插图、图标和图形,或者重新创建您已经拥有的图像。 删除背景:将主题从图像中升至透明的背景。 上传文件:将附件和文件从您的聊天中带到 Canva 用于您的设计。 重量化社交媒体:在一个步骤内调整 Facebook、Instagram 和 LinkedIn 的设计。 大量创建:使用品牌模板生成多种图表数据的设计。 编辑设计:更新文本、媒体和格式化或重新配置和重量化设计元素。 获取:收到关于视觉

一旦安装,用简单的语言描述您想要的内容,或者直接使用 @Canva 调用 Canva。

试试像这样的快点:

@Canva,创建这个框架的投影台。 @Canva,创建一个Instagram帖子宣布我们周五出售。 @Canva,在黎明时生成一个灯塔的插图。 @Canva,从这张照片中删除背景。 @Canva,上传此PDF并将其转换为演示文稿。 @Canva,重建这个设计用于社交媒体。 @Canva,使用我的品牌模板创建这个设计板。 @Canva,更新这个设计的标题。 @Canva,在评论线中实施反馈。

想要采取更实用的方法? 立即在 Canva 的强大的编辑器中打开您的设计,以获得最终的触摸。

plugin_asdk_app_694a52cfaa3c819192bea84e.name: Windsor.ai
plugin_asdk_app_694a52cfaa3c819192bea84e.description:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Connects to 350+ sources across advertising, analytics, organic social, CRM, e-commerce, email, and payments, including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, Microsoft Ads (Bing), GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Google Merchant Center, Stripe, and GoHighLevel.

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

translation.description:
Windsor.ai 将您的营销和业务数据源连接到您的人工智能助理,因此您可以用简单的英语提问和采取行动。

它从任何连接的源头中提取性能数据,在支持的广告和营销平台上,它可以直接进行更改,例如暂停或启用竞选活动,设置预算,创建 Google Business Profile 帖子或回复评论,随时在您确认后。

常见工作流程: - 在每个连接的广告帐户中比较支出、点击和转换 - 查找并暂停表现不佳的Meta Ads、Google Ads、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads或Microsoft Ads活动 - 作为您的Instagram、Threads、Facebook或Google Business Profile帐户发布或回复 - 直接将GA4,Google Search Console或YouTube Analytics数据拖入对话中 - 同步HubSpot、Salesforce或Shopify记录 - 更新Klaviyo流或亚马逊销售商中心列表

连接到 350 多个广告、分析、有机社交、CRM、电子商务、电子邮件和付款渠道,包括 Google Ads、Meta(Facebook) Ads、Instagram、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、LinkedIn Company Pages、Microsoft Ads(Bing)、GA4、Google Search Console、YouTube、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Shopify、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Google Merchant Center、Stripe 和 GoHighLevel。

阅读数据只需要连接相关帐户一次。进行更改(暂停活动,发布内容,回复评论)总是要求您先确认,并且仅在Windsor明确支持写入的平台上可用。

Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品,不与其连接的平台相关联或支持。

plugin_asdk_app_697761cab6f48191b5ed3459.name: Granola
plugin_asdk_app_697761cab6f48191b5ed3459.description:
Granola MCP connects your meeting history to ChatGPT so your assistant can pull real context from past conversations while you work.

Use MCP when you're already working on something bigger:

-   Writing PRDs or proposals: Pull customer feedback, stakeholder input, and decisions from relevant meetings directly into your draft
    
-   Building presentations or reports: Combine insights from multiple conversations with your other research and data
    
-   Coding with context: Give your AI the project background, requirements, and technical decisions discussed in planning meetings
    
-   Strategic analysis: Merge meeting insights with documents, data, and other sources for comprehensive analysis
    
How it works:

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

• Use one-tap templates to tackle everything from meeting agendas and accounting tasks, to packing lists and wedding planning.
• Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
• Get to know your routine better with insights into your personalized productivity streaks.

Todoist on Apple iOS
• Todoist is beautifully designed, simple to get started, and intuitive to use.
• Stay organized from your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, while also syncing across desktop and all other devices.
• With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.
• Location-based reminders available on upgrade. Never forget an errand again.
• All the power from iOS: Siri, Today widget, share extension, handoff, and quick actions.

Questions? Feedback? Visit todoist.com/help

plugin_asdk_app_6a392799cb58819185f82dc0.description:
Connect ChatGPT to Miro to summarize existing boards, update them, or build new ones from scratch. Point ChatGPT at a board and it reads what your team has already decided, researched, and drawn, so its answers start from your context. Ask it to build, and its answers land on the board as native Miro objects – slides, tables, docs, diagrams, sticky notes, frames, and workshop widgets – visual, instantly editable, and collaborative by default.

Key Use Cases:
Product strategy review: ChatGPT generates a strategy presentation as Miro slides, alongside your team's priorities, so the team sees the full picture and comes together to review and collaborate on it. From there, ChatGPT reads the feedback and discussion – the call transcript plus Miro comments and stickies – and writes the update for the wider team.
System design review: Get ChatGPT to create an interactive architecture diagram and documentation for a team of engineers to review and discuss ahead of upcoming changes.
Documentation automation: Set up a scheduled task in ChatGPT to keep your Miro diagrams and documents up to date as things change.
Journey mapping: ChatGPT maps out an existing user journey in Miro for the team to review in a collaborative session. From there, any proposed changes can be picked up by ChatGPT and drafted into follow-up items.

Invoke Miro directly with @Miro, or just describe what you want in plain language. Try prompts like:
- @Miro, summarize the decisions on this board [board URL]
- @Miro, turn this strategy doc into slides alongside our priorities
- @Miro, diagram this service's architecture with the docs beside it
- @Miro, update the journey map on this board with the changes we agreed
- @Miro, turn the comments on this board into action items
- @Miro, build a retro board for my team with dot voting

What Miro can do in ChatGPT:
- Read, search, and summarize context from your Miro boards
- Create boards, and generate full boards for workshops, retros, and planning sessions
- Create slides, diagrams, docs, tables, timelines, sticky notes, and images on the canvas
- Update and edit content already on the canvas, and delete what it created
- Create and update tables, including kanban and timeline views
- Read, reply to, and resolve board comments
- Upload images to a board
- Create, update, and share Miro spaces

plugin_connector_691fa57b709c8191b61c48b.name: Semrush
plugin_connector_691fa57b709c8191b61c48b.legacyDescriptionSource:
The Semrush MCP provides structured, quantitative SEO and traffic data for domains, keywords, backlinks, and market-level audience insights. It returns factual datasets including domain analytics, keyword metrics, backlink profiles, traffic data across time periods and channels, geographic and demographic distributions, and competitive or industry-level indicators.

plugin_asdk_app_6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14.legacySummary: 为 AI 智能体提供邮箱收件箱
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14.legacyDescriptionSource:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.
Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.
Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX
Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in ChatGPT. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.

plugin_asdk_app_6a846ee396988191a2818981.name: Forms AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a846ee396988191a2818981.description:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.

plugin_asdk_app_6a26e0a517488191b80afa0e.description:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.

plugin_asdk_app_69a462cfa7c0819183ea5703.legacySummary: 高亮并批注文本，辅助写作、文档反馈与分析
plugin_asdk_app_69a462cfa7c0819183ea5703.description:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes
• Clean, distraction-free reading experience
• Fast exploration of complex material

Understanding starts with context. Instead of reading around confusing parts, read through them with guidance that appears exactly where you need it. Read confidently, stay curious, and turn difficult passages into clear learning every day. today.

Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

* Painting and coatings

* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing

* Ceilings

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment

* How many square feet of flooring are required?

* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.

plugin_asdk_app_6a4d0a2713b8819190c1b085.name: Is It Down? Availability Check
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d0a2713b8819190c1b085.description:
Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you. 

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is having trouble. Workers can test company pages before reporting a problem. Developers can quickly check a public site before spending time looking for bugs. Support teams can use it as a fast first step when helping customers.

You can ask things like “Is this website down?”, “Can you check example.com?”, “Why won’t this page load?”, “Is the server online?”, or “Can anyone reach this site?” I understand many different ways of asking the same question, so you do not have to use special commands.

My goal is to save you time. Instead of trying many different things, start with a quick check. Knowing whether a website is online or offline helps you decide what to do next. That can stop wasted time, reduce worry, and make fixing problems much easier.

I focus on giving short, useful answers first. If you want more detail, just ask. I can explain what the result means, what you can try next, and which common problems might fit the situation. I keep the language simple, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay honest about what I know.

Whether you are checking one website or many, I aim to make the process fast, clear, and easy. Paste a web address, type a site name, or ask if a service is down. I’ll check its reachability, explain the result, and help you understand what to do next.

SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.

plugin_asdk_app_69fa6610711c8191bffd6775.description:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・A Pro plan subscription is required to connect
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.

Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Built for people who do entrepreneurial work and juggle more than one thing at a time.

Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters.

Deadline work — hours invested, pace against deadline, where effort is going
Ongoing commitments — weekly hour targets, streaks, monthly results check-in

4. Get your first weekly report  → "Show me my weekly report."
5. Inspect and adjust weekly → "Let's dig into what helps me progress/ hinders my progress"
6. Discover patterns over time  → "How was I keeping up with my priorities over the last weeks and months?"

The AI guides setup, narrates your data, and asks the questions worth sitting with. You decide what to do with it.

Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.

Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

What you can create: AI presentations and pitch decks, posters and flyers, social media graphics, infographics, diagrams, cards, email designs, web concepts, UI mockups, and visual documents.

- @StarryKit, create a 10-slide investor pitch deck for a sustainable urban farming startup.
- @StarryKit, design a bold poster for an electronic music festival in Tokyo.

- @StarryKit, recreate this website screenshot as an editable visual design.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7da30673a481918a1f6867.description:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

Socra Cortex helps people and teams stop repeating the same preferences, requirements, and decisions to ChatGPT and Codex. It keeps that knowledge and its reasons in a single source of truth that agents can retrieve before acting, across conversations and tools.

Modules record what should be and why, with a responsible owner and version history. Dependencies link the knowledge required to understand it. Flash loads the relevant Module and all its Dependencies, foundations first and each Module once.

Team members can own different subjects while their knowledge works together. For example, a product requirement Module created in ChatGPT can depend on architecture and security Modules maintained by their owners. Codex can Flash that requirement before implementing it and receive those decisions together.

As conversations and work reveal new knowledge, agents propose changes to existing Modules, so the knowledge always stays up to date. The suggested workflow asks them to show exact Before and After content and Dependencies for the owner's approval before saving. Updates become available on later Flashes, while version history preserves earlier knowledge and records changes.

Issues connect tasks to the Modules governing them, with assignees, work dependencies, comments, and evidence. Inboxes show unblocked work to its responsible person or agent; completed Issues preserve the outcome and history.

People and teams own the knowledge in their Socra Account, with Module permissions for people and groups. Review Modules, the knowledge map, and work at https://cortex.socra.com. Connect ChatGPT, Codex, or any other AI provider to that same Account with Cortex access.

Setup and agent instructions: https://workspace.socra.com/docs/cortex/installation.md

plugin_asdk_app_6a5cb08939488191b11c6c56.name: PostFast
plugin_asdk_app_6a5cb08939488191b11c6c56.description:
PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

Plan and schedule
Draft a post, choose which of your connected accounts it goes to, attach an image or video, and place it on the calendar for a specific time. Save it as a draft, route it for approval, or approve one that is already waiting. Review what is queued and remove a scheduled post. Supported accounts: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Telegram, and Google Business Profile.

Check how posts did
Look up the performance of a published post, or how an account's follower count has moved day by day. Analytics cover Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest Business accounts, and LinkedIn company pages.

Add an account
Generate a link that opens PostFast's account connection flow when you want to add a new social profile.

How it works
PostFast connects to each social network under its own app registrations and platform credentials, and stores your drafts, scheduled posts, media and comment history in your own PostFast workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Some tools do call a platform live, for example when publishing a post, and each of those is labelled as such.

You sign in with your existing PostFast account over OAuth. Viewing accounts, writing posts, and reading analytics are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time. The connector also exposes comment management tools used by other clients, which are not part of the workflows described here.

plugin_asdk_app_6a9a7836aabc8191b794d077.description:
Check essays, research papers, articles, and professional documents for signs of AI-generated writing inside ChatGPT. This AI detector and AI checker analyzes text you provide and returns AI and human likelihood scores, sentence-level highlights, and review guidance. The interactive workspace keeps your original text and detection results together for a clear, focused review.

Use it as a ChatGPT detector when reviewing text that may contain AI-generated writing, an AI essay checker for academic manuscripts, or an AI content detector for editorial and business documents. The tool supports AI writing review by bringing overall scores and individual sentence highlights into the same view, helping you identify passages that deserve closer attention.

Paste text into the workspace, run an AI detection scan, and read the overall assessment. Inspect highlighted sentences, consider the review guidance, and compare the results with the surrounding paragraphs. This text-checking workflow helps you move from a general question about possible AI use to a closer examination of specific passages.

Educators and researchers can use the AI text detector to support the review of essays, assignments, research papers, literature reviews, and other academic writing. Consider the findings alongside drafts, citations, source material, assignment requirements, and discussion with the author. Sentence-level AI detection provides an additional reference for understanding the text within its academic context.

Editors, publishers, journalists, and content teams can examine contributed articles, blog posts, newsletters, opinion pieces, and editorial drafts for possible AI-generated content. Use the AI content checker during an editorial review to identify sections that warrant follow-up with the writer and to keep the discussion grounded in the supplied text.

Marketing and SEO teams can review website copy, landing-page text, product descriptions, campaign content, and client deliverables. Business teams can check reports, proposals, and other professional writing. The same AI writing detector workflow helps reviewers examine the text they receive and decide where additional context or author input would be useful.

Whether you need an AI text checker for a research manuscript, a GPT detector for an article, or AI-generated text detection for business content, the workspace combines an overall assessment with sentence-level detail. Review possible AI writing, inspect the highlighted passages, and use the results to guide a more informed conversation about the content.

Detection results are estimates and should be interpreted with context and human judgment.

Successfully generated playable videos are charged even when the result does not fully match your expectations. You can inspect balances and recent generation costs, or send feedback to help improve future results. For critical issues, contact support@creativeclaw.co.

plugin_asdk_app_696e890a45388191b24c4a36.description:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let ChatGPT suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

ChatGPT can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines ChatGPT’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.

plugin_asdk_app_6a764f4cfd008191b7fe46c6.legacyDescriptionSource: Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details. Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities. For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within ChatGPT for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content.

plugin_asdk_app_695d100ea2e881918c922c73.description:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_6a605ef150fc819190b151f4.name: Font Pairing: Design & Brands
plugin_asdk_app_6a605ef150fc819190b151f4.description:
AI Font pairing for Designers.

Find beautiful font combinations in seconds with AI. Instead of trying dozens of fonts by hand, describe your project and get a complete font trio made for it. Each triplet includes a heading font, an accent font, and a body font that work well together. Whether you are building a website, designing a logo, creating a brand, making a presentation, or working on a social media post, this tool helps you choose fonts with less guesswork and more confidence.

Good typography can make a design feel clean, modern, friendly, bold, elegant, or playful. Picking the right fonts is often one of the hardest parts of design. Many fonts look great on their own but do not look good together. This app helps solve that problem. Tell the AI about your project, your audience, or the feeling you want, and it suggests font triplets that match your goals.

You can ask for styles like minimal, luxury, vintage, futuristic, editorial, corporate, creative, fun, classic, or high-tech. You can also describe your audience, your industry, or your brand personality. The AI uses your ideas to recommend fonts that fit the mood while keeping the design easy to read.

Every recommendation includes three fonts with different jobs. The heading font grabs attention. The accent font adds personality. The body font keeps long text clear and comfortable to read. Together they create a balanced typography system that is easier to use across websites, apps, presentations, posters, packaging, marketing materials, and more.

The app is useful for graphic designers, UI and UX designers, web designers, product designers, marketers, students, content creators, agencies, freelancers, startup founders, and anyone who wants better typography without spending hours testing font combinations.

You can keep asking for new ideas until you find the style you like. Try different moods, industries, audiences, or visual directions. Ask for alternatives, compare different looks, or explore fresh creative ideas. The AI can help you move from rough concepts to polished typography much faster than searching through large font libraries.

Whether you need fonts for a modern landing page, a restaurant menu, a fashion brand, a technology company, a portfolio, a mobile app, a book cover, a newsletter, or an event poster, the app helps you discover combinations that fit the project.

This tool works well during brainstorming, early design exploration, and final design decisions. It can help you avoid common pairing mistakes and give you inspiration when you feel stuck. It is also useful when you want to experiment with styles you might not have considered before.

If you already have one font picked, you can ask for matching options to complete the set. If you only know the feeling you want, the AI can start from that instead. The conversation is flexible, making it easy to refine results until they match your vision.

Instead of spending time comparing endless font lists, start with a strong typography system designed around your project. Save time, discover new ideas, and create designs with more consistency using AI-powered font triplets built for real design work.

plugin_asdk_app_6948cdcd2ad8819196c54ca8.name: Whiteboard by Athena AI
plugin_asdk_app_6948cdcd2ad8819196c54ca8.description:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly

translation.description:
TopView帮助您通过您的智能体创建和管理视觉项目。利用领先的AI模型生成图像和视频，在画布中整理角色、产品、场景、参考素材和版本，无需在不同工具间转移资源即可持续工作。

• 在同一平台生成和编辑图像与视频。通过文本、参考素材、现有资源或智能体上下文进行创作。
• 在画布中整理项目资源。管理角色、产品、场景、分镜脚本、参考素材和生成结果。随着项目推进，资源与版本始终保持关联。

• 制作电影和短篇戏剧。通过电影与戏剧技能开发故事、角色、世界观、分镜脚本、镜头和时间线。
• 将研究数据转化为营销创意。利用产品信息、用户洞察、竞品分析、评价和广告趋势，创作概念方案、用户生成内容视频、产品视频和推广素材。
• 重新制作与改编视频。分析参考素材，复用其结构或风格，用您自己的产品、角色或资源进行重构。
从规划调研到视觉创作、编辑及最终交付，全程与智能体协作，同时保持整个项目在画布中的完整连接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a610f58f8348191bf98761a.description:

This GPT helps you design, improve, explore, and refine gradients for websites, apps, logos, presentations, social posts, games, illustrations, and anything else that uses color. You do not need to know color theory or CSS. Just describe what you want, and it will help you create gradients that fit your idea.

You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

You can ask for things like:

• A sunset gradient for a landing page.
• A modern blue gradient for a SaaS product.
• A calm background for a meditation app.
• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.
• A pastel gradient for invitations.
• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.

plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.legacySummary: 查找可免费使用的素材照片
plugin_asdk_app_6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d12.description:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.

translation.summary: 寻找可免费使用的高质量图片
translation.description:
Pexafy搜索照片的方式就像你向他人描述画面那样。

当你输入「深夜独自在安静公寓工作的人员，仅由温暖的台灯照明」这样的场景描述时，会得到符合该画面的图片——而不是仅通过这些关键词标记的图片。搜索会同时覆盖九个免费图库（Unsplash、Pexels、Pixabay、Kaboompics、Burst、StockSnap、Picjumbo、Skitterphoto、NegativeSpace），而非逐个平台搜索。

提供三个只读工具：

search_photos —— 用一句话描述场景，可按颜色、方向、来源、许可证、摄影师或日期进行筛选。

search_photos_by_image —— 提供参考图片后获取视觉相似的图片，可附加文字说明：「像这个但发生在夜晚」。

get_similar_photos —— 找到与已有图片风格一致的更多图片，可用于保持文章或演示文稿的视觉统一性。

每个搜索结果都包含可显示的版权信息、多尺寸图片以及尺寸、主色调、方向、来源和许可证等元数据。结果会编号呈现，可像对话中那样引用图片——「更像第三个」，而非复制粘贴标识符。

在支持MCP应用的客户端中，搜索结果会以缩略图网格形式展示在对话中，点击即可直接查看完整元数据，无需额外调用。

该连接器为托管服务，无需安装也无需在配置文件中粘贴API密钥：您只需在浏览器中一次登录Pexafy，连接器会获得独立凭证，该凭证与您的密码分离且可独立撤销。仅授予只读权限，且不会请求更多权限。

免费Pexafy账户每月可进行5000次搜索，无需绑定信用卡。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae345f2dc8191bd52864d.legacySummary: 文字转语音与语音转录
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae345f2dc8191bd52864d.description:
VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you started earlier.

Access is granted through OAuth 2.1 with a consent screen that shows exactly which scopes you are approving: voice:read for browsing your library, voice:generate for producing audio and transcripts. You can revoke a connection at any time from Connected Apps in the VoiceLabs app, which invalidates both the stored consent and any live access tokens. Voice cloning is deliberately excluded from this surface. The plugin can only provision VoiceLabs' own preset voices, because uploading samples of a real person's voice requires a consent an agent cannot hold on your behalf.

Generated audio is returned as a short-lived signed link rather than a permanent public URL, and every tool call is recorded on the account's audit trail with its outcome.

translation.description:
VoiceLabs是基于浏览器的语音工作室，提供文本转语音和语音转文字服务。VoiceLabs插件允许ChatGPT直接操作您的语音库：列出账户中的语音配置文件，在缺少语音时配置内置预设语音，通过文本生成语音音频，将音频片段转写为文字，浏览已保存的语音片段，并查看之前启动的生成任务状态。

访问权限通过OAuth 2.1授权协议实现，授权页面会明确展示您需要批准的权限范围：voice:read（浏览语音库）、voice:generate（生成音频和字幕）。您可以在VoiceLabs应用的「Connected Apps」中随时撤销连接，这将同时失效已存储的授权和当前访问令牌。该功能有意排除了语音克隆功能，插件仅能配置VoiceLabs自身的预设语音，因为上传真实人物的语音样本需要用户本人授权，代理无法代为持有。

生成的音频以短期有效的签名链接形式返回，而非永久性公共URL。所有工具调用记录都会保留在账户的审计日志中，并标注操作结果。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0320f532b48191aa2a5d57.name: Heywa
plugin_asdk_app_6a0320f532b48191aa2a5d57.description:
Turn ChatGPT's text answers into visual stories.

Want to review the information Chat has given you in a different way? Heywa will turn your answers into interactive & tappable stories. Perfect for quick decision making, inspiration or learning more about a topic.

Ask Heywa to visualize any ChatGPT response into clean, visual formats that help you decide, discover, and explore faster.

Try prompts like this:
* Can you visualize this comparison for me, @Heywa?
* @Heywa, turn this into a visual story I can share.
* Show me these gift options visually @Heywa.
* I need this decision laid out visually @Heywa.

translation.summary: 将您的回答转化为图像
translation.description:
将ChatGPT的文本回答转化为视觉故事。

想以不同方式回顾Chat提供的信息吗？Heywa会将您的回答转化为互动且可点击的故事。非常适合快速决策、获取灵感或深入了解某个主题。

让Heywa将任何ChatGPT回复转化为清晰的视觉格式，帮助您更快做出决策、发现新内容并探索更多信息。

plugin_asdk_app_69458f632eb08191bae869ab.name: Subdivide
plugin_asdk_app_69458f632eb08191bae869ab.legacyDescriptionSource:
Need a metronome for your next practice session? Just describe what you need and Subdivide builds it right in your conversation.
With Subdivide you can:
• Create metronomes at any tempo from 10-400 BPM
• Use complex time signatures like 7/8, 5/4, or 6/8
• Add subdivisions from eighth notes to septuplets
• Mute individual subdivisions to practice complex rhythms
• Build click tracks with multiple sections and tempo transitions

Perfect for rehearsals, recording sessions, or live performance prep.

plugin_asdk_app_6a3a4dbd763081919117ce18.name: Maze
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a4dbd763081919117ce18.legacySummary: 读取你的 Maze 研究资料
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a4dbd763081919117ce18.description:
Connect Maze to look up research studies, review session results, and surface user insights without leaving the workflow. Find studies by topic even when the study name is unknown, go through participant responses and task metrics, retrieve highlights and themes from moderated and unmoderated sessions, and pull recordings or transcripts for deeper analysis.

Useful for pulling evidence for a product decision, synthesizing research before a design review, or catching up on studies that have not been reviewed yet.

translation.description:
将Maze连接到工作流中，即可查找研究项目、查看会话结果并发现用户洞察，无需离开当前工作环境。即使不知道研究名称，也能通过主题查找研究，查阅参与者反馈和任务指标，从有主持及无主持会话中提取重点内容和核心主题，并获取录音或文字稿用于深入分析。

适用于为产品决策提取证据、在设计评审前整合研究资料，或查阅尚未审阅的研究项目。

plugin_asdk_app_69463c3af6a48191aef5c210.name: Make A Viz
plugin_asdk_app_69463c3af6a48191aef5c210.legacyDescriptionSource:
Make A Viz app in ChatGPT lets you create and edit visual diagrams—flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and mind maps—directly inside ChatGPT.
Diagrams are generated instantly within ChatGPT, with no external tools or tabs required. You can ask for things like “create a flowchart for our sales approval process” or “build a sequence diagram for user authentication,” and see the diagram rendered inline.
Diagrams are fully editable through conversation and a visual editor. You can refine them by sending instructions such as “add an error-handling branch” or by directly adjusting nodes and connections.
All diagrams are saved automatically and remain accessible inside ChatGPT. You can retrieve and continue editing them later by asking “list my diagrams” or “show the onboarding flow I created.”

plugin_asdk_app_6a0c45498a2081918ddff759.name: Presentations.AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c45498a2081918ddff759.legacySummary: 制作幻灯片与演示文稿
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c45498a2081918ddff759.legacyDescriptionSource:
Presentations.AI turns ideas, text, and source documents into complete presentations.
Describe what you want — a Series A pitch, a quarterly business review, a training module, or a single explainer slide — and you get a finished deck back: structured layouts, visuals, and editable content. You can also paste an article or notes, or upload a PDF, Word document, or PowerPoint file, and convert it into a presentation directly.

Every result is delivered as an editable PowerPoint file, a PDF, individual slide images, or a shareable web link.
Built for founders, executives, sales and marketing teams, educators, and anyone who needs a finished presentation in minutes — not just an outline or a draft.

plugin_asdk_app_6a20a8fd8acc819193b3864e.name: Change.org: Start a Petition
plugin_asdk_app_6a20a8fd8acc819193b3864e.legacyDescriptionSource:
The Change.org app in ChatGPT helps you draft a petition for any cause. Use the app to turn your idea into a publish-ready petition with a compelling title, a clear argument, and your personal story. plugin_asdk_app_6a9a9af423b0819195523f55.name: SSHOW
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a9af423b0819195523f55.legacySummary: 设计幻灯片并制作动画
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a9af423b0819195523f55.description:
SSHOW is a design tool where one canvas holds your layout, its motion, and the
presentation you give from it. Connect this plugin and your assistant works inside
the project you already have open in a SSHOW editor: it reads the scenes and
objects, adds or changes text, shapes, images and keyframes, and takes a
screenshot to check its own work.

Everything happens in the project on your screen, so you watch each change land. A
batch of edits arrives as a single undo step, and the assistant can undo or redo it
for you. Nothing runs when you have no editor open.

You need a free SSHOW account and a project open at s.show or in the desktop app.
You sign in once when you connect, and you can end the connection at any time from
your profile.

translation.summary: 设计和制作幻灯片动画
translation.description:
SSHOW是一款设计工具，一个画布即可容纳你的布局、动态效果以及由此呈现的演示内容。连接此插件后，你的助手将在你当前打开的SSHOW编辑器项目中工作：它会读取场景和对象，添加或修改文本、形状、图片和关键帧，并截屏以检查自身的工作成果。

所有操作都在你屏幕上的项目中进行，因此你可以实时看到每次更改的效果。一批编辑操作会作为单一撤销步骤呈现，助手可以为你撤销或重做该步骤。当你没有打开编辑器时，任何操作都不会执行。

你需要拥有一个免费的SSHOW账户，并在s.show网站或桌面应用中打开一个项目。连接时只需登录一次，你随时可以从个人资料页面结束连接。

plugin_asdk_app_69b9154609d481919f0ce339.legacyDescriptionSource:
Havi transforms rough ideas into polished, presentation-ready slides instantly. Start with a prompt, a few notes, or a rough outline. The app builds the narrative, layout, and design so you can stay focused on your messaging. Build aesthetic slides with zero design effort.

You can ask for things like "Turn my product notes into a 5-slide overview" or "Create an onboarding presentation for new hires".
The app also supports instant edits with commands like "simplify the text on slide 2" or "change the theme to something more professional".

All presentations save automatically and can also be exported into both PDF and PPT formats directly.

How to Use

  1. Connect the Havi App from the directory
  2. Type "@" and tag Havi app, or type "Havi", then enter your prompt to generate stunning slides instantly

translation.summary: 几秒钟内打造专业演示文稿
translation.description:
Havi可将粗糙的创意瞬间转化为精美的演示文稿。从一个提示、几条笔记或粗略大纲开始，应用程序会构建叙事逻辑、版式设计和视觉风格，让您专注内容表达。零设计成本打造美观幻灯片。

您可以提出如「将产品笔记转化为5页概述」或「为新员工创建入职培训演示文稿」等请求。

应用还支持即时指令编辑，例如「简化第2张幻灯片的文字」或「更换为更专业的主题」。

所有演示文稿会自动保存，并可直接导出为PDF和PPT格式。

使用方法
1. 从应用目录中连接Havi应用
2. 输入「@」并@Havi应用，或直接输入「Havi」并输入您的指令，即可立即生成惊艳幻灯片

plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.name: kernelCAD
plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.legacySummary: 通过自然语言创建 CAD 模型
plugin_asdk_app_6a2fcd20e8008191b0c688ca.legacyDescriptionSource:
kernelCAD turns natural-language descriptions into real, parametric CAD models. Ask for a part, bracket, enclosure, or mechanism and kernelCAD writes editable .kcad.ts source backed by a true BREP kernel (OpenCascade), then lets you inspect topology, run design checks (interference, manufacturability, reachability, load), and export to STEP/STL. Every model opens in an interactive 3D viewer right inside the conversation, so you can rotate, zoom, and review the part without leaving ChatGPT.
Unlike a text-to-image tool, kernelCAD produces engineering-grade geometry with named faces and edges, parametric features, assemblies with mates and joints, and validation gates that catch broken or non-manufacturable models before you build.

Every model opens in an interactive 3D viewer right inside the conversation, so you can rotate, zoom, and review the part without leaving ChatGPT. Unlike a text-to-image tool, kernelCAD produces engineering-grade geometry with named faces and edges, parametric features, assemblies with mates and joints, and validation gates that catch broken or non-manufacturable models before you build.

translation.description: kernelCAD 将自然语言的描述转化为真实的、参数化的 CAD 模型。 请求一个部件、支架、封装或机制,而 kernelCAD 会写出可编辑的 .kcad.ts 源,由一个真正的 BREP 内核 (OpenCascade) 支持,然后允许您检查 topology,运行设计检查(干扰、制造能力、可达性、负载),并导出到 STEP/STL. 每个模型都以交互式 3D 浏览器打开,所以您可以在 ChatGPT 无需离开的情况下旋转、缩小和查看该部件。 与文本到图像工具不同, kernelCAD 会产生具有命名的面部和边缘、参数特征、配对和合并的组装和验证

plugin_asdk_app_6a5f7b1be6b48191b2ee935e.description: Aspicio turns DXF CAD drawings into things ChatGPT can work with: structured facts (units, bounds, layers with the colors actually drawn, entity counts, and the drawing's text content), rendered PNG images, and an interactive in-chat viewer with pan, zoom, layer toggles, and fullscreen. Point it at a drawing URL or paste DXF text to read title blocks and dimension values, check layer structure, and visually inspect floor plans, die-cut layouts, and mechanical parts without leaving the conversation.

translation.description: Aspicio将DXF CAD图纸转化为ChatGPT可处理的结构化数据：包含单位、边界范围、实际绘制颜色的图层、实体数量及图纸文本内容的结构化事实，渲染后的PNG图像，以及支持平移、缩放、图层切换和全屏模式的交互式在线查看器。您只需将其指向图纸URL或粘贴DXF文本，即可读取标题栏和尺寸数值，检查图层结构，并在不离开对话界面的情况下直观查看平面图、裁切布局和机械部件。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.name: VideoGen
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.summary: Create and edit videos with AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.legacySummary: 用 AI 创建和编辑视频
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.legacySummaryOriginal: Create and edit videos with AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.legacyDescriptionSource:
Create professional, editable videos and media from ChatGPT with your VideoGen account. Refine projects anytime on videogen.io.

Workflows: turn a narration script, uploaded voiceover, PDF/slideshow, or scene-by-scene storyboard into a multi-scene video with AI visuals and captions. Or generate a single prompt-to-clip when you only need a short shot.
Media tools: create images, video clips, voiceovers, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and talking-head avatars; upscale, vectorize, remove backgrounds, or add 3D parallax to stills. Upload brand assets (logos, product shots, audio) with the in-chat uploader when ChatGPT supports it.
Edit and deliver: remix projects (captions, transitions, animate stills), export MP4 downloads, and open deep links back into the VideoGen app for timeline edits, team settings, and finer control. Generation uses your VideoGen team credits; if a feature isn't available on your account, open app.videogen.io and manage your VideoGen account, then retry.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7632963b6c8191b3da9073.description:
Create professional, editable videos and media from ChatGPT with your VideoGen account. Refine projects anytime on videogen.io.

Workflows: turn a narration script, uploaded voiceover, PDF/slideshow, or scene-by-scene storyboard into a multi-scene video with AI visuals and captions. Or generate a single prompt-to-clip when you only need a short shot.

Media tools: create images, video clips, voiceovers, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and talking-head avatars; upscale, vectorize, remove backgrounds, or add 3D parallax to stills. Upload brand assets (logos, product shots, audio) with the in-chat uploader when ChatGPT supports it.

Edit and deliver: remix projects (captions, transitions, animate stills), export MP4 downloads, and open deep links back into the VideoGen app for timeline edits, team settings, and finer control. Generation uses your VideoGen team credits; if a feature isn't available on your account, open app.videogen.io and manage your VideoGen account, then retry.

translation.description:
通过您的VideoGen账户从ChatGPT创建专业且可编辑的视频和媒体内容。随时在videogen.io上优化您的项目。

工作流程：将旁白脚本、上传的配音、PDF/幻灯片或分镜脚本转化为包含AI视觉效果和字幕的多场景视频。或当您只需要短镜头时，直接通过单个提示生成视频片段。

媒体工具：创建图像、视频片段、配音、音乐、音效、动态图形和虚拟人物头像；对静态画面进行放大、矢量化、背景移除或添加3D视差效果。当ChatGPT支持时，可通过聊天内嵌上传器上传品牌素材（Logo、产品照片、音频）。

编辑与交付：重新混剪项目（字幕、转场、动态静态画面），导出MP4下载，并通过深度链接返回VideoGen应用进行时间轴编辑、团队设置和精细控制。生成内容将消耗您的VideoGen团队积分；若账户未开通某功能，请访问app.videogen.io管理VideoGen账户后重试。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3b65deef9881919825c50e.description:
PosterMyWall brings design templates into your chat. Describe what you need - a grand opening flyer, a baby shower invitation, a band logo, an Instagram sale post; and browse template options that appear right in the conversation.

What you can do
- Describe the design you're looking for in plain language.
- Include details like size, colors, style, or theme, and the results will match them.
- Browse the template options that appear in the chat.
- Open any template on PosterMyWall to customize it.

Designs for everything
Flyers, invitations, logos, posters, social media posts, menus, and more for small businesses, events, churches, schools, and organizations of every kind.

Customizing your template
This plugin finds and displays templates; editing happens on PosterMyWall. Every template preview includes an "Open in PosterMyWall" button that opens the template's page in a new tab, where you can edit it in PosterMyWall's drag-and-drop editor - swap text and images, resize for other platforms, and download.

Try prompts like
- Find me a grand opening flyer for a coffee shop.
- Show me baby shower invitations in soft pastels.
- I need a square Instagram post for a 50% off weekend sale.
- Find a grunge logo for a rock band.

Requirements: No account is needed to open a template. A free PosterMyWall account is required to save or download your design. Every template has a free download option; high-resolution downloads are paid.

translation.description:
PosterMyWall将设计模板带入您的聊天中,描述您需要的内容 - 一个伟大的开启小册子,婴儿淋浴邀请,乐队标志,Instagram销售帖子;并浏览在谈话中直接出现的模板选项。

您可以做什么 - 用简单的语言描述您正在寻找的设计 - 包括尺寸,颜色,风格或主题等细节,结果将匹配它们 - 浏览聊天中显示的模板选项 - 打开PosterMyWall上的任何模板以定制它。

每件事情的设计 飞行本、邀请、徽标、海报、社交媒体帖子、菜单等,适用于小型企业、活动、教堂、学校和各种组织。

定制您的模板 此插件会找到和显示模板;编辑发生在PosterMyWall上. 每个模板预览都包含一个“在PosterMyWall中打开”按钮,该按钮将模板的页面打开在一个新的卡片中,您可以在PosterMyWall的拖放编辑器中编辑它 - 交换文本和图像,为其他平台调整尺寸,并下载。

尝试提示,如 - 给我一个咖啡店的伟大开幕小册子 - 向我展示柔软的糕点中的婴儿淋浴邀请 - 我需要一个立方体的Instagram帖子,以获得50%的周末出售 - 找到一个摇滚乐队的格兰奇标志。

要求:不需要帐户来打开模板. 需要免费的 PosterMyWall 帐户来保存或下载您的设计. 每个模板都有免费的下载选项;高分辨率的下载是付费的。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9d0e60d4b4819194e190a9.name: Musamimuk

plugin_asdk_app_6a7be9a728448191adb2f3be.name: Drivethrough
plugin_asdk_app_6a7be9a728448191adb2f3be.description:
Describe the website you want, and it's live in seconds. No code, no settings, no website builder to learn - you say what you want, ChatGPT builds it, and Drivethrough puts it online.

Every site starts private, visible only to you. Share it like a doc link - send it to exactly the people you choose, no accounts needed - or make it public for the world when you're ready. That makes Drivethrough good for two kinds of sites: the little ones that were never for the whole internet (trip plans, the family recipe book, a tool that splits the bills), and the public ones you've been meaning to make (the plumbing business, the band, the bake sale).

Changing a site is just asking again. Every change is saved, so you can roll back to any earlier version instantly. Forms and RSVPs land in your email. Public sites can use your own web address, and it's free to start.

translation.description:
描述你想要的网站，几秒钟内即可上线。无需编码、无需设置、无需学习网站构建工具——你只需说明需求，ChatGPT会帮你构建，Drivethrough将网站发布到网络。

每个网站默认为私有，仅对你可见。像分享文档链接一样分享网站——可发送给任意指定的人，无需账户——或在准备就绪时将其设为公开。这使Drivethrough适用于两种类型的网站：原本就仅面向特定人群的网站（如旅行计划、家庭食谱簿、分账工具），以及你一直想创建的公开网站（如水管工服务、乐队介绍、烘焙义卖）。

修改网站只需重新提出需求即可。每次修改都会保存，可随时回滚到任意先前版本。表单和回复信息会直接发送到你的邮箱。公开网站可使用自定义网址，且免费起步。

Choose your Style or brand kit in the chat, open the draft in Synthesia to edit, or just generate and watch the video directly in the chat. Already have the source material somewhere else? Pull it from the tools you're connected to and hand it straight to us — no copy-paste, no rebuilding. You can ask Synthesia to: "Make a video explaining our new expense policy." "Turn this brief into a two-minute video for new starters." "Take the notes from our product spec and make an internal launch video." "Pull this quarter's numbers and make a 90-second update for the team." "Find the onboarding video we published last quarter." "Summarize what shipped this week and turn it into a video for the sales team." "Show me my drafts." Requirements: a paid Synthesia account. Connect once and we'll use your existing brand settings and workspace permissions — you'll only ever see videos you already have access to in Synthesia. Want to go hands-on?
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c6ebc8f74819197497c77.description:
Synthesia turns whatever you're working on into a finished, on-brand video.

Start from a prompt, a script, a document, or a link. We build a multi-scene video draft using your workspace's brand kits or one our curated Styles. Choose your Style or brand kit in the chat, open the draft in Synthesia to edit, or just generate and watch the video directly in the chat.

Already have the source material somewhere else? Pull it from the tools you're connected to and hand it straight to us — no copy-paste, no rebuilding.

You can ask Synthesia to:

"Make a video explaining our new expense policy."
"Turn this brief into a two-minute video for new starters."
"Take the notes from our product spec and make an internal launch video."
"Pull this quarter's numbers and make a 90-second update for the team."
"Find the onboarding video we published last quarter."
"Summarize what shipped this week and turn it into a video for the sales team."
"Show me my drafts."

Requirements: a paid Synthesia account. Connect once and we'll use your existing brand settings and workspace permissions — you'll only ever see videos you already have access to in Synthesia.

This plugin is currently in beta and features may be added or removed in the future, and there may be bugs. Please report any bugs, feedback, or issues you experience at https://synthesiacreate.typeform.com/mcp-beta and/or support@synthesia.io

translation.summary: 将任何内容转化为视频
translation.description:
Synthesia能将您正在处理的任何内容转化为完整的品牌调性视频。

从提示、脚本、文档或链接开始。我们将使用您工作区的品牌套件或我们的精选风格来创建多场景视频草稿。在聊天中选择您的风格或品牌套件，打开Synthesia中的草稿进行编辑，或直接在聊天中生成并观看视频。

如果您已在其他地方拥有源材料？可以从已连接的工具中提取内容直接交给我们——无需复制粘贴，无需重新构建。

您可以要求Synthesia执行以下操作：

"制作一个解释我们新差旅政策的视频。"
"将这份简报转化为给新员工的两分钟视频。"
"整理产品规格的笔记并制作内部发布视频。"
"提取本季度的数据并制作90秒的团队更新视频。"
"找到我们上季度发布的入职视频。"
"总结本周发布的内容并制作给销售团队的视频。"
"给我看看我的草稿。"

要求：付费Synthesia账户。完成一次连接后，我们将使用您现有的品牌设置和工作区权限——您只能看到在Synthesia中已拥有访问权限的视频。

想亲自操作？每个草稿或生成的视频都可以在Synthesia的完整编辑器中打开进行编辑和润色。

此插件目前处于测试阶段，未来可能会添加或删除功能，也可能存在一些错误。请通过https://synthesiacreate.typeform.com/mcp-beta和/或support@synthesia.io向我们报告任何错误、反馈或问题。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa28e5a079c81919a66c838.name: ShotClick
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28e5a079c81919a66c838.description:
ShotClick is a screenplay editor: professional formatting, locked scene numbers, revision passes, production breakdown, and .fdx import and export.

This plugin lets ChatGPT work inside the script itself instead of returning loose text. It reads your projects, scenes, subject, treatment, outline, characters, research notes and comments, and writes back properly formatted scenes, loglines, treatments and outline beats. Your existing permissions apply: on a shared project, a viewer stays read-only through the plugin too.

It can open a "what if" branch from any scene, so an alternate version of the story is written in parallel without touching the original. It also reaches AI Studio, the screenplay-to-video pipeline: it looks at the generated keyframes and reference images, then writes the image and video prompts that match them.

No tool deletes anything — not a scene, not a project, not a note — and no tool spends AI credits. Connecting requires a ShotClick account on the Studio plan, which includes the MCP connector.

translation.description:
ShotClick是一款剧本编辑器：提供专业格式排版、锁定场景编号、修订流程、制作分解功能，以及.fdx文件的导入导出支持。

该插件让ChatGPT能够直接在剧本内部工作，而非返回松散文本。它可读取您的项目、场景、主题、剧本大纲、概要、角色、研究笔记和评论，并返回格式规范的场景、一句话简介、剧本大纲和概要要点。您的现有权限依然有效：在共享项目中，查看者通过插件仍保持只读状态。

它可以从任意场景开启「假设」分支，平行编写故事的替代版本而不会修改原始内容。同时可接入AI Studio剧本转视频流程：分析生成的关键帧和参考图，然后撰写匹配的图像和视频提示词。

没有任何工具会删除内容——不会删除场景、项目或笔记，也不会消耗AI积分。连接需要拥有Studio计划的ShotClick账户，该计划包含MCP连接器。

plugin_asdk_app_6a310833394081919705b0a3.description:
The Clueso MCP gives Chatgpt a complete video production toolbox, connected to your Clueso workspace. Clueso turns screen recordings, slide decks, documents, or a plain prompt into finished videos and step-by-step written guides; this connector puts all of it in the chat.

What Chatgpt can do with it:
• Create - build a project from a prompt, a screen recording, a slide deck, or a document
• Compose - place text, callouts, shapes, images, motion graphics and stock footage across a timeline
• Narrate - write scripts and generate voiceover from a library of 350+ voices, synced to on-screen action
• Edit - make targeted changes to any clip, element or word without rebuilding the project
• Preview - render any frame as an image to check the result mid-conversation
• Publish - export the finished video, and build the written article from the same source
• Reuse - save any project as a template so the next video inherits its structure and branding

Because it runs through your assistant, it composes with whatever else you have connected pull a script from meeting notes, a feature list from a project tracker, or account detail from a CRM, and build the video from material that already exists.

Typical uses: product and feature walkthroughs, customer education libraries, internal training built from existing decks, launch and changelog videos, help-centre articles paired with video.

Everything the connector creates opens in the Clueso editor and stays fully editable.

translation.summary: 通过提示编辑或创建视频
translation.description:
Clueso MCP为Chatgpt提供完整的视频制作工具箱，连接到您的Clueso工作区。Clueso可将屏幕录制、幻灯片演示文稿、文档或普通提示转换为成品视频和分步书面指南；此连接器可将所有内容整合到聊天界面中。

Chatgpt可通过该工具实现的功能：
• 创建 - 从提示、屏幕录制、幻灯片演示文稿或文档构建项目
• 编排 - 在时间轴上放置文字、标注、图形、图片、动态图形和素材库视频
• 配音 - 从350+种语音库中撰写脚本并生成配音，同步屏幕动作
• 编辑 - 对任何片段、元素或文字进行针对性修改而无需重建项目
• 预览 - 将任意帧渲染为图片以在对话中检查效果
• 发布 - 导出成品视频，并从相同素材生成书面文章
• 复用 - 将任何项目保存为模板，使下个视频继承其结构和品牌元素

由于通过您的助手运行，它可以整合其他连接内容：从会议记录中提取脚本、从项目跟踪器获取功能列表、从CRM中调取账户详情，并基于现有素材制作视频。

典型应用场景：产品与功能演示视频、客户教育资料库、基于现有演示文稿制作的内部培训、发布与更新日志视频、搭配视频的帮助中心文章。

连接器生成的所有内容都会在Clueso编辑器中打开，并保持完全可编辑状态。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa2f4b4b2b0819199dbaa94.name: Quickads
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2f4b4b2b0819199dbaa94.description: QuickAds helps you research successful ads, discover trending hooks, and turn insights into new campaigns. Create AI images and videos, publish posts, launch ad campaigns, run automated agents, and analyze the performance of your content, ads, and ad accounts - all from one place.

translation.description: QuickAds助您研究成功广告，发现热门话题，并将洞察转化为新活动。创建AI图像和视频，发布帖子，启动广告活动，运行自动化代理，并分析您的内容、广告及广告账户的表现——所有操作均可一站式完成。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa15df8f0e88191935d169a.name: AdKraft
plugin_asdk_app_6aa15df8f0e88191935d169a.legacySummary: 通过照片制作视频广告
plugin_asdk_app_6aa15df8f0e88191935d169a.description: AdKraft turns product photos into finished video ads. Ads are made on your own AdKraft account and use its credits; new accounts start with free credits, and you can check the balance or list the ads you have made without leaving the chat.

translation.summary: 通过照片制作视频广告
translation.description: AdKraft能将产品照片转化为完整的视频广告。输入产品名称、简短描述和几张照片链接，它会撰写脚本、生成视频素材，用16种语言中的一种添加配音，并返回可直接发布的MP4格式视频——支持竖屏、方形或横屏格式，通常在两到五分钟内完成。广告将创建在您的AdKraft账户中并消耗账户积分；新账户初始赠送免费积分，您无需离开聊天界面即可查看余额或列出已制作的广告。
