plugin_asdk_app_6aa82cdc03fc81919026fc6a.name: Motionvid
plugin_asdk_app_6aa82cdc03fc81919026fc6a.description: MotionVid turns a prompt or a script into a finished motion graphics video. Describe what you need, like an animated logo reveal, a product ad, a how-it-works explainer, an animated infographic or a map explainer, and MotionVid plans the scenes, animates them, adds narration and music, and renders an MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.  Pick a style such as claymation, paper collage or flat vector, apply your brand kit, preview frames before rendering, and ask for changes to an existing video without starting over. Works with your MotionVid account on any paid plan.

translation.description: MotionVid可将提示或脚本转化为完整的动态图形视频。描述您的需求，例如动画标志揭示、产品广告、工作原理说明、动态信息图表或地图说明，并MotionVid将规划场景、进行动画制作、添加旁白和音乐，并以16:9、9:16或1:1格式渲染为MP4文件。选择黏土动画、纸张拼贴或扁平矢量等风格，应用您的品牌套装，预览帧再进行渲染，并可在不重新开始的情况下对现有视频提出修改要求。支持在任何付费计划的MotionVid账户上使用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8adaaa6d748191906ced78.name: Lawh.ai
plugin_asdk_app_6a8adaaa6d748191906ced78.legacySummary: 创建可编辑的分层设计
plugin_asdk_app_6a8adaaa6d748191906ced78.legacyDescriptionSource:
Lawh.ai turns a description into a real, layered design file in the user's own account rather than a flat image. It measures the text, computes the layout, prevents clipping, and reports layout or contrast problems so they can be fixed. Designs can be listed, previewed as images, opened in an interactive view where layers are dragged and text retyped, started from a hand-authored template library, organised into folders, and built with the user's own uploaded logos and images.
Arabic and right-to-left layouts are supported natively. Finished work stays editable in the browser and exports as a layered Photoshop file with live text.

plugin_asdk_app_6aaa085f71148191b80c6220.name: AdsTurbo
plugin_asdk_app_6aaa085f71148191b80c6220.summary: Make AI ad videos and images
plugin_asdk_app_6aaa085f71148191b80c6220.legacySummary: 制作 AI 视频广告与图像
plugin_asdk_app_6aaa085f71148191b80c6220.legacySummaryOriginal: Make AI ad videos and images
plugin_asdk_app_6aaa085f71148191b80c6220.description:
AdsTurbo turns ChatGPT into an ad creative workstation. Connect your AdsTurbo account and ask ChatGPT to produce ad videos and product images directly in the conversation.

What it can do:
- Clone a competitor ad: analyze a reference video into a shot-by-shot storyboard and prompts, then generate a new video with the same structure.
- Generate video from text or images, including first/last-frame and multi-reference generation, plus extending or locally editing an existing video.
- Create digital-human spokesperson videos: pick a platform AI actor, clone a custom persona from a photo and voice sample, or lip-sync a portrait to an audio track (TTS included).
- Clean up finished videos: remove watermarks, logos and burnt-in subtitles, upscale to 2K/4K, and add or translate subtitles.
- Transform videos: swap the on-screen person, drive a static portrait with a reference video's motion, or translate a whole video into another language.
- Create and edit images for e-commerce: text-to-image, background removal, product and scene shots, campaign posters, and upscaling.

Generation runs as background tasks; ChatGPT returns a link to each finished video or image. All assets you provide must be publicly accessible URLs.

Requires an AdsTurbo account with a Pro plan or above. Generation consumes AdsTurbo credits according to your plan.

translation.description:
AdsTurbo将ChatGPT转变为广告创意工作台。连接您的AdsTurbo账户后，可在对话中直接让ChatGPT生成广告视频和产品图片。

主要功能：
- 克隆竞争对手广告：分析参考视频生成分镜头脚本和提示词，然后按照相同结构生成新视频。
- 从文本或图像生成视频，支持首尾帧生成、多参考生成，以及对现有视频进行扩展或局部编辑。
- 制作数字人代言人视频：选择平台AI演员，通过照片和语音样本来克隆自定义角色，或为肖像视频添加唇形同步（包含文本转语音功能）。
- 优化完成的视频：去除水印、logo和嵌入字幕，升级至2K/4K画质，并添加或翻译字幕。
- 视频转换：替换屏幕人物，用参考视频的动作驱动静态肖像，或整片翻译成其他语言。
- 制作电商图片：文本生成图像、背景消除、产品与场景拍摄、活动海报制作及画质提升。

生成过程作为后台任务运行；ChatGPT会为每个完成的视频或图片返回链接。您提供的所有素材必须为公开可访问的URL。

需要拥有专业版或更高计划的AdsTurbo账户。生成内容将根据您的计划消耗AdsTurbo积分。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab579a2fc24819199d8bea6.name: Treza
plugin_asdk_app_6ab579a2fc24819199d8bea6.legacySummary: 创建和编辑 AI 视频
plugin_asdk_app_6ab579a2fc24819199d8bea6.description:
Treza makes and finishes videos from ChatGPT. Describe a video and Treza builds it with current video and image models, narration, music and captions, then renders it on your Treza account. You can also work with media you already have: join clips into one video over a voiceover and a music bed, or caption, upscale, crop or trim a single file.

What you can do:
- Start from a ready-made template, such as turning a long video or podcast into captioned vertical clips, or build a custom pipeline from a brief.
- Run a pipeline and follow it to the finished video.
- Check what a run will cost before spending, and see your credit balance.
- Browse the videos, images and audio your account has made.
- Add an image, video or audio file you attach or link, then edit it.
- Publish a pipeline and pause or resume its schedule.
- Connect your YouTube channel or TikTok account, and post a finished video after you review it. Nothing is posted until you press Post.

Runs spend prepaid credits from your Treza account. You sign in with Google when you connect, which creates a Treza account if you don't have one. Posting needs your own YouTube channel or TikTok account, which you connect from a link Treza gives you in the chat.

translation.description:
Treza 通过 ChatGPT 制作并完成视频。描述一个视频内容，Treza 将使用当前视频和图像模型、旁白、音乐及字幕来构建视频，并在您的 Treza 账户中进行渲染。您也可以使用已有的媒体素材：将片段合并到语音旁白和背景音乐中，或对单个文件进行字幕添加、画质提升、裁剪或剪辑。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 从现成模板开始，例如将长视频或播客转换为带字幕的竖版片段，或根据简要说明构建自定义流程。
- 运行流程并跟踪至最终视频成品。
- 在消费前查看运行成本，并查看您的信用余额。
- 浏览账户生成的视频、图片和音频。
- 添加您上传或链接的图片、视频或音频文件，然后进行编辑。
- 发布流程并暂停或恢复其定时任务。
- 连接您的 YouTube 频道或 TikTok 账号，在审核后将成品视频发布。只有在您点击发布时才会实际上传。

流程会消耗您 Treza 账户中的预付信用点数。连接时需通过 Google 登录，若尚未有账户将自动创建 Treza 账户。发布功能需要您拥有独立的 YouTube 频道或 TikTok 账号，可通过 Treza 在聊天中提供的链接进行连接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a94efba550881919f5e51d8.name: Carat
plugin_asdk_app_6a94efba550881919f5e51d8.legacySummary: 创建 AI 图像与视频
plugin_asdk_app_6a94efba550881919f5e51d8.description:
Create images, video, audio, branded assets, and social content directly in ChatGPT. Start with an idea or reference files, and use Carat to plan, generate, review, edit, and export your work in one conversation.

With Carat, you can:

• Generate images and videos from text or reference media. Create portraits, illustrations, product visuals, cinematic scenes, social content, and ad creatives, or turn a still image into a video.
• Create product and brand content, including product photos, campaign visuals, short-form video ads, and coordinated social assets.
• Edit and transform existing media. Upload files for analysis, upscale images, create variations, and refine the results through conversation.
• Generate and work with audio for your creative projects.
• Inspect images, video, and audio before editing. Analyze uploaded content and technical metadata to choose suitable source material and workflows.
• Build and revise video projects in Carat Studio. Edit timelines, preview changes, and export the finished video.
• Review generated results in chat and build on previous creations without starting over.

Describe what you want to make and attach any references you need. From a single image to a multi-step video project, plan, create, and keep refining your work in the same conversation.

Connect your Carat account to get started. No separate API key is required. Generations use the same credit balance as the Carat platform.

translation.description:
在ChatGPT中直接创建图像、视频、音频、品牌素材和社交内容。从一个想法或参考文件开始，使用Carat在一次对话中完成规划、生成、审阅、编辑和导出工作。

使用Carat您可以：

• 通过文本或参考素材生成图像和视频。可创建人像、插画、产品视觉、电影场景、社交内容和广告创意，或把静态图像转化为视频。
• 创建产品和品牌内容，包括产品照片、活动视觉、短视频广告和协调的社交素材。
• 编辑和改造现有媒体。上传文件进行分析，放大图像，生成变体，并通过对话优化结果。
• 为创意项目生成和处理音频。
• 在编辑前检查图像、视频和音频。分析上传内容和技术元数据，选择合适的素材和工作流程。
• 在Carat Studio中构建和修改视频项目。编辑时间线，预览更改，并导出最终视频。
• 在聊天中审阅生成结果，并在原有创作基础上持续优化而无需从头开始。

描述您想创作的内容并附加所需参考素材。从单张图像到多步骤视频项目，可在同一对话中完成规划、创作和持续优化。

连接您的Carat账户即可开始使用。无需单独的API密钥。生成内容使用与Carat平台相同的信用额度。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6e0c6b48b48191845e65bc.name: Uwear
plugin_asdk_app_6a6e0c6b48b48191845e65bc.legacySummary: 创建 AI 时尚图像
plugin_asdk_app_6a6e0c6b48b48191845e65bc.legacyDescriptionSource: Uwear helps fashion teams organize garments, reusable models, locations, and art direction; prepare and approve photoshoot briefs; and generate, edit, and review product images and videos using their existing Uwear account and credits.

translation.description: Uwear帮助时尚团队整理服装、可重复使用的模型、拍摄地点和艺术指导；制定并审批摄影计划；并通过其现有的Uwear账户及积分生成、编辑和审核产品图片与视频。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa8f97285d08191bc987b06.name: Atlas Cloud
plugin_asdk_app_6aa8f97285d08191bc987b06.legacySummary: 使用超过 400 个模型制作媒体内容
plugin_asdk_app_6aa8f97285d08191bc987b06.legacyDescriptionSource:
Generate images, videos, audio, 3D assets, and text with a live catalog of 400+ AI models. Choose video models such as Seedance, Veo, Kling, MiniMax, and Wan; image models such as GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX, and Qwen; 3D models from Hunyuan and Tripo; plus audio models from Suno, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, and Seed Audio.
With this plugin, you can:
• Generate and edit images from text, images, or supported references.
• Create text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video clips; use supported video editing, avatar, and motion-control workflows.
• Turn text or images into 3D assets; create speech and music; transcribe audio; and run supported LLMs.
• Search the live model catalog, inspect each model’s inputs, output type, and pricing, upload source media for a generation task, and track asynchronous jobs to completion.
Connect your Atlas Cloud account in the browser—no API key is required. Billable jobs charge your Atlas balance and may require confirmation before submission. Availability, inputs, output formats, processing time, and cost vary by selected model. Uploads are temporary generation inputs, not permanent file storage.

translation.summary: 使用400多种模型创建媒体
translation.description:
使用400多种AI模型的直播目录生成图像,视频,音频,3D资产和文本;选择视频模型,如Seedance,Veo,Kling,MiniMax和Wan;图像模型,如GPT Image,Nano Banana,Seedream,FLUX和Qwen;来自Hunyuan和Tripo的3D模型;以及来自Suno,ElevenLabs,MiniMax和Seed Audio的音频模型。

借助此插件,您可以: • 生成和编辑来自文本,图像或支持的参考文本的图像; • 创建文本到视频,图像到视频和参考到视频的剪辑; 使用支持的视频编辑,外观和运动控制工作流程; • 将文本或图像转换为3D资产; 创建语音和音乐; 转录音频; 运行支持的LLM。

在浏览器中连接您的 Atlas Cloud 帐户 — 无需 API 密钥. 可收费的任务会收取您的 Atlas 余额,并且可能需要提交前确认。 可用性、输入、输出格式、处理时间和成本因选择的模型而异。 上传是临时生成输入,而不是永久性文件存储。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab639b28e2081919b704b4a.name: Frameo
plugin_asdk_app_6ab639b28e2081919b704b4a.legacySummary: 生成和编辑 AI 视频
plugin_asdk_app_6ab639b28e2081919b704b4a.description: Frameo turns a prompt into a finished short video inside ChatGPT. It generates images, video clips, voiceovers, music, and sound effects in the user's Frameo workspace, keeps characters and style consistent across shots, and assembles the clips with ffmpeg and motion-graphics templates into a final cut. Users can also upload or import their own media, browse a free sound-effect library, and read back a project's canvas and Library. Every credit-spending generation is quoted first with estimate_cost and runs only after the user confirms.

translation.description: Frameo在ChatGPT内将提示转换为完整短视频。它在用户的Frameo工作区生成图片、视频片段、配音、音乐和音效，保持镜头间角色与风格的一致性，并通过ffmpeg和动态图形模板将片段合成最终成片。用户还可上传或导入自有媒体，浏览免费音效库，查看项目的画布和素材库。每次生成前会先通过estimate_cost进行费用预估，确认后才执行生成操作。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa9b57cc4388191af101301.name: Pedra
plugin_asdk_app_6aa9b57cc4388191af101301.description:
Pedra is the AI photo and video studio for real estate agents. Connect your Pedra account and ask ChatGPT to prepare a listing's visuals.

Virtually stage empty rooms in the style you want, empty furnished rooms, renovate spaces with new floors and finishes, enhance lighting and straighten perspective, replace a dull sky with a blue one, remove objects, or blur faces and license plates. Describe any other edit in plain words, like "paint the walls sage green".

Pedra also turns a property's photos into a listing video with animated clips, background music, a narrated voiceover, and word-synced subtitles.

Everything you create is saved to your Pedra properties, so you can keep editing in the Pedra app. Requires a Pedra account; generations use your account's credits.

translation.description:
Pedra是房地产经纪人的AI照片和视频工作室。连接您的Pedra账户，让ChatGPT准备房源的视觉素材。

您可以虚拟布置空房间（按您想要的风格）、空置的家具齐全房间，用新地板和装修翻新空间，增强照明并校正透视，将阴沉的天空替换为蓝天，移除物体或模糊人脸和车牌。用简单明了的语言描述其他编辑需求，例如「将墙壁涂成鼠尾草绿」。

Pedra还能将房产照片转化为带动画片段、背景音乐、旁白和同步字幕的房源视频。

您创建的所有内容都会保存到Pedra房源中，可继续在Pedra应用中编辑。需要Pedra账户；生成内容会消耗账户积分。

plugin_asdk_app_6a973e80c5048191a440bb08.name: Marq
plugin_asdk_app_6a973e80c5048191a440bb08.legacySummary: 创建符合品牌风格的内容
plugin_asdk_app_6a973e80c5048191a440bb08.description: Marq is the Brand Enablement Platform for brand teams supporting creators across the organization. Connect Marq to ChatGPT to find brand templates and use them to create or update on-brand content like one-pagers, datasheets, and social posts. Use ChatGPT to inspect a project’s pages, text, images, and Smart Fields, then rewrite, proofread, or translate copy and replace images. You can also personalize content with user, team, or project information, populate documents from your Marq datasets, and apply Marq Brand Kit colors, fonts, and logos to supported template elements. Export finished projects as PDF, PNG, or JPG. Changes preserve existing styling and element locks, so teams can create and update content faster without losing brand or layout control. ChatGPT only works with content the signed-in user can access in Marq.

translation.summary: 创建符合品牌规范的内容
translation.description: Marq 是品牌赋能平台，专为品牌团队打造，支持组织内的创作者。将 Marq 连接到 ChatGPT，查找品牌模板并使用它们创建或更新符合品牌规范的内容，例如单页文档、数据表和社交媒体帖子。使用 ChatGPT 检查项目的页面、文本、图片和智能字段，然后重写、校对或翻译文案并替换图片。您还可以通过用户、团队或项目信息个性化内容，从 Marq 数据集填充文档，并将 Marq 品牌工具包中的颜色、字体和标志应用到支持的模板元素。将完成的项目导出为 PDF、PNG 或 JPG 格式。更改会保留现有样式和元素锁定，因此团队可以更快地创建和更新内容，同时不会失去品牌或布局控制。ChatGPT 仅能处理已登录用户在 Marq 中可访问的内容。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa73c97b8288191ab40d6fa.name: Swish Sports Court Builder
plugin_asdk_app_6aa73c97b8288191ab40d6fa.description: Create custom basketball and other sports court designs with Swish Court Builder. Set dimensions, choose flooring and colors, adjust court markings and borders, and add sports lines, logos, and text. View 2D and 3D previews, download images or videos, and continue editing in Swish Court Builder. Customers can review and order physical court flooring through the Swish Court website.

translation.description: 通过Swish Court Builder创建定制篮球场及其他运动场地设计。设置尺寸、选择地板材质和颜色、调整场地标记和边框，并添加运动线、标志和文字。查看2D和3D预览，下载图片或视频，并在Swish Court Builder中继续编辑。客户可通过Swish Court网站查看并订购实体场地地板。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa6d22a487c819195f5f691.name: PictureBooks
plugin_asdk_app_6aa6d22a487c819195f5f691.description: Create private illustrated storybooks from your ideas, follow generation progress, and read stories saved in your PictureBooks account. Built for parents, caregivers, educators, and other adult authors. Connect your existing account to check available credits and create books using those credits. The plugin does not purchase credits, charge a card, or publish your books. You can disconnect access in PictureBooks at any time.

translation.description: 从您的创意出发，创建私密图文故事书，跟踪生成进度，并阅读保存在您PictureBooks账户中的故事。专为家长、看护人员、教育工作者及其他成人作者设计。连接您的现有账户以查看可用信用点，并使用这些信用点创作书籍。该插件不会购买信用点、扣费或发布您的书籍，您可随时在PictureBooks中断开访问。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa41d5122f48191865e1b40.name: Details
plugin_asdk_app_6aa41d5122f48191865e1b40.description: Details helps you find curated website design references, inspect images and ordered video frames, and retrieve reusable web interface resources from the Details Vault. Search by section, component, style, or interaction, compare numbered results, then inspect a selected reference or retrieve a resource's implementation instructions and documentation. A connected Details account with an eligible plan is required; available tools and usage allowances depend on your account.

translation.description: Details帮助您查找精选的网站设计参考，检查图片和有序视频帧，并从Details Vault获取可重用的网页界面资源。可通过板块、组件、样式或交互方式搜索，比较编号结果，然后检查选定的参考内容或获取资源的实现说明和文档。需要连接符合资格计划的Details账户；可用工具和使用配额取决于您的账户。

plugin_asdk_app_6abc0713a40081919b055a6c.name: Planner 5D: Design & Planning
plugin_asdk_app_6abc0713a40081919b055a6c.legacySummary: 规划空间并创建视觉效果
plugin_asdk_app_6abc0713a40081919b055a6c.description:
Plan a renovation, see how furniture fits, explore a new home, or create visuals for your next project.
Create and edit floor plans, try different layouts, arrange furniture, and visualize interiors, buildings, and outdoor spaces in 2D and 3D. Explore ideas for your own home, client projects, or property presentations.
Turn photos, sketches, and references into images and videos. Compare styles, materials, and design options, or create visual content beyond home design.
Work with plans, specifications, quotes, and project documents. Organize materials and costs, compare options, and prepare clear briefs and presentations.
Start with an idea, a photo, a floor plan, or your project files. Develop your work through conversation and continue refining it in Planner 5D.

translation.description: 计划翻新,看看家具如何合适,探索新房屋,或为您的下一个项目创建视觉图。创建和编辑地板图,尝试不同的布局,安排家具,并在2D和3D中可视化室内,建筑物和户外空间。探索您自己的家,客户项目或财产演示的想法。将照片,草图和参考转化为图像和视频。比较风格,材料和设计选项,或创建超出家居设计的视觉内容。使用计划,规格,报价和项目文件。组织材料和成本文件,比较选项,并准备清晰的简报和演示文稿。从一个想法,一张照片,一张地板计划或您的项目文件开始。通过对话开发您的工作,并继续在Planer 5D中完善它。

plugin_asdk_app_6a88289a42b48191af01d7e1.name: WonderWorks
plugin_asdk_app_6a88289a42b48191af01d7e1.legacySummary: 生成 AI 视频与媒体内容
plugin_asdk_app_6a88289a42b48191af01d7e1.description: Bring your creative vision to life with WonderWorks AI. Generate stunning images, cinematic video clips, multi-shot storyboards, original music, and immersive sound effects directly from your conversation. Turn a story idea into a visually consistent sequence of key images that can become a long-form video. Use detailed prompts and reference images to control composition, style, characters, and visual continuity. Animate images into video, direct camera movement and on-screen action, and create the perfect soundtrack for your story. Ideal for filmmakers, content creators, marketers, and anyone turning ideas into compelling visual experiences.

translation.description: 通过WonderWorks AI实现您的创意愿景。从对话中直接生成令人惊叹的图像、电影级视频片段、多镜头分镜脚本、原创音乐和沉浸式音效。将故事创意转化为视觉一致的关键图像序列，这些图像可进一步发展成长篇视频。使用详细提示和参考图像控制构图、风格、角色和视觉连贯性。将图像动画化为视频，指导镜头运动与屏幕动作，并为您的故事打造完美原声配乐。适用于电影制作人、内容创作者、营销人员以及任何将创意转化为引人入胜的视觉体验的人士。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa5c87fee8c8191be7798ec.name: Vectorize
plugin_asdk_app_6aa5c87fee8c8191be7798ec.legacySummary: 把标志转为可编辑 SVG
plugin_asdk_app_6aa5c87fee8c8191be7798ec.description: Vectorize converts PNG, JPEG, and WebP logos into editable SVG revisions. Users can inspect and refine colors, curve smoothing, background removal, and framing in an interactive preview, then download an approved SVG or generate a complete brand kit.

translation.summary: 将标志转换为可编辑的SVG
translation.description: Vectorize可将PNG、JPEG和WebP格式的标志转换为可编辑的SVG版本。用户可通过交互式预览检查并优化颜色、曲线平滑度、背景去除和构图，然后下载已批准的SVG文件或生成完整的品牌套装。

plugin_asdk_app_6a608e436adc8191affb5460.name: Orisu
plugin_asdk_app_6a608e436adc8191affb5460.legacySummary: 构建 AI 媒体工作流
plugin_asdk_app_6a608e436adc8191affb5460.description: Orisu helps users create, inspect, edit, run, and share node-based workflows for generating AI images, video, audio, and text. Users can manage reusable apps and brand kits, validate workflow graphs, estimate run costs, monitor executions, and review generated outputs from ChatGPT.

translation.description: Orisu帮助用户创建、检查、编辑、运行和共享用于生成AI图像、视频、音频和文本的基于节点的工作流。用户可以管理可重用的应用和品牌套件，验证工作流图，估算运行成本，监控执行情况，并查看来自ChatGPT的生成输出。

plugin_asdk_app_69494bc0260481919dcbef67.name: AI Humanizer
plugin_asdk_app_69494bc0260481919dcbef67.legacySummary: 让 AI 文字更自然
plugin_asdk_app_69494bc0260481919dcbef67.description: Transform your AI-generated content into natural, human-like text with the ultimate AI Humanizer  tool. This ai-to-human text converter effortlessly converts output from AI to humanized text.

translation.summary: 将AI文本转化为自然流畅的人类文本
translation.description: 使用终极AI Humanizer工具，将您的AI生成内容转化为自然流畅的人类文本。这款AI转人类文本转换器可轻松将AI输出转换为人性化文本。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8c69d0604081918a66243a.name: 굿새김 Goodsaegim
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c69d0604081918a66243a.description: Goodsaegim makes custom goods — acrylic keyrings, acrylic stands, stickers, postcards, photo cards and more — in small runs starting from a single piece. Ideal for fan merch, artist goods, and one-off gifts made from your own artwork. Chat to pick a product and options (size, quantity, accessories), get a real-time quote with VAT and shipping included, and once the spec is settled receive links that take you through artwork upload and payment. Your file is checked for print readiness before production. Made in Korea by the manufacturer itself; ships within Korea only. Covers 11 products with option info, quotes, and order links.

translation.description: Goodsaegim提供亚克力钥匙扣、亚克力支架、贴纸、明信片、照片卡等定制商品，小批量起订最低仅需一件。适合粉丝周边、艺术家商品以及基于您原创作品的定制礼物。通过聊天选择产品及选项（尺寸、数量、配件），获取包含增值税及运费的实时报价，确认规格后可直接通过链接上传设计稿并完成支付。生产前会检查文件是否符合印刷要求。由制造商直接在韩国生产；仅限韩国境内配送。涵盖11种产品，提供选项信息、报价及订单链接。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa199e8775c819193fc3a31.name: Taste
plugin_asdk_app_6aa199e8775c819193fc3a31.description: Find and browse designs you have saved in Taste. Search your references and collections, view designs in a visual gallery, and use your taste profile to guide design work. Connect your Taste account to access your library.

translation.description: 在Taste中查找并浏览您保存的设计，搜索您的参考资料和作品集，以视觉画廊形式查看设计，并通过您的品味档案指导设计工作。连接您的Taste账户以访问您的资料库。

plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.name: GSC Wizard
plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.legacyDescriptionSource:
GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back.
Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow.
It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.
plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.description: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.

translation.description: GSC Wizard将ChatGPT与您自己的谷歌搜索控制台属性连接，从而以自然语言分析SEO性能。您可以请求性能摘要、顶级查询和页面、两个时间段间的排名变化、内容衰减、关键词自相残杀、CTR与位置曲线，或完整的SEO报告，并获得最终答案。与将数千行原始数据流式传输到模型不同，所有分析均在服务器端针对数据仓库进行计算，因此结果快速、准确且高效。您还可以列出并检查属性，运行谷歌的URL检查工具，跟踪索引情况，管理主题集群和内容组，并向IndexNow提交URL。它还会报告您自己关联的谷歌分析4（GA4）属性：流量概览、维度分解、电子商务、关键事件（转化），以及由ChatGPT和Perplexity等AI助手带来的流量，以及搜索控制台与GA4混合的着陆页浏览量。摘要工具会在ChatGPT中直接生成交互式卡片和表格。所有访问均通过谷歌登录受限于您的账户。

plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.name: Lovable
plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.legacyDescriptionSource: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build. Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.
plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.description: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build. Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.

translation.summary: 通过聊天构建全栈应用
translation.description: Lovable通过自然语言构建和编辑全栈网页应用。描述一个应用，Lovable将创建项目、编写TypeScript、Tailwind和shadcn/ui代码，并返回可实时预览的界面。后续消息可进一步优化应用，您可查看生成代码与差异，添加PostgreSQL数据库和第三方连接器，管理可复用的项目知识与技能，并将完成的应用发布为公共网址。

plugin_asdk_app_695325bae7348191b58ae934.name: TinyFish
plugin_asdk_app_695325bae7348191b58ae934.legacyDescriptionSource: TinyFish helps ChatGPT answer web questions and complete user-directed browser workflows. It can search the web, read specific pages, and run a live browser session for tasks that require interaction, such as navigating a site, clicking, filling forms, checking page state, or working inside a web app. Use it for specific requested tasks; it is not for broad crawling, bulk URL processing, or unspecified third-party access.
plugin_asdk_app_695325bae7348191b58ae934.description: TinyFish helps ChatGPT answer web questions and complete user-directed browser workflows. It can search the web, read specific pages, and run a live browser session for tasks that require interaction, such as navigating a site, clicking, filling forms, checking page state, or working inside a web app. Use it for specific requested tasks; it is not for broad crawling, bulk URL processing, or unspecified third-party access.

translation.description: TinyFish帮助ChatGPT解答网络问题并完成用户指定的浏览器工作流。它可以搜索网络、阅读特定页面，并为需要交互的任务运行实时浏览器会话，例如浏览网站、点击操作、填写表单、检查页面状态或在网页应用内部操作。该工具仅适用于特定请求的任务；不适用于大规模爬取、批量URL处理或未明确的第三方访问。
在Netlify上构建和部署

plugin_asdk_app_69e0086d87088191a3edc052.name: Neon
plugin_asdk_app_69e0086d87088191a3edc052.legacyDescriptionSource: Neon lets users inspect and manage Neon projects, branches, computes, Postgres databases, authentication, data APIs, functions, storage, logs, and database changes through ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69e0086d87088191a3edc052.description: Neon lets users inspect and manage Neon projects, branches, computes, Postgres databases, authentication, data APIs, functions, storage, logs, and database changes through ChatGPT.

translation.summary: 管理您的 Neon 后端
translation.description: Neon 允许用户通过 ChatGPT 检查和管理 Neon 项目、分支、计算、 Postgres 数据库、身份验证、数据 API、函数、存储、日志和数据库更改。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3c407853888191beddc215.name: Resend
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c407853888191beddc215.legacyDescriptionSource: Resend helps users send transactional email, inspect delivery and request logs, manage audiences, domains, templates, broadcasts, automations, webhooks, API keys, and OAuth grants from ChatGPT using their own Resend credentials.

plugin_asdk_app_69f63e01766881919640f03b.name: SentinelX
plugin_asdk_app_69f63e01766881919640f03b.legacyDescriptionSource:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.
Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and your OS's file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple hosts and label them however you want.
Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit config files, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.

translation.description:
SentinelX 可让您通过 ChatGPT 管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器——无需 SSH。在任意 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装小型开源代理，ChatGPT 即可执行检测命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件，并调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成服务。

所有操作均受您控制的每台主机允许列表约束。代理仅执行您明确声明安全的命令和服务，在代理边界拒绝所有策略外请求，同时您的操作系统文件权限仍作为额外保护层。您可以连接多台主机并按自定义方式标记它们。

With Sticklight, creators can build complete applications - including dashboards, client portals, internal tools, MVPs, marketing platforms, and interactive products - not just static sites. The result is a stable, flexible environment where professionals can move from idea to fully functional application while maintaining the precision, reliability, and creative control their work requires.

translation.description:
Sticklight是一款专为专业网页创作者设计的AI驱动构建工具，帮助他们更快打造真正的数字产品——同时不牺牲质量、控制或设计标准。您可以通过自然语言描述想要创建的内容，Sticklight将生成包含结构、界面和核心逻辑的可运行项目。创作者可在此基础上完善每个细节，手动编辑元素、调整布局与交互，并在需要时访问底层代码，从而确保对每个像素的完全掌控，维持作品所需的工艺水准。

对经验丰富的创作者而言，Sticklight的特殊价值在于能产出非通用化成果。平台不提供模板化输出，而是支持自定义设计决策和独特产品构思，同时保持开发加速优势。创作者可将AI辅助生成与自身专业技能结合，交付经过打磨的高质量体验，满足真实用户和流量的需求。

通过Sticklight，创作者可以构建完整应用程序——包括仪表盘、客户门户、内部工具、MVP、营销平台和交互式产品——而不仅仅是静态网站。这创造了一个稳定灵活的环境，使专业人士能从创意快速过渡到完整功能应用，同时保持对精度、可靠性及创作控制的严格要求。

plugin_asdk_app_6a64c90329cc8191bedca18a.name: Themely Design+Style Generator
plugin_asdk_app_6a64c90329cc8191bedca18a.description:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.

translation.description:
通过AI为应用程序、网站、仪表板、着陆页等创建精美设计主题。描述您的需求，探索不同视觉风格，对比不同创意方案，并在几秒钟内预览您的设计概念。无论您是从空白页面开始还是需要更新现有方案，此工具都能在无需高级设计技能的情况下，帮助您快速发现设计方向。

只需告诉ChatGPT您想打造什么。您可以请求移动应用、网站、在线商店、作品集、博客、仪表板、管理面板、营销页面或几乎任何数字产品。然后描述您想要的情感、目标受众、颜色或风格。AI会将您的想法转化为易于探索和优化的精致设计主题。

无需从头开始即可尝试多种不同风格。生成干净、现代、极简、有趣、暗色、多彩、高端、未来感、玻璃质感、柔和、大胆、优雅或创意主题。通过对比不同风格，找到最符合您项目、品牌或个人品味的方案。您对提示的微小调整就能产生新创意，帮助您以全新方式思考。

在投入时间设计或开发前预览您的创意。早期看到不同主题能更轻松地选择颜色、布局、排版、间距和整体视觉方向。您可以快速判断哪些方案可行，哪些需要调整，再进入设计或开发阶段。

该工具适用于设计师、开发者、创业者、学生、营销人员、创作者、广告公司及所有需要视觉灵感的人群。它可以帮您为企业网站、创业着陆页、移动应用、软件仪表板、电商平台、教育平台、作品集、旅游网站、金融应用、健康应用、效率工具、娱乐服务等探索创意。

当需要灵感、想突破创作瓶颈或单纯想看到新可能时使用。只需片刻就能生成大量设计方向，而非在无尽图库中搜索。探索符合您目标的创意并持续优化，直到找到喜爱的风格。

尝试色彩搭配、页面布局、界面风格、导航方式、按钮设计、卡片布局、表单设计、图标风格、内容板块、排版体系和视觉层级。可以要求受现代趋势或经典设计原则启发的主题。将不同创意混合，为您的项目打造独特方案。

AI能理解简单指令，因此无需专业设计术语。用日常语言描述您的项目。您可以详细说明或简要概括。要求修改方案、请求其他风格或继续探索，直到结果符合预期。每个新提示都能带来全新概念和意外灵感。

无论您是规划首个网站还是改进数以千计用户使用的产品，此工具都能让早期设计探索更快更简单。它帮助您发现主题、对比视觉方向，并在投入详细设计工作前建立信心。

非常适合头脑风暴、创意探索、产品规划、设计评审、客户演示、原型设计、概念开发和视觉灵感。借助ChatGPT将简单想法转化为吸引人的设计主题，探索多种可能性，找到最契合您项目的外观。

plugin_asdk_app_69cd66d6b11081919d55522e.name: Create State
plugin_asdk_app_69cd66d6b11081919d55522e.description: Create State gives ChatGPT persistent memory for your software projects. Save code snippets, architectural decisions, and debugging insights to a personal knowledge graph. Pick up exactly where you left off in future conversations.

translation.description: Create State 为 ChatGPT 提供软件项目所需的持久记忆功能。可将代码片段、架构决策和调试洞察保存至个人知识图谱，在未来的对话中准确接续之前的内容。

plugin_asdk_app_69c2a46272188191897a37e0.name: Adalo
plugin_asdk_app_69c2a46272188191897a37e0.description: Build and manage no-code apps entirely through conversation.  Adalo's ChatGPT integration lets you create, modify, and   manage mobile and web applications without ever leaving the    chat. Just describe what you want — Adalo's AI builds it   for you.

translation.summary: 构建和管理无代码应用
translation.description: 通过对话完全实现无代码应用的构建与管理。Adalo的ChatGPT集成让您能够在不离开聊天界面的情况下，创建、修改和管理移动及网络应用。只需描述你的需求——Adalo的AI会为你构建。

plugin_asdk_app_6a70eca71e948191aea49dbb.name: Context.dev
plugin_asdk_app_6a70eca71e948191aea49dbb.summary: Live web data for AI agents
plugin_asdk_app_6a70eca71e948191aea49dbb.legacySummaryOriginal: Live web data for AI agents
plugin_asdk_app_6a70eca71e948191aea49dbb.legacyDescriptionSource:

plugin_asdk_app_6a13a2500194819184429920.description: PageShare lets you share and protect HTML pages generated with ChatGPT. Publish new and update existing pages, control access with passwords or email rules, manage custom domains and tracking links, and review analytics for your sites.

plugin_asdk_app_6a16bcb9a37081919b0db1d8.name: Catalyst by Zoho

plugin_asdk_app_69ce0ee1b7a88191a223ce0a.name: 3Min API
plugin_asdk_app_69ce0ee1b7a88191a223ce0a.description: 3Min API lets you create REST APIs without writing backend code. Define a JSON schema, and get full CRUD endpoints with automatic webhook delivery, sandbox/production separation, real-time logs, and usage statistics. Manage everything through natural language — create endpoints, test API calls, search logs, invite collaborators, deploy to production, and generate ready-to-paste WordPress plugin snippets that render your endpoints on any WordPress page.

translation.description: 3Min API 使您无需编写后端代码即可创建REST API。定义JSON架构，即可获得包含自动网络钩子交付、沙箱/生产环境分离、实时日志和使用统计的全功能CRUD端点。通过自然语言管理所有功能——创建端点、测试API调用、搜索日志、邀请协作者、部署到生产环境，并生成可直接粘贴的WordPress插件代码片段，可在任何WordPress页面上渲染您的端点。

plugin_asdk_app_694ead37fc2881918277eca6.name: Hot100.ai
plugin_asdk_app_694ead37fc2881918277eca6.description: Hot100 lets you search and browse hundreds of AI projects, tools, and agents. Ranked weekly and tagged by stack, use case, and builder tools like Cursor & Replit. Find inspiration, explore what’s shipping, and stay on top of the AI ecosystem.

translation.description: Hot100允许您搜索和浏览数百个AI项目,工具和代理,每周排名并按堆栈,使用案例和构建工具标记,如Cursor & Replit。

plugin_asdk_app_6a28163c23d08191a73e6c15.name: WoWSQL
plugin_asdk_app_6a28163c23d08191a73e6c15.description: WoWSQL lets users manage their PostgreSQL database-as-a-service projects directly from ChatGPT. Users can list and inspect projects, browse database tables, execute SQL queries and statements, search platform documentation, read full doc pages, and list file storage buckets — all within their authenticated WoWSQL workspace.

translation.description: WoWSQL 允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 管理其 PostgreSQL 数据库即服务项目。用户可以列出并检查项目、浏览数据库表、执行 SQL 查询和语句、搜索平台文档、阅读完整文档页面以及列出文件存储桶——所有操作均在其已认证的 WoWSQL 工作区中完成。

plugin_asdk_app_6a64a3fb52e08191bc12c9bd.name: DNS Inspector
plugin_asdk_app_6a64a3fb52e08191bc12c9bd.description: DNS Inspector looks up the main DNS record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain and displays them in a clear, readable widget, with one-click refresh and copy-to-clipboard for each value.

translation.description: DNS Inspector 可针对任意域名即时查询主要DNS记录类型（A、AAAA、CNAME、MX、TXT、NS、SOA），并以清晰易读的组件展示结果，每个数值均支持一键刷新和复制功能。

plugin_asdk_app_698641f6925c81918cbc124d.name: Botpress
plugin_asdk_app_698641f6925c81918cbc124d.description:
The Complete AI Agent Platform

Botpress is an all-in-one platform for building AI agents powered by the latest LLMs. Use this application to rapidly prototype agents that can do FAQ, sales, support and so much more!

How it works:
1. Tag @Botpress in your chat and ask ChatGPT to create an agent with Botpress.
2. Iterate on design, business logic, information sources and more through natural language!
3. Once deployed, with the click of a button, you can open your agent in Botpress to access a comprehensive visual agent builder.

translation.description:
完整的AI代理平台

Botpress是基于最新大型语言模型的全功能AI代理开发平台，可通过该应用快速构建可执行常见问题解答、销售支持、客户服务等任务的AI代理！

工作原理：
1. 在聊天中@Botpress，并让ChatGPT使用Botpress创建一个代理。
2. 通过自然语言迭代设计、业务逻辑、信息来源等要素。
3. 部署完成后，点击按钮即可在Botpress中打开代理，使用全面的可视化代理构建工具。

plugin_asdk_app_6a566052cde08191bbb62f83.name: Outside Agent
plugin_asdk_app_6a566052cde08191bbb62f83.description: Outside Agent turns a plain-language brief into a hosted AI agent you can publish to SMS, voice, and web without leaving your coding agent. Describe what the agent should do and it composes the full configuration, grounds it in your own content, runs a safety review, and ships it. Create agents, seed a knowledge base, preview replies before publishing, issue a phone number, and manage everything you’ve built, all through natural conversation.

translation.description: 外部代理将简单的简介转化为托管的AI代理,您可以发布到SMS、语音和网络中,而不离开编码代理人。 描述代理人应该做什么,并组成完整的配置,在自己的内容中建立基础,运行安全审查,并发送它。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1cb1116f4881919bfa5e9a.name: Agent Ready
plugin_asdk_app_6a1cb1116f4881919bfa5e9a.description:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.

translation.description:
Agent Ready可检测任意网站对AI代理、助手和爬虫的可读性。输入一个网址，它将根据Vercel代理可读性规范、llms.txt标准以及新兴代理协议（MCP服务器卡片、A2A代理卡片、agents.json）扫描该网站，然后生成交互式评分卡：0-100分的代理可读性评分、llms.txt评分，以及按网站、页面、llms.txt和协议分类的逐项检查明细——每个未通过检查项都会配以通俗易懂的修复建议。

您可以使用它来查明AI工具无法读取您内容的原因，验证llms.txt和AGENTS.md文件，确认结构化数据和Markdown内容的一致性，并可随时重新扫描以确认修复效果。每个检测结果都会链接到agent-ready.dev上的完整可共享报告。免费使用，无需账户。

plugin_asdk_app_69f9215e800881919f3d96d7.name: Buildy
plugin_asdk_app_69f9215e800881919f3d96d7.description: Buildy is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Buildy gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.

translation.summary: 为代理打造的个人应用
translation.description: Buildy是个人网页应用的托管运行时，用户及其代理可以共享此类应用。代理创建应用后，Buildy会为其分配URL、后端服务和键值存储，用户可在ChatGPT、Claude及其他代理间持续使用同一应用和数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3bbf2f5a1c8191bd7c43ab.name: ArmorCodex
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bbf2f5a1c8191bd7c43ab.legacyDescriptionSource: ArmorCodex lets you read, update, and review the policies that govern how AI coding agents interact with tools, files, and infrastructure. plugin_asdk_app_6a3bbf2f5a1c8191bd7c43ab.description: ArmorCodex lets you read, update, and review the policies that govern how AI coding agents interact with tools, files, and infrastructure. translation.description: Alchemy帮助开发者通过ChatGPT检查EVM和Solana区块链数据，管理Alchemy应用和基础设施，查看使用情况，并配置网络钩子和Gas管理策略。

plugin_asdk_app_69d9214e90608191bb223a76.name: IcePanel
plugin_asdk_app_69d9214e90608191bb223a76.description:
IcePanel is a collaborative diagramming and modelling tool for software architecture. With IcePanel's MCP, bring your software architecture designs into ChatGPT and Codex.

Some cool things you can do with IcePanel's MCP:
- Understand the systems you're building and data flows
- Create model objects and keep them in sync with code
- Manage architecture decision records and ensure they align with what gets built in reality

translation.description:
IcePanel 是面向软件架构的协作型绘图和建模工具。通过 IcePanel 的 MCP，将您的软件架构设计带入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。

使用 IcePanel 的 MCP 可以实现以下功能：
- 理解您正在构建的系统和数据流
- 创建模型对象并保持与代码同步
- 管理架构决策记录并确保它们与实际构建的内容一致

plugin_asdk_app_6967f065ac9481918969c660.name: Statsig
plugin_asdk_app_6967f065ac9481918969c660.legacyDescriptionSource:
Bring your Statsig workspace into ChatGPT. Product builders can now explore, manage, and create Statsig experiments, feature gates, dynamic configs, and more directly in ChatGPT conversations.
Ask things like:
“Move this experiment to 50% rollout.”
“Turn on this feature gate for all users.”
“Show me which dynamic configs changed this week.”
"Explain how the DAU metric is defined.”

You can both read and write to Statsig: inspect experiment settings, read metric definitions, update allocations, toggle feature flags, edit targeting rules, and modify dynamic config values directly from ChatGPT.
The app connects through Statsig’s MCP server and honors your existing Statsig permissions, so you only see and change what you’re authorized to access—across projects, environments, and teams.

plugin_asdk_app_6a60e68db3908191b0af3727.name: MiroMiro
plugin_asdk_app_6a60e68db3908191b0af3727.description:
Extract design from any website

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from ChatGPT: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Everything comes from the site's real CSS and assets, not screenshots or guesses.

Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

What you can do:

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.

translation.description:
从任何网站提取设计

MiroMiro让你通过ChatGPT从任何实时网站中提取真实设计数据：品牌配色、字体、Logo、设计令牌、图片、SVG图像、Lottie动画，以及由实际页面区域重构的可直接使用的代码。所有数据均来自网站的真实CSS和资源，而非截图或猜测。

可用于匹配品牌风格、重建喜欢的页面区域或收集情绪板素材，直接将输出结果导入你的项目。

你能实现的功能包括：

- 从任意网址提取完整的品牌档案：带角色的色板、字体、Logo和favicon链接、社交资料及主题
- 以CSS变量或Tailwind配置形式提取网站的设计令牌系统（颜色、间距、圆角、阴影、排版）
- 将任意页面区域转换为带Tailwind类的干净React、Vue或HTML代码
- 列出网站加载的所有字体及其文件链接、格式和CSS堆栈以实现复现
- 收集所有SVG Logo和图标为可直接粘贴的代码及原始文件链接
- 按来源（img、srcset、picture、背景图、favicon、社交图片）分组整理页面图片资源并提供原始链接
- 找到页面中的Lottie动画并获取其JSON文件

适合需要从实时网站获取真实设计数据的开发者、设计师和AI构建者，而非仅凭肉眼观察。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.name: 60fps
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.legacyDescriptionSource:
60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so
you can build them.
Search in plain language, like "springy bottom sheet" or "pull to refresh with haptics", and get
back matching shots with the app, the gesture, and the motion vocabulary that describes them. Open
one for a frame by frame breakdown of the animation: what moves, in what order, with what timing
and easing. Where a bespoke recreation exists, you can pull compile-checked SwiftUI for it.

It answers the question a reference video cannot: not just what an interaction looks like, but what
it is actually doing.
Read only. It never writes anything and never acts on your behalf.

通过自然语言搜索，例如「弹性底部表单」或「带触感反馈的下拉刷新」，即可获得包含对应应用、操作手势以及描述其运动规律的动效术语的匹配片段。点击任一片段可查看逐帧分解的动画细节：显示对象、运动顺序、时间节奏及缓动方式。当存在定制化复现内容时，可直接获取经过编译检查的SwiftUI代码。

plugin_asdk_app_694e764297f08191a9370473.name: Agiflow
plugin_asdk_app_694e764297f08191a9370473.description: Agiflow is a shared project board for turning plans into trackable work. Create projects, break them into work units and tasks, set priorities and statuses, assign work, add comments and attachments, and review progress across your workspace. Use Agiflow to plan launches, organize backlogs, run standups, triage incoming work, and keep decisions connected to the tasks they affect. Changes are saved to your authenticated Agiflow workspace, where your team can review and continue the work.

translation.description: Agiflow是用于将计划转化为可跟踪工作的共享项目看板。创建项目，将其分解为工作单元和任务，设置优先级和状态，分配工作内容，添加评论和附件，并在您的工作区中审查进度。使用Agiflow可规划产品发布、管理待办事项清单、召开站会、处理待办工作以及确保决策与相关任务保持关联。所有更改都会保存至您的已认证Agiflow工作区，团队成员可随时查看并继续推进工作。

Includes the Aiven MCP Server for project, service, and database management, Kafka topics and connectors, PostgreSQL queries, integrations, and application deployment directly from your AI assistant.

plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3eaae26081918ee32782.name: Testifly
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3eaae26081918ee32782.legacyDescriptionSource:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup.
Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.
Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.
Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.

plugin_asdk_app_6a33ce728e488191a82df247.name: Sugra API
plugin_asdk_app_6a33ce728e488191a82df247.legacyDescriptionSource:
Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol.
The connector exposes a small, stable tool surface over the full Sugra catalog of more than 1,300 endpoints aggregating 130+ primary sources across data domains including markets, macroeconomics and central banks, corporate filings, public finance, trade flows, agriculture, climate and natural events, maritime activity, prediction markets, global news, network intelligence, and entity screening.
Main workflows: discover endpoints by natural-language search and inspect their schemas, run a one-step find-and-call to retrieve data, pull macroeconomic series and central-bank rates, fetch market prices, history and fundamentals through Sugra Finance, screen a person or organization name against sanctions corpora, resolve free text to a canonical entity, and compose a normalized current view or bounded timeseries for an entity with freshness and provenance.
Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI model families and any MCP-enabled client. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.

plugin_asdk_app_6a61e9d605448191a80c63f0.name: ProductOS
plugin_asdk_app_6a61e9d605448191a80c63f0.description: ProductOS is a remote-first, AI-native development platform. Connect ChatGPT to your entire cloud workspace with no local clone needed. Create and manage projects, boot isolated cloud sandboxes with live preview URLs, read and write files, run a full shell (npm, git, node), provision Postgres databases and S3 storage, and trigger production deploys. Every file change auto-syncs to GitHub. Perfect for rapid prototyping, full-stack development, and team collaboration directly from chat.

translation.description: ProductOS 是一个以远程优先、原生AI支持的开发平台。无需本地克隆即可将ChatGPT连接到整个云工作区。创建和管理项目，启动隔离的云沙盒并获取实时预览网址，读写文件，运行完整终端（npm、git、node），配置Postgres数据库和S3存储，并触发生产环境部署。每次文件更改都会自动同步到GitHub。适用于从聊天界面直接进行的快速原型设计、全栈开发和团队协作。

plugin_asdk_app_69932d93c9088191a2574842.name: microfn
plugin_asdk_app_69932d93c9088191a2574842.description:
microfn is a sandboxed cloud environment for building, deploying, and running tiny JavaScript functions - designed to be AI-friendly. Give ChatGPT its own workspace to write functions, deploy them, manage their code and secrets, and run the functions you've already built.

With microfn, ChatGPT can:

- Write and deploy a new JavaScript function on request
- Inspect, update, and validate the code of existing functions
- Manage function settings and secrets securely
- Run your functions and use their results in the conversation

Each function runs in an isolated sandbox, so ChatGPT can safely create and compose its own tools - fetch a weather API, build a key-value store, post to Slack, send a Telegram message, and much more.

translation.description:
microfn是一个沙箱化云环境，用于构建、部署和运行微型JavaScript函数，专为AI友好设计。为ChatGPT提供专属工作空间，可编写函数、部署函数、管理代码和密钥，并运行已构建的函数。

通过microfn，ChatGPT可以：

- 按需编写并部署新的JavaScript函数
- 检查、更新并验证现有函数的代码
- 安全管理函数设置和密钥
- 运行你的函数并在对话中使用其结果

每个函数都在隔离的沙箱中运行，因此ChatGPT可以安全地创建和组合自己的工具——获取天气API数据、构建键值存储、向Slack发送消息、向Telegram发送信息等更多功能。

plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.name: Git Diff Patcher Bridge

plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.description: Git Diff Patcher Bridge connects ChatGPT to GDP through a privacy-bounded MCP endpoint. translation.description: Git Diff Patcher Bridge通过隐私保护的MCP端点将ChatGPT与GDP连接。它可以检查选定的仓库上下文，诊断补丁，读取本地验证证据，协调持久化的开发状态，分类重启需求，生成关联证据的私有Wire草案，并创建可审查的本地请求。托管连接器不会直接应用补丁、执行任意shell命令、强制推送代码、发布公共内容或绕过GDP Desktop权限。所有涉及仓库变更的操作仍需经过GDP Desktop的审查和本地执行边界限制。该连接器还支持预配置的演示工作区，供零安装的评审人员和用户评估。

plugin_asdk_app_6a60c62613808191b41e39b4.description: DNS Doctor (https://dnsdoctor.dev) — DMARC monitoring plus SPF, DKIM and DMARC diagnostics for any domain. Scan email authentication, find SPF lookup-limit problems, check DKIM and DMARC, generate validated DMARC records, monitor DMARC RUA reports and new senders, and move from p=none to quarantine on a scan's evidence and to reject on report evidence. Free domain scans and a free monitoring trial. Every DNS change is human-approved. translation.description: DNS Doctor (https://dnsdoctor.dev) — 提供DMARC监控功能，为任何域名提供SPF、DKIM和DMARC诊断服务。可扫描电子邮件认证情况，发现SPF查找限制问题，检查DKIM和DMARC，生成验证过的DMARC记录，监控DMARC RUA报告和新发件人，并根据扫描结果将策略从p=none调整为隔离，或根据报告证据调整为拒绝。提供免费域名扫描和免费监控试用。每次DNS更改均需人工批准。修复记录通过确定性算法生成并经过RFC验证，不会由AI猜测；SPF会进行诊断而非直接重写。包含二十个工具：扫描域名（SPF、DKIM、DMARC、MX、DNS健康状况、黑名单、域名和TLS到期情况）、查看存储的报告、查询域名注册信息（注册商、到期时间、DNS服务器、锁定状态）、构建验证过的DMARC升级方案或从零开始创建DMARC记录、验证粘贴的DMARC记录、统计SPF查找次数、审计SPF包含项、检查DKIM选择器、在域名自有DNS服务器上检查记录、从六个不同位置检查全球传播情况、检查反向DNS、解析DMARC汇总报告、为非发件域名构建加固包、向域名所有者提供监控注册链接，并为已登录操作员显示监控警报日志和执行就绪评估。三个账户工具可添加域名至监控、运行所有权验证并查看待发布记录；目前它们会向所有者提供相同的注册链接。助手不会自动登录用户、代为发送邮件或应用DNS更改：它仅解释检测结果，并将每条记录呈现给人类用户进行发布。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6d31df2f848191acf2daa6.name: Sitelemetry
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d31df2f848191acf2daa6.description: Sitelemetry audits websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, accessibility, and performance. It returns prioritized findings with evidence, impact, and concrete remediation guidance. Public, non-intrusive checks can assess public websites; protected security modules and full audits require a verified Sitelemetry project. Connections use OAuth with PKCE, and private-network targets are blocked. A Sitelemetry account is required; available audits and usage limits reflect the access already assigned to the connected account.

translation.description: Sitelemetry 从安全、技术SEO、AI可见性、分析和跟踪集成、可访问性以及性能等方面对网站进行审计。它会返回带有证据、影响及具体修复指导的优先级发现结果。公开的、非侵入性检查可评估公开网站；受保护的安全模块和完整审计需要经过验证的Sitelemetry项目。连接采用带有PKCE的OAuth协议，私有网络目标将被阻止。需要Sitelemetry账户；可用的审计和使用限制反映已分配给连接账户的权限。

plugin_asdk_app_6a79de2b746881918127ddf4.description:

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a7c2760248191a8c61bb2.description:
Graffiticode lets AI agents perform verified, task-specific operations instead of making unrestricted API calls. By using formal task languages to validate inputs, enforce capabilities, and produce structured artifacts, Graffiticode helps developers expose their services to AI agents with greater control, reliability, and predictable results.

Explore the growing catalog of Graffiticode languages for common tasks, or create your own language to expose your application's unique capabilities to AI agents through a verified, task-specific interface.

translation.description:
Graffiticode让AI代理执行经过验证的任务特定操作，而非进行无限制的API调用。通过使用形式化任务语言验证输入、强制执行功能并生成结构化成果，Graffiticode帮助开发者以更高控制度、可靠性和可预测性向AI代理暴露服务。

探索不断增长的Graffiticode语言目录中针对常见任务的方案，或创建专属语言通过经过验证的任务特定接口，向AI代理暴露应用程序的独特能力。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2b771cfb288191a4e53af3.name: Mnemom
plugin_asdk_app_6a2b771cfb288191a4e53af3.description: Mnemom is trust infrastructure built for agents, not just the humans who run them. In one chat you can look up an agent's Continuous Trust Rating — the score, the grade, and the accountability evidence behind it — and confirm it's cryptographically signed, not merely asserted. Drop your own alignment card and get an instant trust read back; claim a verifiable identity with no human in the loop; and walk away with an embeddable Trust Rating badge for your README or agent card. Every read is honest about what it knows: a quiet record reads as quiet, never as a red flag. The system tells the truth — and view-source proves it.

translation.description: Mnemom 是为代理人而建造的信任基础设施,而不仅仅是运行它们的人类。在一个聊天中,你可以搜索代理人的持续信任评级 - 其背后的分数,分数和责任证明 - 并确认它是加密签名的,而不仅仅是声称的。放下自己的对立卡,并获得即时信任读取;声称可验证的身份,没有人在循环中;并带着可嵌入的信任评级标签为您的 README 或代理卡。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6f945292888191a7d77db4.name: @imqueue
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f945292888191a7d77db4.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery").
Results carry page URLs, and get_doc returns any page as plain markdown for
reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All six tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and no
storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a service name. Nothing is
retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

translation.summary: 搜索文档，生成代码框架
translation.description:
@imqueue 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架，用于构建通过消息队列而非 HTTP 通信的微服务——您只需编写一个类，用装饰器标记需要发布的方法，调用方将获得从运行中的服务生成的完整类型客户端。

该服务器让您的助手直接掌握其知识，因此能生成真实的 @imqueue 代码，而非看似合理的代码。

search_docs 覆盖指南、教程、CLI 手册、文章以及所有 @imqueue 包的导出符号（包含 API 参考）——您可以用自然语言提问（“如何暴露服务方法？”）或查找具体签名（“RedisQueue.send”，“IMQOptions.safeDelivery”）。结果包含页面链接，get_doc 可返回任意页面的纯文本 markdown 格式以便阅读和引用。list_packages 返回当前包目录及安装命令，这正是助手选择正确包而非猜测名称的方式。当两个包覆盖相同领域（如追踪或数据库层）时，结果会附带选择规则，因为同时安装两者会静默失败而非报错。

scaffold_service 会根据您描述的方法签名生成符合规范的服务——包含 @expose() 装饰器的 JSDoc 类型方法的 IMQService 子类，以及启动它的引导代码。自定义返回类型会携带生成该类型所需的 @classType() 和 @property() 装饰器，这很重要，因为缺少这些装饰器的字段在生成的客户端中会被视为 any 类型但仍能编译通过。scaffold_client 展示如何生成和使用服务的类型客户端。两者均返回可审查和粘贴的源代码文本；均不会写入文件。

所有六个工具均为只读模式。该服务器不涉及账户、认证或存储：每个请求均无状态处理，它唯一可见的数据是您发送的参数——搜索查询、文档 URL 或服务名称。所有数据不会被保留，且不会收集或使用任何对话内容进行训练。

那些需要操作您本地机器的工具——如运行 imq CLI、在磁盘上创建项目、启动/停止服务、读取日志——被刻意排除在该服务器之外，因为托管服务器无法访问您的机器，也不应声称可以。这些功能包含在本地安装中（npx -y @imqueue/mcp），而 local_install_guide 返回其安装步骤。

translation.description: NORMS评估经批准的规范性记录是否具备足够的验证依据以支持声明目的。它将检查明确授权、时间适用性、范围、验证情况、条款分割及结构化条件，并报告存在的障碍、未知领域和未核查区域。缺失或未验证的必要依据将导致失败。NORMS不提供法律建议、合规认证、PDF或文档解析、法律检索、从自由文本推断规范性条件、合同审批或外部数据修改。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.name: SiteTriage
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.summary: Find out why a site is broken
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.legacySummaryOriginal: Find out why a site is broken
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.description: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry. It then returns the most likely root cause, ranked, with concrete fix steps — instead of guesses. Ideal for the deploy moment: apex-vs-www misconfigurations, stale DNS after a host migration, propagation lag, certificate errors, redirect loops, and emails landing in spam. Stateless and anonymous: no accounts, no stored data.

translation.description: 您的网站突然无法访问——请SiteTriage帮您找出原因。输入一个URL或域名，它将从网络边缘执行实时只读诊断：DNS解析与传播情况、服务器当前展示的完整TLS证书（包括TLS 1.3）、HTTP状态码和重定向链、邮件认证机制（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）、域名注册信息及到期情况。随后会返回最可能的故障原因列表，并附上具体解决步骤——彻底告别猜测。特别适合部署时刻使用：域名解析配置错误（主域名与www子域名混淆）、迁移主机后的残留DNS记录、传播延迟、证书错误、重定向循环以及邮件被误判为垃圾邮件等问题。无状态且完全匿名：无需账户，不存储任何数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a651de7b82c8191bc3480f1.description:
The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

The MCP server exposes structured tools that allow AI assistants to understand, author, validate, and work with Opscotch applications and workflows.

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

An AI connected to the server can perform tasks such as:
- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch

translation.description:
Opscotch MCP服务器为AI助手提供对Opscotch知识库和创作工具的直接访问权限。

MCP服务器提供结构化工具，使AI助手能够理解、创作、验证并处理Opscotch应用程序和工作流。

该服务器专为使用AI编码助手的开发者，以及希望通过自然语言构建或维护Opscotch解决方案的自动化工程师设计。

连接到服务器的AI可以执行以下任务：
- 回答关于Opscotch平台的问题
- 解释API、配置和运行时行为

- 验证工作流结构和配置

通过MCP，AI可以使用专为理解Opscotch平台而设计的工具，从而获得以下结果：

- 更精确的响应
- 了解当前平台功能
- 具备结构化创作能力而非单纯生成文本

典型使用场景
- "创建一个每分钟轮询HTTP端点的工作流。"

超越基础的在线存在感。通过ZyberSpace，本地企业可以快速创建服务页面、落地页、获客网站、作品集、餐厅页面、美发沙龙网站、承包商网站和吸引客户的中小企业网站。

内置网站功能包括：

- AI生成的网站文案和布局
- 主机服务和公开网站链接
- 移动端适配页面
- 联系与报价请求表单
- SEO优化的业务页面
- 自定义域名
- SSL安全网站
- 面向本地企业类别的模板市场
- 简单的编辑与重新发布功能

自信地启动并持续优化。ZyberSpace帮助企业在不需设计师或开发人员的情况下，快速更新内容、优化页面、发布更改，始终保持专业网站形象。

无需任何设置。无需编程、无需配置主机、无需复杂工具、无需技术配置。只需描述您的业务，自定义网站内容并发布即可。

plugin_asdk_app_6a84930f6168819198fa552e.name: DocRunic
plugin_asdk_app_6a84930f6168819198fa552e.description:
Connect DocRunic to ChatGPT to work with documentation in your authorized workspaces. Search and browse pages, read current content and version history, inspect page structures and attachment metadata, create or update drafts, and publish documentation when requested.

Access is protected by DocRunic OAuth and follows the workspace access, role, and scopes granted to the connection. The plugin does not expose tools for deleting or archiving pages.

translation.description:
将DocRunic连接至ChatGPT，在授权的工作空间中处理文档。支持搜索浏览页面、阅读当前内容与版本历史、检查页面结构及附件元数据、创建或更新草稿，并在需要时发布文档。

访问权限由DocRunic OAuth保护，遵循连接所获的工作区访问权限、角色和作用域。该插件不提供删除或归档页面的工具。

plugin_asdk_app_6a684cf455908191a0aa7efe.name: IDrive e2
plugin_asdk_app_6a684cf455908191a0aa7efe.description: Connect your IDrive e2 account to browse regions, manage buckets and objects, configure lifecycle and Object Lock settings, and generate presigned links using natural-language prompts.

translation.description: 通过自然语言提示连接您的IDrive e2账户，浏览区域、管理存储桶和对象、配置生命周期及对象锁定设置，并生成预签名链接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7eac0f20c081918f11ac22.name: Camber
plugin_asdk_app_6a7eac0f20c081918f11ac22.description: Camber lets users manage accounts and workspaces, discover or create agents, and launch and monitor agent runs directly within ChatGPT.

translation.description: Camber允许用户在ChatGPT内部直接管理账户和工作区、发现或创建代理，并启动和监控代理运行。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6a699e6f3481918d5e6034.name: NPMScan
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a699e6f3481918d5e6034.description: Look up npm package metadata, known vulnerabilities, and CVE details directly from a conversation. NPMScan's MCP server gives AI agents read-only tools backed by the npm registry, OSV.dev, GitHub Security Advisories, GitHub's own API, and the NIST National Vulnerability Database: search packages by name or keyword with download counts, dependent-package counts, and typosquat detection on every result; inspect a package's install scripts, maintainers, license, GitHub stars, and download trend before installing, or compare 2-5 candidates side-by-side with a deterministic pick; check an exact version pinned in a lockfile, or simulate upgrading one before running npm install to see if it's a safe patch or a likely-breaking major bump; query vulnerabilities for one package or up to 100 at once, each finding enriched with severity, a summary, CVE aliases, and the fixed version rather than a bare advisory ID; audit an entire GitHub repository's dependencies (including monorepo workspaces) in one call, or generate a spec-valid CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM with vulnerability and license data embedded; rank the findings from a raw `npm audit --json` report by CISA KEV/FIRST EPSS exploitation data to know what to fix first, then pull the concrete, ordered remediation playbook for a flagged finding; check an npm maintainer account's publish history for a compromised-account-style cluster, or pull their basic profile; browse the latest npm advisories from either GitHub's curated, mostly CVE-backed reviewed set or its known-malicious-package malware feed, filterable by severity, vulnerability category (XSS, SQL/NoSQL Injection, SSRF, Access Control, Code Injection, and 15 more, reviewed only), affected package, or an exact GHSA/CVE ID; and look up authoritative CVSS/CWE data for any CVE across any ecosystem, enriched with CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities status and FIRST.org's EPSS exploitation-probability score. No API key or authentication is required, and every result links back to the full write-up on npmscan.com.

translation.description: 直接通过对话查询npm包元数据、已知漏洞和CVE详情。NPMScan的MCP服务器为AI代理提供只读工具，这些工具依托于npm注册表、OSV.dev、GitHub安全公告、GitHub自身API以及NIST国家漏洞数据库：可通过包名或关键词搜索，结果包含下载量、依赖包数量及拼写错误检测；查看包的安装脚本、维护者、许可证、GitHub星标和下载趋势后再安装，或通过确定性选择并排比较2-5个候选包；检查锁文件中精确版本或模拟升级前的版本，查看是否为安全补丁或可能引发中断的主版本更新；一次查询单个包或最多100个包的漏洞信息，每个发现均包含严重程度、摘要、CVE别名和修复版本而非原始公告ID；一次审计整个GitHub仓库的依赖关系（包括单仓库工作区），或生成包含漏洞和许可证数据的符合规范的CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM；根据CISA KEV/FIRST EPSS利用数据对原始npm audit --json报告中的发现进行排序，确定优先修复项，然后获取被标记发现的具体修复方案；检查npm维护者账户的发布记录是否存在账户被入侵式集群，或获取其基础资料；浏览来自GitHub精选的、主要基于CVE审核的公告或其已知恶意包恶意软件源，可按严重程度、漏洞类别（XSS、SQL/NoSQL注入、SSRF、访问控制、代码注入等15种以上类别，仅审核）、受影响包或具体GHSA/CVE ID过滤；查询任何CVE的权威CVSS/CWE数据，包含CISA已知利用漏洞状态和FIRST.org的EPSS利用概率评分。无需API密钥或身份验证，每个结果都会链接到npmscan.com上的完整文章。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58a845f88191860e59f4.name: BasicDeploy
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58a845f88191860e59f4.description:
BasicDeploy lets your assistant create a live container for a web app, deploy code to it, and manage it — all from the chat. Each app comes with a PostgreSQL database, S3-compatible object storage, environment variables, and a public HTTPS URL, set up automatically.

Through the connector, the assistant can create containers, deploy a project, run shell commands, and read logs. You can also add hosted sign-up and login to the apps you build over standard OpenID Connect, so your app gets its own users without writing an auth system. You sign in once with your BasicDeploy account — no API key to paste. Pricing is a flat monthly rate that includes the database, storage, bandwidth, and URL.

translation.description:
BasicDeploy让你的助手能够为网络应用创建实时容器，向其中部署代码并进行管理——所有操作均可通过聊天完成。每个应用均自动配置PostgreSQL数据库、兼容S3的对象存储、环境变量以及公共HTTPS网址。

通过连接器，助手可以创建容器、部署项目、运行shell命令并查看日志。你还可以通过标准OpenID Connect为所构建的应用添加托管注册和登录功能，这样你的应用即可拥有独立用户体系而无需自行开发认证系统。使用BasicDeploy账户一键登录即可——无需粘贴API密钥。定价采用固定月费制，包含数据库、存储空间、流量和网址费用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a701565da608191a54c7b91.name: PR Readiness Check
plugin_asdk_app_6a701565da608191a54c7b91.legacySummary: 检查 PR 就绪状态
plugin_asdk_app_6a701565da608191a54c7b91.description: Analyzes supplied pull request materials for change evidence, requirement alignment, testing, risks, rollback, and readiness for human review. It does not access repositories, run tests, approve, or merge pull requests.

translation.description: 分析提供的拉取请求材料中的变更证据、需求对齐性、测试情况、风险、回滚方案以及人工评审就绪状态。该工具不访问代码仓库、不运行测试、不批准或合并拉取请求。

plugin_asdk_app_6a48cb6545e4819192d92ee3.name: Prism by Crossdeck
plugin_asdk_app_6a48cb6545e4819192d92ee3.legacyDescriptionSource:
Prism reads your live Crossdeck workspace — revenue, entitlements, errors, analytics, read-cost and customer identity — joined BY IDENTITY, so it answers cross-layer questions no single-layer tool can: which paying customers an error hit and what they pay, who costs the most in database reads, and your lifetime-value leaderboard by name.
Secure and read-only: OAuth 2.0 sign-in (no key to paste), no write path, and every number is self-describing (it reports 'not instrumented' rather than a fake zero for an un-wired surface).
plugin_asdk_app_6a48cb6545e4819192d92ee3.description: Prism reads your live Crossdeck workspace — revenue, entitlements, errors, analytics, read-cost and customer identity — joined BY IDENTITY, so it answers cross-layer questions no single-layer tool can: which paying customers an error hit and what they pay, who costs the most in database reads, and your lifetime-value leaderboard by name. Secure and read-only: OAuth 2.0 sign-in (no key to paste), no write path, and every number is self-describing (it reports 'not instrumented' rather than a fake zero for an un-wired surface).

translation.description: Prism 读取了通过 IDENTITY 连接您的实时 Crossdeck 工作空间 - 收入、权利、错误、分析、阅读成本和客户身份,因此它可以回答任何单层工具的跨层问题:支付客户的错误和他们付出的代价,数据库中最昂贵的读取,以及您的终身价值的名称。

plugin_asdk_app_6a68b368b8588191afee9a7e.name: mittwald
plugin_asdk_app_6a68b368b8588191afee9a7e.description: Manage your mittwald (mStudio) hosting infrastructure from ChatGPT. List and inspect projects, apps, servers and domains; provision and manage MySQL and Redis databases, users, backups and backup schedules; work with containers, stacks, cron jobs and volumes; configure domains, DNS zones, virtual hosts, SSL certificates and mail addresses; manage organization and project members, SSH users and keys, and API tokens. Read-only tools inspect resources, while write tools create, update or remove them on the authenticated user's behalf.

translation.description: 从ChatGPT管理您的mittwald（mStudio）托管基础设施。列出并检查项目、应用、服务器和域名；配置和管理MySQL及Redis数据库、用户、备份及备份计划；操作容器、堆栈、定时任务和卷；配置域名、DNS区域、虚拟主机、SSL证书和邮件地址；管理组织及项目成员、SSH用户和密钥、API令牌。只读工具用于检查资源，而写入工具则代表已认证用户创建、更新或删除资源。

plugin_asdk_app_6a79985b0ef881918e389c82.name: Flyte
plugin_asdk_app_6a79985b0ef881918e389c82.description: Author, run, and deploy Flyte 2 workflows, apps, and agents with skills grounded in the Flyte SDK and documentation. In ChatGPT web, search Flyte docs and SDK examples. In a local ChatGPT environment with the Flyte CLI configured, run and manage your authenticated Flyte cluster.

translation.summary: 作者, 迁移, 运行, 调试
translation.description: 创建、运行和部署 Flyte 2 工作流程、应用程序和代理,并具备在 Flyte SDK 和文档中建立的技能。在 ChatGPT 网站上,搜索 Flyte 文档和 SDK 示例。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8f6c526c5481918eb8a488.name: Lumen UI
plugin_asdk_app_6a8f6c526c5481918eb8a488.description: Lumen UI helps coding agents build accessible interfaces from a real multi-framework design-system contract. Search the component catalog, retrieve framework-specific usage and source, inspect web and native recipes, read semantic tokens, and follow the bundled Lumen workflow for Astro, React, Web Components, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose.

translation.summary: 使用 Lumen 构建接口
translation.description: Lumen UI有助于编码代理从真正的多框架设计系统合同中构建可访问的接口. 搜索组件目录,检索框架特定的使用和源,检查Web和原生食谱,阅读语义代码,并跟踪Bundled Lumen工作流程为Astro,React,Web Components,React Native,SwiftUI和Jetpack Compose。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3da23321a88191914164e9.name: Resolve AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a3da23321a88191914164e9.description:
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.

translation.description: 连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 来解决 AI. 启动和控制调查,拉动实时生产背景,并将根因发现转化为拉动请求。 Resolve 插件连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 来解决 AI 通过 MCP。 Resolve 的代理人加入您的呼叫旋转来分类和调查警报,并与工程师一起更快地达到根因原因; 这个插件将该表面直接带入您的编码代理,以便您可以在您已经编码的地方采取行动。 它安装了列表和过滤警报的技能,阅读和总结调查,开始新的根因分析,询问后续问题,指导与您在本地的背景下进行积极调查,在风险变更之前拉动区域的生产资料,并将结果翻译成本地代码变更和PR。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.name: HTML/CSS to Image API
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.legacySummary: 将 HTML 渲染为图片
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.legacyDescriptionSource:
The HTML/CSS to Image MCP server lets AI assistants create production-ready images, website screenshots, and PDFs through natural-language instructions.

Use it to:
  * Render HTML and CSS into PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF
  * Capture screenshots of public URLs
  * Generate images from reusable templates and variables
  * Create batches of multiple image variations
  * Create, update, list, and version image templates
  * Configure viewport size, device scale, selectors, render delays, and other rendering options
