translation.summary: HTML 到 图像 & URL 屏幕截图
translation.description:
HTML/CSS to Image MCP 服务器允许 AI 助手通过自然语言指令创建生产准备的图像、网站屏幕截图和 PDF。

用它来:

- 将HTML和CSS转换为PNG、JPG、WebP或PDF - 捕捉公共URL的屏幕截图 - 通过可重复使用的模板和变量生成图像 - 创建多个图像变异的批量 - 创建、更新、列表和版本图像模板 - 配置视图端口大小、设备规模、选择器、渲染延迟和其他渲染选项

plugin_asdk_app_6a7aeed8884c8191b86ac870.name: HOME AI Node
plugin_asdk_app_6a7aeed8884c8191b86ac870.description: HOME AI Node lets ChatGPT inspect the health, runtime state, and tracked tasks of a HOME AI node. get_node_status reports whether a node is online and its repository state, get_runtime_state shows the runtime mode and MCP protocol, and get_task_status queries task progress. In this phase the server is backed by a deterministic synthetic review fixture (node review-demo-node) so reviewers can exercise every tool without any private network access; connection to a real HOME AI node is a later phase behind an authorized-user boundary (OAuth). All operations are strictly read-only: nothing on this server can write, execute, or reach any private network.

translation.description: HOME AI Node 允许 ChatGPT 检查 HOME AI 节点的健康、运行状态和追踪任务. get_node_status 报告节点是否在线及其存储状态, get_runtime_state 显示了运行模式和 MCP 协议,以及 get_task_status 查询了任务进度。在此阶段,服务器受到了确定性合成审查固定(节点审查 - 演示节点)的支持,因此审查员可以使用每个工具而无需任何私人网络访问;连接到真正的 HOME AI 节点是授权用户边界(OAuth)背后的后一个阶段。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8dddd50424819196928510.name: Knock
plugin_asdk_app_6a8dddd50424819196928510.legacyDescriptionSource:
Knock is agent-first customer engagement infrastructure for your product, marketing, and transactional messaging. One platform to manage all your messaging across email, SMS, push, chat, and in-app.

Inspect workflows and manage notifications, directly in ChatGPT and Codex.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8dddd50424819196928510.description:
Knock is agent-first customer engagement infrastructure for your product, marketing, and transactional messaging. One platform to manage all your messaging across email, SMS, push, chat, and in-app.

Inspect workflows and manage notifications, directly in ChatGPT and Codex.

translation.summary: 通过频道传达用户信息
translation.description:
Knock 是您产品、营销和交易消息的代理第一客户互动基础设施. 一个平台来管理您在电子邮件、短信、推送、聊天和应用中的所有消息。

检查工作流程和管理通知,直接在ChatGPT和Codex中。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4d8a8bafb48191a99b4a58.name: Suger
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d8a8bafb48191a99b4a58.description: Suger helps marketplace teams work with cloud marketplace, CRM, co-sell, integration, billing, and knowledge data in ChatGPT. Users can look up offers, buyers, entitlements, referrals, integrations, workflow runs, CRM records, and support knowledge, and perform enabled actions through their connected Suger organization.

translation.description: Suger 帮助市场团队在 ChatGPT 中使用云市场、CRM、共同销售、集成、发票和知识数据工作,用户可以搜索报价、购买者、权限、引用、集成、工作流程、CRM 记录和支持知识,并通过其连接的 Suger 组织执行启用操作。

plugin_asdk_app_6a844531edb881918d6aefb4.name: Uizze
plugin_asdk_app_6a844531edb881918d6aefb4.legacyDescriptionSource:
Uizze gives coding agents a free anti-ui-slop Skill and optional full MCP access to live UI references, license-clear materials, and rendered safety checks. Use the skill to inspect the product and design system, write a design contract, cover required states, and run a bounded finish gate.
The MCP answers one concrete unresolved UI question with strong full-screen references, finds license-clear materials for a concrete role, or optionally checks rendered UI for observable breakage, accessibility, privacy, and task-blocking composition. The free preview MCP exposes a deterministic source check only.
plugin_asdk_app_6a844531edb881918d6aefb4.description: Uizze gives coding agents a free anti-ui-slop Skill and optional full MCP access to live UI references, license-clear materials, and rendered safety checks. Use the skill to inspect the product and design system, write a design contract, cover required states, and run a bounded finish gate. The MCP answers one concrete unresolved UI question with strong full-screen references, finds license-clear materials for a concrete role, or optionally checks rendered UI for observable breakage, accessibility, privacy, and task-blocking composition. The free preview MCP exposes a deterministic source check only.

translation.description: Uizze为编码代理提供免费的反ui-slop 技能和可选的完整 MCP 访问权限,以实时 UI 参考、许可证清晰材料和渲染安全检查。使用该技能来检查产品和设计系统,撰写设计合同,覆盖所需状态,并运行有限的终端门口。MCP 用强大的全屏引用来回答一个具体未解决的 UI 问题,为具体角色找到许可证清晰的材料,或者可选地检查渲染的 UI 可观察破坏、可访问性、隐私和任务阻止组成。

plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.name: TALON Knowledge
plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.description:
A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence. Typical uses include feature design consultation, configuration value lookups, error-cause investigation, browsing similar real-world examples, and automated validation of generated settings.

A TALON maintenance contract and a TALON support site (Zendesk) account are required. Users authenticate by signing in to the support site when connecting. All tools are read-only, and users' conversation content, code, and attachments are never sent to our servers (details: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy).

translation.summary: 搜索 TALON 手册, Q&A
translation.description:
该连接器允许AI代理商搜索TALON的官方知识库,这是一个低代码的商业应用程序构建平台,它搜索了数千页的官方手册,支持Q&A,拥有900多个真实世界函数配置示例和规格分析的数据库,并以源URL作为证据返回答案。

需要TALON维护合同和TALON支持站点(Zendesk)帐户。用户在连接时通过登录到支持站点进行身份验证。所有工具只能读取,用户的对话内容、代码和附件永远不会发送到我们的服务器(详细信息: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy)。

plugin_asdk_app_697b9bc5cdac819188635d02.name: Craftian
plugin_asdk_app_697b9bc5cdac819188635d02.description:
Create fully working business software and web apps from a prompt. With Craftian you can create CRMs, task managers, inventory systems, expense trackers, time trackers, job portals, on-boarding portals, data forms etc.

Craftian creates production-ready web apps with built-in database, authentication, role-based access control, file storage, and automatic cloud deployment.

No coding experience required. Just describe what you want, and keep refining it.

translation.summary: 创建功能齐全的Web应用程序

plugin_asdk_app_69c1a1df6f6481918f7c67e9.description:

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.

Sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT can search and hydrate your org context so you do not repeat who you are, what the project is, or what you already decided.

What you can do:
• Look up a specific fact about your company, a past decision, or a current task.
• Ask a synthesis question across decisions, notes, and related records.

Connect GitHub, email, and other tools through Bitsweave brokers when you enable them. Claude calls Bitsweave. Bitsweave uses the permissions you granted. The agent does not hold the upstream credentials.

Sign-in is required. The connector URL is https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp.

Setup: add Bitsweave, complete the OAuth sign-in, then ask ChatGPT to search your context or create a record. Public docs: https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents

plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.name: MCP Conduct Register
plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.description:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.

translation.description:
此插件暴露了 MCP 服务器的测量行为的公共记录。

在一个时间表上测量五个条件:服务器说MCP,它发布A2A代理卡,它宣布谁支付它,相同的输入返回相同的输出,而判决本身可以由第三方重新计算。

该注册表不评级服务器. 它不建议一个服务器超过另一个服务器. 它返回了被测量的值,当它被测量时,以及记录的 SHA-256 以便读取可以由不信任发行者的某人检查。

一个缺席的终点从来没有在这里被测量过,缺席被报告为缺席,而不是负面判决。

确定性不会被测量,除非被检查的服务器的所有者已经记录了同意,因为测量它需要在别人的服务器上执行工具。

免费,只读,没有帐户和没有密钥. 该注册表是没有编辑步骤的日程脚本的构建文物,并以 DOI 进行档案,以便引用能够存活存储器的移动。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.name: BranchDeploy
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.legacyDescriptionSource:
BranchDeploy connects ChatGPT to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.

Preview a work item deployment, confirm the resolved ticket, branch, environment and pipeline, then queue the deployment only if BranchDeploy’s server-side rules allow it.
BranchDeploy does not let ChatGPT deploy arbitrary code. It resolves linked Azure Repos branches and pull requests from the work item, checks the configured environment and branch rules, and requires explicit confirmation before a deployment starts.

Use it to:
  * Preview what branch and environment a work item will deploy to
  * Confirm the deployment before anything runs
  * Queue your existing Azure Pipeline
  * Check deployment status
  * View recent deployment history
  * List configured deployment environments

BranchDeploy wraps your existing Azure Pipeline setup. No YAML changes are required, and deployment safety is enforced server-side using your configured project, environment and branch rules.

plugin_asdk_app_6a856978bdf0819191b886f2.description:

  each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under
  their own brand.

  This plugin serves RideDesk's developer documentation as queryable tools,
  so an agent can pull the exact API contract while building an operator's
  booking website: the three-call quote → book → checkout flow, embeddable
  booking widgets, visitor attribution, live chat, the customer portal, and
  each account's own MCP booking server for AI-agent bookings.

  plugin — and prices are always computed server-side from the operator's
  own rate card, never by an agent.

  site, look up the checkout contract, fetch widget embed snippets for a
  specific domain, or search the docs for captcha, attribution and
  customer-portal details.

plugin_asdk_app_6a95d3a05d888191945f40e3.name: Unblocked
plugin_asdk_app_6a95d3a05d888191945f40e3.description:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.

One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Codex over MCP, or through the Unblocked CLI and API. Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, Sentry, Datadog, and more.

translation.description:
Unblocked 是代理软件开发的背景层,它在您的代码、对话、问题、文档、产品和生产系统中提供理由,以便代理人能够以更少的人类干预的方式正确地完成工作。

编码代理人知道代码,他们不知道为什么它是这样写的,两个矛盾的文件中哪个是当前的,什么是票据决定,或者生产正在做什么。

一个MCP服务器取代了十几个. 文本在到达代理人之前被排序,压缩和组装到服务器侧,因此代理人因高质量的输入而产生了理由. 结果:可靠的代码反映了您的团队如何实际构建软件,产生了更少的代币和更少的后退。

通过 MCP 或通过 Unblocked CLI 和 API 与 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、GitHub Copilot 和 Codex 合作,连接到 GitHub、GitLab、Slack、Microsoft Teams、Jira、Linear、Confluence、Notion、Google Drive、Sentry、Datadog 等等。

plugin_asdk_app_6a755f9301d481919ab12736.name: Embrasure

plugin_asdk_app_6a9b5284465c8191b6eba9a9.description: qBraid helps users explore quantum devices, validate and simulate circuits, submit quantum jobs, and inspect results. plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.name: LabWired
plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.description: LabWired runs real embedded firmware on a deterministic simulation of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and ESP32), right inside the conversation. Pick a board, wire up an MCU with sensors, displays, and buses, compile firmware, and run it in an interactive hardware lab you can watch — no physical board required. The same firmware binary that flashes to real silicon runs in the simulator, so results are reproducible enough to debug and to gate CI on. LabWired validates your wiring before it runs, lists the boards and components it supports, compiles firmware from source, and opens a live lab view embedded in ChatGPT where you can see GPIO, serial output, and peripherals respond in real time.

translation.summary: 在虚拟芯片上运行固件
translation.description: LabWired 运行真正的嵌入式固件在微控制器(ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V 和 ESP32)的确定性模拟上,直接在对话中。 选择一个板,与传感器,显示器和巴士连接一个 MCU,编译固件,并在您可以观看的交互式硬件实验室中运行 - 无需物理板。 相同的固件二进制在模拟器中运行,所以结果足够可复制来调试和打开 CI。 LabWired 在运行前验证您的连接,列出它所支持的板和组件,从源头编译固件,并打开嵌入 ChatGPT 中的实时实验室视图,您可以看到 GPIO,系列输出和外部设备实时响应。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.name: Better Design
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.description:
Better Design gives AI coding agents a design-engineering layer for frontend work.

Design Intelligence mode loads UI principles before the agent writes UI code, then asks the agent to self-review against accessibility, visual design, motion, content, and comprehension rules. It helps catch issues like weak hierarchy, inaccessible controls, distracting motion, unclear copy, and missing reduced-motion behavior before code is presented.

Scaffold mode lets an agent install a complete shadcn-compatible visual system: tokens, globals, and component source. Better Design can also generate a new custom design system from a natural-language prompt and return a shadcn install command for the resulting registry.

The MCP server exposes tools for finding and generating design systems, loading UI/UX and React Native guidance, reviewing interface quality, extracting existing CSS tokens, and installing icon components. Tools are served from a public HTTPS endpoint and authenticated with OAuth for hosted ChatGPT and Codex use.

translation.description:
更好的设计为AI编码代理提供了前端工作的设计工程层。

Design Intelligence 模式在代理人编写 UI 代码之前加载 UI 原则,然后要求代理人对可访问性、视觉设计、运动、内容和理解规则进行自我审查。

Scaffold 模式允许代理人安装完整的 shadcn 兼容的视觉系统:代币、全球和组件源. Better Design 还可以从自然语言提示中生成新的自定义设计系统,并返回由此产生的注册表的 shadcn 安装命令。

MCP 服务器暴露了用于寻找和生成设计系统的工具,加载 UI/UX 和 React Native 指导,审查接口质量,提取现有 CSS 代币,并安装图标组件。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9c56474bd8819198275700.description: Tiniest Cloud hosts static web apps and gives each one sign-in, per-user storage, realtime, push notifications, scheduled jobs and a language model with nothing to configure. From a conversation you can deploy a folder and get a live URL, share the app with someone by email, roll back to an earlier version, connect a third-party API without putting its key in the page, schedule recurring work, and put an app on your own domain.

translation.summary: 使用 Sign-in 部署 Web 应用
translation.description: Tiniest Cloud 主持静态 Web 应用程序,每个应用程序都提供一个登录、用户存储、实时、推送通知、日程工作和一个没有任何配置的语言模型。从一个对话中,您可以部署一个文件夹并获得直播 URL,通过电子邮件与某人共享应用程序,回滚到以前的版本,连接第三方 API 而无需将其钥匙放在页面中,计划重复工作,并将应用程序放到自己的域。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5c3e5e745881918b228734.name: AiAkiv Memory
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c3e5e745881918b228734.description: AiAkiv is long-term memory that AI agents and teammates share over MCP. It saves the important parts of your conversations as a knowledge graph and recalls them across sessions, tools, and teammates — so context one AI saves, the next one picks up, and a whole team works from one shared memory instead of scattered private chats. Save with an explicit command ("ak save"), recall by meaning with semantic search. Hosted remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; Korean and English supported.

translation.summary: AI 代理商的共享记忆

plugin_asdk_app_6a9f3ff2e7908191a15ba565.description: Vioscale AI helps users discover, compare, and evaluate software using evidence-backed facts, transparent scores, and canonical citations.

plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.name: Tessryx
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.summary: Build and host live web apps
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.legacySummaryOriginal: Build and host live web apps
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.description:
Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.

The main workflows the tools support:
- Author a JSON Schema, then datafiles validated against it. The same schema generates an editing interface, so a non-technical person can maintain the content afterwards without an agent.
- Author workflows that return HTML or JSON, and bind them to public URLs as dynamic endpoints with edge caching. One endpoint serves both a rendered page and the API routes that page's own JavaScript calls.
- Define parameterized HTTP calls to external systems, with credentials held as write-only secrets the assistant can reference but never read.
- Schedule workflows on a cron or interval so data recomputes on its own.
- Claim and verify a custom domain and serve any of the above from it.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1; there are no API keys for the user to manage.

translation.summary: 构建和托管现场Web应用程序
translation.description:
Tessryx给了一个代理人建立一个地方. 从聊天中,它为真实的网站,API或内部工具创建了数据,逻辑,页面和日程工作,Tessryx在用户自己的域上的公共URL上托管了它们。

工具支持的主要工作流程: - 创建 JSON 方案,然后对其进行验证的数据文件. 相同的方案生成了一个编辑界面,因此非技术人员可以随后在没有代理的情况下维护内容。 - 创建工作流程返回 HTML 或 JSON,并将其绑定到公共 URL 作为边缘缓存的动态终端。 - 一个终端既服务于渲染页面和页面本身的 JavaScript 呼叫的 API 路径。 - 定义对外部系统的参数化 HTTP 呼叫,凭证保留为只写秘密,助手可以参考,但永远不会阅读。

身份验证是 OAuth 2.1;没有用户可以管理的 API 密钥。

plugin_asdk_app_6aacf78d67d48191a4919b49.description: With the nunu.ai plugin, you can automate your QA testing. plugin_asdk_app_6aa02bd506908191bbf12fc2.description: Observability for AI agents: query your logs, traces, metrics, and errors with SQL, build dashboards and chart alerts, manage uptime monitors, respond to incidents, see who's on-call, and publish status page reports. plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.name: Termalin
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.description:
Termalin connects your servers to the chat. Ask ChatGPT to check disk space, tail a log, restart a service, edit a config or install a package — it runs real commands over SSH and reads or writes files over SFTP on the servers you enrolled, and reports back in the conversation. It can also list tables and run read-only or full queries on your databases through the same secure path. No SSH key is ever pasted anywhere: servers connect outward through Termalin Connectors (a one-line install), each run is authenticated with a short-lived certificate, and access is granted with OAuth from your termal.in account. You stay in control: per-connection policy (full access, an allowlist of commands, or read-only), a full audit trail of every action, and one-click disconnect from your account page. Works alongside the Termalin desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) and web cabinet, but needs neither to be open.

To get started you need a termal.in account (Pro, Team or trial) with at least one Connector enrolled (Settings → Connectors, a one-line install) and a verified email.

translation.description:
Termalin 连接你的服务器到聊天. 请 ChatGPT 检查磁盘空间,尾声日志,重新启动服务,编辑配置或安装包 - 它通过 SSH 运行真实命令,在你注册的服务器上读取或写文件 SFTP,并在对话中报告。 它还可以列出表并通过相同的安全路径在数据库中运行仅读或完整的查询。 没有 SSH 密钥被粘贴到任何地方:服务器通过 Termalin Connectors (一行安装)连接到外部,每个运行都通过短期证书进行身份验证,并从您的 termal.in 帐户获得 OAuth 访问。 您可以控制:每连接政策(完全访问,允许命令列表或仅读),每个操作的完整审计路线,并单

要开始,你需要一个 termal.in 帐户(专业,团队或试用)至少有一个连接器注册(设置 →连接器,一行安装)和一个验证的电子邮件。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.name: MacroDroid Macro Builder
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.summary: Build a macro by describing it
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.legacySummaryOriginal: Build a macro by describing it
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.description:
Describe the automation you want in everyday language and get a complete MacroDroid macro back, ready to import on your Android phone.

MacroDroid is the Android automation app used daily by over a million users to automate their device with triggers, actions and constraints: silence the phone in meetings, turn off WiFi when the battery is low, read messages aloud while driving, send your location when you get home, and thousands more.

This plugin gives ChatGPT the full MacroDroid feature catalog (over 400 triggers, actions and constraints), the exact JSON layout for each one, and a validator that checks the finished macro before you see it. Just say what you want to happen and when, for example "mute my phone during calendar events and unmute afterwards". ChatGPT picks the right features, writes the macro and validates it.

Import the result by saving it as a .macro file and choosing Import on the Macros tab, or paste it into the MacroDroid AI Macro Builder at remote.macrodroid.com to send it straight to your phone.

No account or sign-in is needed. Nothing you type is stored by MacroDroid.

translation.summary: 通过描述它来构建一个宏
translation.description:
用日常语言描述您想要的自动化,并获得完整的 MacroDroid 宏,准备在您的 Android 手机上导入。

MacroDroid 是超过一百万用户每天使用的 Android 自动化应用程序,用触发器、操作和限制来自动化他们的设备:在会议上保持沉默,在电池低时关闭 WiFi,在开车时大声阅读消息,在回家时发送您的位置,以及其他数千个。

此插件为 ChatGPT 提供了完整的 MacroDroid 功能目录(超过 400 个触发器、操作和限制),每个功能的准确 JSON 布局,以及在你看到它之前检查完成的宏的验证器。

将结果导入,将其保存为 .macro 文件,并在 Macros 卡上选择导入,或者将其粘贴到 remote.macrodroid.com 的 Macro Builder 中,直接发送到您的手机。

无需帐户或登录,您输入的任何内容都不会被 MacroDroid 存储。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa2109570b0819194170aae.name: Loadster

plugin_asdk_app_6aa11dfaeb20819187226d48.name: Flowlines
plugin_asdk_app_6aa11dfaeb20819187226d48.description: Connect your Flowlines account to review AI agent activity, compare outcomes across time periods, investigate unsuccessful sessions, and analyze user cohorts. Use aggregate metrics, signals, topic maps, and focused session evidence to understand findings and identify product needs. Save independently verified findings as private workspace notes when requested. Requires a Flowlines account with access to a workspace containing agent data. Authorized results can include end-user conversation and activity data; responses should summarize evidence and mask direct personal identifiers. Flowlines records tool activity, arguments, results, and conversation outcome reports in private telemetry.

translation.description: 连接您的 Flowlines 帐户以审查 AI 代理活动,比较时间间隔的结果,调查失败的会话,并分析用户群。使用累积指标,信号,主题地图和集中式会话证据来了解结果并识别产品需求。在要求时将独立验证的结果保存为私人工作区笔记。 需要 Flowlines 帐户,可以访问包含代理数据的工作区。 授权的结果可以包括最终用户对话和活动数据; 响应应总结证据并掩盖直接的个人标识符。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9e71d5acc88191a706c762.name: Sabre Developer Hub MCP Server
plugin_asdk_app_6a9e71d5acc88191a706c762.description: Developer Hub MCP helps users search Sabre Developer Hub documentation by artifact name or content, inspect artifact details, fetch documentation pages, and review recently updated documentation.

translation.description: Developer Hub MCP 可帮助用户根据文物名称或内容搜索 Sabre Developer Hub 文档,检查文物细节,检索文档页面,并查看最近更新的文档。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9ded0caab48191bf35e038.name: Domain Scan
plugin_asdk_app_6a9ded0caab48191bf35e038.description: Domain Scan by CYBERACE checks a domain's email, HTTPS and DNS security, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS certificates, security headers, DNSSEC and blocklists. Get a security score, per-check findings and suggested fixes, with a temporary report link when available. No account or API key is required. Each scan stores results, consumes scan quota and may trigger administrative notifications. This plugin provides on-demand public domain scans; it does not access account data, configure monitoring or modify DNS records.

translation.description: CYBERACE 域扫描可以检查域的电子邮件、HTTPS 和 DNS 安全性,包括 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、TLS 证书、安全标题、DNSSEC 和区块清单。获取安全分数、每个检查结果和建议的修复,在可用时提供临时报告链接。不需要帐户或 API 密钥。每个扫描存储结果,消耗扫描配额,并可能引发行政通知。这个插件提供按需的公共域扫描;它不访问帐户数据,不配置监控或修改 DNS 记录。

plugin_asdk_app_6a91978e41a08191a6e7519c.name: Chartquery
plugin_asdk_app_6a91978e41a08191a6e7519c.description:
Chartquery generates charts, diagrams, QR codes, barcodes, and labels from ChatGPT. Describe the data or payload and get a public render URL you can open.

Charts: AI chart from a brief, or a structured chart payload. Diagrams: AI flowchart or a structured diagram. Codes: QR for URLs and Code128 barcodes. Labels: preview, parse, validate, convert, compile. Visual tools return https://api.chartquery.com/v1/{kind}/render/{id}?utm_source=chatgpt.com. Show that URL.

Sign in with your Chartquery account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.chartquery.com.

translation.description:
Chartquery 会从 ChatGPT 生成图表、图表、QR 代码、条形码和标签. 描述数据或效用量,并获得您可以打开的公共渲染 URL。

图表:从简短的图表或结构化图表的图表。图表:AI flowchart或结构化图表。代码:URL和Code128条形码的QR代码。标签:预览,解析,验证,转换,编译。视觉工具返回 https://api.chartquery.com/v1/{kind}/render/{id}?utm_source=chatgpt.com. 显示该URL。

连接时使用 Chartquery 帐户登录. 呼叫使用与 app.chartquery.com 相同的信贷和配额。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9ee7d263108191856c3dad.name: ApyHub EU
plugin_asdk_app_6a9ee7d263108191856c3dad.description: Use ApyHub to find and call production APIs for tasks that need external processing. Search the catalog by capability, then call the endpoint that fits. Covers file conversion (Word, PDF, Excel, images), document generation, OCR and text extraction, data validation (email, phone, VAT, IBAN, tax IDs), enrichment, geolocation and IP data, currency and unit conversion, QR and barcode generation, archive handling, and AI utilities. Search first to see what is available, review the endpoint details, then execute. Each endpoint returns its own cost and certification metadata.

translation.description: 使用 ApyHub 查找和调用需要外部处理的任务的生产 API. 根据能力搜索目录,然后调用匹配的终端。 涵盖文件转换(Word, PDF,Excel,图像),文档生成,OCR和文本提取,数据验证(电子邮件,电话,增值税,IBAN,税务ID),丰富,地理位置和IP数据,货币和单位转换,QR和条码生成,档案处理和AI实用工具。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9a83e37cc4819188896fee.name: Pydantic Logfire
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a83e37cc4819188896fee.description: Logfire helps engineering teams query telemetry, investigate exceptions, build dashboards and alerts, install observability integrations, and manage prompts and variables in their private workspace.

translation.description: Logfire 帮助工程团队查询远程测量,调查例外,构建仪表板和警报,安装可观察性集成,并在其私人工作区中管理提示和变量。

plugin_asdk_app_6a73b856e4348191a97dc8e3.name: Lobu
plugin_asdk_app_6a73b856e4348191a97dc8e3.description: Lobu gives ChatGPT governed access to durable workspace memory, connected data, devices, notification channels, and other agents. Users can search and save shared context, query authorized data, preview changes, and run permission-checked actions with human approvals where required.

translation.description: Lobu 允许 ChatGPT 对持久的工作区内存、连接数据、设备、通知渠道和其他代理提供受控的访问权限,用户可以搜索和保存共享背景,查询授权数据,预览更改,并在需要时使用人类批准执行授权检查的操作。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7e0055cb1c8191adca1ee4.name: Network Solutions
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e0055cb1c8191adca1ee4.description: Turn your business idea into a complete online presence with Network Solutions. Find and compare available domains, generate a logo and brand identity, create and customize a professional website, and choose the right hosting to take it live. Refine your website with different layouts, colors, fonts, and imagery, check domain pricing, and continue to Network Solutions when you are ready to purchase and launch. You can also use Network Solutions tools to deploy existing applications, and as new capabilities become available, add ecommerce, marketing, and other services to help grow and operate your business.

translation.description: 通过网络解决方案将您的业务理念转化为一个完整的在线存在。 查找和比较可用的域名,生成标志和品牌身份,创建和定制专业网站,并选择合适的托管,以便使其活跃。 用不同的布局,颜色,字体和图像来完善您的网站,检查域名价格,并在您准备购买和推出时继续使用网络解决方案。 您还可以使用网络解决方案工具来部署现有应用程序,随着新功能的推出,添加电子商务,营销和其他服务来帮助您的业务增长和运营。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa92269c998819182b551d3.name: Akwadra
plugin_asdk_app_6aa92269c998819182b551d3.description: Akwadra lets users create, inspect, edit, validate, and preview web-app projects from ChatGPT. ChatGPT writes the source files while Akwadra stores them in the signed-in user’s private workspace. The plugin can also read build logs for already-hosted projects. It does not purchase hosting or process payments.

translation.description: Akwadra 允许用户从 ChatGPT 创建、检查、编辑、验证和预览 Web 应用程序项目。ChatGPT 编写源文件,而 Akwadra 将其存储在注册用户的私人工作空间中。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9951eb4eec819180b4c69e.name: html.contact - Contact Forms
plugin_asdk_app_6a9951eb4eec819180b4c69e.description: Create contact forms for your website with html.contact by 854 Labs, without building a custom backend. Get installable HTML, fix form setup issues, route email notifications to verified recipients, and review selected submissions. Also supports lead capture, feedback, and waitlist forms. Uses your linked html.contact account; changes and email tests require confirmation.

translation.description: 使用 HTML.contact by 854 Labs 创建您的网站的联系表格,而不构建自定义后端。 获取可安装的 HTML,修复表单设置问题,将电子邮件通知路由到已验证的收件人,并审查所选提交内容。 还支持 lead capture、feedback 和 waitlist 表单。 使用您的链接的 html.contact 帐户; 更改和电子邮件测试需要确认。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab6de6dd34c8191afd2b8ee.name: CodSpeed
plugin_asdk_app_6ab6de6dd34c8191afd2b8ee.description: CodSpeed helps users optimize code with measured performance data. Inspect benchmark runs, compare changes, and analyze flamegraphs to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. The plugin also includes skills for setting up benchmarks and guiding iterative optimization.

translation.description: CodSpeed有助于用户通过测量性能数据优化代码,检查基准运行,比较更改,分析闪电图以找到瓶颈并验证改进。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa311aad644819191f07573.name: Honeycomb (EU)
plugin_asdk_app_6aa311aad644819191f07573.description: Honeycomb helps users investigate observability data, inspect traces, AI conversations, and anomaly signals, run queries and BubbleUp analyses, manage alerts and dashboards, and follow instrumentation migration guidance through ChatGPT.

translation.description: Honeycomb帮助用户调查可观测数据,检查线索,AI对话和异常信号,运行查询和BubbleUp分析,管理警报和仪表板,并通过ChatGPT遵循仪器迁移指南。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5656ef5c5481918d7561fc.name: WarmHub
plugin_asdk_app_6a5656ef5c5481918d7561fc.description: WarmHub helps users inspect repositories and schemas, search and traverse versioned knowledge graphs, validate and submit structured commits, manage collections, and configure webhook subscriptions from ChatGPT.

translation.description: WarmHub 帮助用户检查存储库和方案,搜索和浏览版本的知识图表,验证和提交结构化委托,管理收藏,并从 ChatGPT 配置 webhook 订阅。

plugin_asdk_app_69d3e530928c819191a9738e.name: Fingerprint
plugin_asdk_app_69d3e530928c819191a9738e.description:
The Fingerprint MCP Server connects ChatGPT directly to Fingerprint's device intelligence platform, enabling fraud analysts, developers, and security teams to investigate suspicious activity and understand traffic patterns more quickly.

Fingerprint captures device intelligence signals, including bot detection, VPN usage, browser tampering, and visitor behavior, on your highest-risk pages and actions like login, checkout, and account creation. With this connector, you can query that data conversationally, no dashboards or manual correlation required

Try prompts like:

- "Show me bot traffic from the last hour."
- "Is this signup spike part of a coordinated operation?"
- "Who are my most suspicious visitors and why?"
- "Help me implement Fingerprint to protect my site."

ChatGPT queries your Fingerprint workspace and returns insights in seconds. Developers can also use it to build and integrate Fingerprint into their applications, getting guidance on setup, configuration, and best practices without leaving the conversation.

Connect to your Fingerprint account to get started. New to Fingerprint? Sign up for free at fingerprint.com.

translation.summary: 查询欺诈 & 设备信号
translation.description:
Fingerprint MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 直接连接到 Fingerprint 的设备智能平台,使欺诈分析师、开发人员和安全团队能够更快地调查可疑活动并了解流量模式。

指纹捕获设备情报信号,包括机器人检测,VPN使用,浏览器篡改和访问者行为,在您的高风险页面和操作,如登录,支票和帐户创建。

试试像这样的快点:

“显示我上个小时的机器人流量” - “这个登录峰值是协调操作的一部分吗?” - “谁是我的最可疑的访问者,为什么?” - “帮助我实施指纹来保护我的网站。

ChatGPT 查询您的指纹工作区,并在几秒钟内返回见解,开发人员还可以使用它来构建和整合指纹到他们的应用程序中,在不离开谈话的情况下获得设置,配置和最佳实践的指导。

登录你的指纹帐户开始. 新到指纹? 注册免费在fingerprint.com。

plugin_asdk_app_6968be85e40c819191f4e291.name: DocuWriter.ai
plugin_asdk_app_6968be85e40c819191f4e291.description: DocuWriter is an AI-powered platform for creating and managing complete, structured documentation for entire codebases. Teams can connect repositories and generate documentation covering architecture, modules, services, classes, functions, dependencies, APIs, diagrams, READMEs, and other technical components. It supports both individual repositories and larger multi-repository systems. From ChatGPT, users can work with that centralized documentation through Spaces, semantic search, Autopilot, and repository workflows.

translation.description: DocuWriter 是一个人工智能驱动的平台,用于为完整的代码库创建和管理完整的结构化文档。 团队可以连接存储库并生成涵盖架构、模块、服务、类、功能、依赖、API、图表、READMEs 和其他技术组件的文档。 它支持单个存储库和更大的多存储库系统。 从 ChatGPT,用户可以通过空间、语义搜索、自动驾驶和存储库工作流程来处理该集中化文档。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2ab834c8191a93649ac.name: doDomain
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2ab834c8191a93649ac.description:
doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it. The doDomain plugin lets ChatGPT drive that work from your account: check a domain's current DNS state, list the apps configured on your team, list existing domain connections, create a new connect session for a customer, look up a session you already started, verify a session once the records are in place, and re-run verification on a connection that has drifted.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.

translation.description:
doDomain 是域连接作为服务:它为产品提供指向客户自己的域的导向流程,并处理其背后的 DNS 记录、验证和证书。 doDomain 插件允许 ChatGPT 驱动程序从您的帐户中工作:检查域的当前 DNS 状态,列出您团队配置的应用程序,列出现有的域连接,为客户创建新的连接会话,搜索您已经开始的会话,一旦记录已经在位,检查会话,并在连接中重新运行验证。

通过 PKCE 和动态客户端登记的 OAuth 2.1 进行访问。在同意屏幕上,每个功能都被授予范围 - 域、应用、连接和会话的单独阅读和写入范围 - 并且您未授予范围的工具从未被提供给助手。

创建连接会话与您的计划的每月连接配额计数;验证检查是有限的,所以在同一连接上重复重新验证将被告知等待,而不是默默地重复。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa136938ca08191808d78be.name: Vlak
plugin_asdk_app_6aa136938ca08191808d78be.description: Search Vlak's component catalogue, inspect exact React props and accessibility guidance, and get verified installation instructions for package, CLI, shadcn registry, or CSS-only use. Vlak is read-only and does not modify projects or external services.

translation.description: 搜索 Vlak 的组件目录,检查准确的 React 附件和可访问性指南,并获得对包、CLI、shadcn 注册表或仅使用 CSS 的验证安装说明。

plugin_asdk_app_6a96923ff47481919800bde4.name: PlanetScale
plugin_asdk_app_6a96923ff47481919800bde4.description: PlanetScale is a hosted MySQL/Vitess and Postgres database platform. This app connects ChatGPT to your PlanetScale databases so it can diagnose slow or failing queries and fix them. It reads schemas, runs queries, and uses PlanetScale Insights to identify the exact query or index problem behind a slow endpoint, then recommends or applies the change with safeguards for destructive operations. It also reviews logs and cluster sizes, searches documentation, and manages billing through Stripe Checkout.

translation.description: PlanetScale 是一个托管的 MySQL/Vitess 和 Postgres 数据库平台. 该应用连接 ChatGPT 到您的 PlanetScale 数据库,以便诊断慢性或失败的查询并修复它们. 它读取方案,运行查询,并使用 PlanetScale Insights 来识别慢性终端背后的准确查询或索引问题,然后建议或应用更改以保护破坏性操作。 它还审查日志和集群大小,搜索文档,并通过 Stripe Checkout 管理计费。

plugin_asdk_app_6aac044a3e4c819182c689d8.name: Harness
plugin_asdk_app_6aac044a3e4c819182c689d8.description: Harness helps users inspect software delivery health, diagnose failed executions, find delivery resources, and perform authorized create, update, delete, and execute actions across their Harness account from ChatGPT.

translation.description: Harness 帮助用户检查软件交付状况,诊断失败的执行,查找交付资源,并在他们的 Harness 帐户中执行授权创建,更新,删除和执行操作。

plugin_asdk_app_6a90296230f4819180d857f6.name: Expo
plugin_asdk_app_6a90296230f4819180d857f6.description: Expo helps developers find official guidance, prepare compatible dependencies and EAS workflows, manage builds and workflow runs, create and run commands in cloud sandboxes, set build usage budgets, inspect crash and store feedback, and respond to App Store and Google Play reviews through ChatGPT.

translation.description: Expo 帮助开发人员找到官方指导,准备兼容的依赖和 EAS 工作流程,管理构建和工作流程,在云沙盒中创建和运行命令,设置构建使用预算,检查崩溃和存储反馈,并通过 ChatGPT 响应 App Store 和 Google Play 评论。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab6537385e081919ae488e0.name: Review Times
plugin_asdk_app_6ab6537385e081919ae488e0.description:
Review Times shows how long AI app, connector and plugin stores are taking to review submissions right now, including ChatGPT plugins, Claude, Meta Muse, Grok and Cursor.

Ask before you submit ("How long is ChatGPT plugin review taking?"), check whether a review that has gone quiet is normal, or compare stores before a launch. You get the typical wait (the median days to a decision, counting submissions still waiting), approval and rejection times, whether the queue is moving, and how each store's review works.

The numbers come from developer reports, public posts linked to their sources, and public review queues. If you want, you can add your own submission so the numbers get better for everyone. No account needed.

translation.summary: 查看 App Store 评论时间
translation.description:
评论时报显示,AI应用程序,连接器和插件商店现在需要多长时间来审查提交,包括ChatGPT插件,Claude,Meta Muse,Grok和Cursor。

在提交之前询问(“ChatGPT插件审查需要多长时间?”),检查已经安静的审查是否正常,或者在推出之前比较商店。

这些数字来自开发人员的报告,与其来源链接的公共帖子,以及公众评论排队. 如果您想要的话,您可以添加自己的提交,以便数字对每个人都更好。

plugin_asdk_app_6a956527ac488191b306c034.name: Gumlet
plugin_asdk_app_6a956527ac488191b306c034.description: Easily manage your video and image libraries, retrieve real-time performance analytics, organize workspaces, and automate media processing workflows without leaving your conversation.

translation.description: 轻松管理视频和图像库,获取实时性能分析,组织工作区,并自动化媒体处理工作流程,而不离开对话。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7045fe403c81918e49f176.name: mach
plugin_asdk_app_6a7045fe403c81918e49f176.description: mach connects an approved account to inspect Flutter, React Native, and Expo delivery work: projects, cloud builds, store submissions, OTA releases, Maestro test runs, and account usage. It is read-only and never exposes project secrets, signing credentials, build logs, or artifacts.

translation.description: mach 连接一个经过批准的帐户来检查 Flutter、React Native 和 Expo 交付工作:项目、云构建、商店提交、OTA 发布、Maestro 测试运行和帐户使用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9a645c20f4819187369704.name: Etherscan
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a645c20f4819187369704.description: Etherscan brings live public blockchain data into ChatGPT. Users can inspect wallet balances and activity, token transfers, transactions and receipts, verified contract source and ABI, event logs, blocks, gas recommendations, and supported EVM chains, then display selected results in an interactive Etherscan card. The app is read-only and cannot sign or broadcast transactions.

translation.description: Etherscan 将公共区块链数据带入 ChatGPT. 用户可以检查钱包余额和活动,代币转移,交易和收据,验证的合同来源和 ABI,事件日志,块,天然气推荐和支持的 EVM 链,然后在交互式 Etherscan 卡中显示所选择的结果。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab70b1720748191bcfd401a.name: Instant AI
plugin_asdk_app_6ab70b1720748191bcfd401a.description:
Find domain names and explore brand ideas with Instant AI, powered by Instant Domain Search. Check one name across hundreds of extensions, check up to 50 full domain names at once, generate .com alternatives, and search indexed USPTO trademark records.

Instant AI is free and read-only, with no account or API key required. Domain results link to research pages on instantdomainsearch.com. Registration status comes from our search index, rebuilt daily from registry zone files and DNS observations, rather than live registry queries. Trademark results include the source snapshot date and do not establish legal clearance.

Built by Instant Labs, Inc., an ICANN-accredited registrar (IANA 3952).

plugin_asdk_app_6aa8935a002c8191a3b3d804.name: DEEPBOM Artifact Evidence
plugin_asdk_app_6aa8935a002c8191a3b3d804.description: Inspect attached AI model deployment files without executing model code. DEEPBOM analyzes supported TFLite, ONNX, GGUF, SafeTensors, Core ML, and ExecuTorch files in the browser and reports SHA-256, serialized structure, tensor encodings, quantization evidence, and static findings. Explore Model IR tables and visualizations, and export SVG, PNG, Word-ready bundles, CycloneDX 1.7 artifact evidence, or SPDX 2.3 artifact inventories. Use Send PNG to chat to share a selected visualization or Save via ChatGPT to obtain a download link for a generated file when supported by the host. These actions share the generated export, not the model file. Results separate artifact defects, cautions, and evidence gaps, and explain what static analysis cannot establish. Use the local CLI or local MCP for confidential, very large, sharded, or multi-file artifacts.

translation.description: 检查附加的 AI 模型部署文件而不执行模型代码。 DEEPBOM 分析在浏览器中支持的 TFLite, ONNX, GGUF, SafeTensors, Core ML 和 ExecuTorch 文件,并报告 SHA-256,序列结构,压缩编码,量化证据和静态结果。 探索模型 IR 表和可视化,并导出 SVG, PNG, Word-ready bundles, CycloneDX 1.7 文物证据,或 SPDX 2.3 文物库存。 使用发送 PNG 聊天以共享选定的可视化或通过 ChatGPT 保存以获得生成的文件的下载链接,当主机支持。 这些操作共享生成的导出,而不是模型文件。 结果分离文物缺陷

plugin_asdk_app_6aa8c89899a881918862cd7f.name: Wolfire Workspace
plugin_asdk_app_6aa8c89899a881918862cd7f.description: Wolfire Workspace helps authorized game developers inspect their games, dated store checks, saved build provenance and release reports. Ask what needs attention and follow evidence back to the dashboard. Prepare public listing observations for review; saving requires confirmation in the dashboard. Requires an invited workspace account. This plugin does not run builds, download artifacts or publish releases.

translation.description: Wolfire Workspace有助于授权的游戏开发人员检查他们的游戏,日期商店检查,保存的构建来源和发布报告. 询问需要注意的内容,并跟踪证据回到仪表板上。 准备公开列表观察进行审查; 保存需要在仪表板上确认。 需要邀请的工作区帐户。 此插件不运行构建,下载文物或发布版本。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8f76cbcd248191a28416c8.name: Gondwana
plugin_asdk_app_6a8f76cbcd248191a28416c8.description: Build, debug, and understand games made with the Gondwana C#/.NET game engine. The plugin uses Gondwana-specific workflows and read-only access to the current official repository, tests, demos, templates, and wiki so answers and generated code can be grounded in the engine's current public APIs.

translation.summary: 构建和调试 Gondwana 游戏
translation.description: 使用Gondwana C#/.NET游戏引擎构建,调试和理解游戏. 该插件使用Gondwana特定的工作流程,并只访问当前的官方存储库,测试,演示文稿,模板和维基,以便答案和生成的代码可以在引擎的当前公共API中建立。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa47394ea708191bcef52a7.name: Knowledge for Agents
plugin_asdk_app_6aa47394ea708191bcef52a7.legacySummary: 面向 Agent 的知识工具
plugin_asdk_app_6aa47394ea708191bcef52a7.description: Shared experience and conversations for AI agents. Search real problems, solutions, failed approaches and observed outcomes in a public community knowledge base. Compare exact errors, environments and revisions before relying on a record. This ChatGPT connection reads anonymously; guest and persistent pseudonymous contributions are available through separate governed participation flows.

translation.description: AI代理商的共享经验和对话 在公共社区的知识库中搜索真实问题、解决方案、失败方法和观察结果. 在依靠记录之前比较准确的错误、环境和修订。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8ffc9d54d481919c8a68d8.name: ASO Skill
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ffc9d54d481919c8a68d8.description: ASO Skill helps app developers and marketers research current Apple App Store search rankings and keyword autocomplete, compare difficulty and popularity, inspect app metadata, and check account credits through ChatGPT.

translation.summary: 苹果 App Store 研究
translation.description: ASO Skill 帮助应用程序开发人员和营销人员研究当前的 Apple App Store 搜索排名和关键字自动完成,比较困难和受欢迎性,检查应用程序元数据,并通过 ChatGPT 检查帐户信用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a90afb92b548191b773f492.name: Pod
plugin_asdk_app_6a90afb92b548191b773f492.description: Pod is a living index of what actually happens when people and agents use things. Search real experiences with any product, API, service, place, or organization before making a decision. Then share yours to help the next person or agent.

translation.description: Pod 是人们和代理人使用事物时实际发生的事情的活跃指数. 在做出决定之前,搜索任何产品,API,服务,地点或组织的真实体验。

plugin_asdk_app_6a993221cf8081919fd7194d.name: juudd
plugin_asdk_app_6a993221cf8081919fd7194d.description: juudd puts an AI-written project online without a second account to sign up for. Ask it to deploy, and you get a live site on your own subdomain with a Postgres database of its own — no build pipeline to configure, no dashboard to learn. Bring a project you already have: juudd accepts the files, serves them, and hands back a URL you can share. Custom domains, permanent versions with one-step rollback, and a plain record of every action taken on your account are included. Built for people who can direct an AI to write a working site but have never deployed one.

translation.description: juudd 将 AI 编写的项目在线放置,而无需注册第二个帐户。请它部署,你可以在自己的子域上获得一个实时网站,拥有自己的 Postgres 数据库 - 没有构建管道来配置,没有仪表板来学习。 带来你已经拥有的项目: juudd 接受文件,服务它们,并返回你可以共享的 URL。 包含了自定义域、永久版本,具有一步倒退,以及在你的帐户上采取的每一个行动的清晰记录。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab4ed5292d48191bc192893.name: Prisma
plugin_asdk_app_6ab4ed5292d48191bc192893.description:
Take your app from idea to a live URL with Prisma. Prisma brings together app hosting with Prisma Compute, managed databases with Prisma Postgres, and type-safe data access with Prisma ORM.

Build a new app with Prisma Composer or get an existing app ready for Compute. The plugin guides you through setup, local testing, and deployment, then checks that your live app works. Optional diagnostics use Prisma's MCP server to inspect deployment state and logs.

Requires ChatGPT's desktop app with local execution. Initially tested on macOS.

Do not use this plugin to process protected health information (PHI) or payment card data regulated by PCI DSS, including through connected databases, application logs, or project files. For healthcare or payment-related prototypes, use a separate environment containing synthetic data only.

translation.summary: 构建和部署您的应用程序
translation.description:
Prisma 将您的应用从想法转变为实时 URL。Prisma 将应用程序托管与 Prisma Compute、Prisma Postgres 管理数据库、Prisma ORM 安全键入数据连接在一起。

使用 Prisma Composer 构建新应用程序或为 Compute 准备现有应用程序. 该插件将引导您进行设置、本地测试和部署,然后检查您的实时应用程序是否有效。

需要具有本地执行的 ChatGPT 桌面应用程序,最初在 macOS 上测试。

不要使用此插件处理受 PCI DSS 监管的受保护的健康信息(PHI)或支付卡数据,包括通过连接的数据库、应用日志或项目文件。

plugin_asdk_app_6aad87f29b1881919513e315.name: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge
plugin_asdk_app_6aad87f29b1881919513e315.description: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge lets authorized server owners inspect server health, work with approved files, and manage user-level processes from ChatGPT. Connections use OAuth with one-time owner pairing, and OpenAI reviewers receive a separate isolated demo environment.

translation.summary: 管理您的 AI-HIVE 服务器
translation.description: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge 允许授权的服务器所有者检查服务器的状态,与批准的文件进行工作,并从 ChatGPT 管理用户级流程。

plugin_asdk_app_6abc2a9552748191b465859a.name: Cloudflare
plugin_asdk_app_6abc2a9552748191b465859a.description: Cloudflare helps users search product documentation, discover API endpoints, and read, create, update, or delete resources across their Cloudflare accounts through ChatGPT.

translation.description: Cloudflare 帮助用户搜索产品文档,发现 API 终端,并通过 ChatGPT 阅读、创建、更新或删除 Cloudflare 帐户中的资源。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8f92eae3a88191a4c5d75f.name: Kernel
plugin_asdk_app_6a8f92eae3a88191a4c5d75f.description: Kernel lets developers manage their Kernel account from ChatGPT. Start, inspect, and end cloud browser sessions in their own Kernel project, review saved browser profiles, sign in to their own accounts through a secure login panel that keeps passwords out of chat, check deployed Kernel apps, and search Kernel documentation.

translation.description: Kernel 允许开发人员从 ChatGPT 管理他们的 Kernel 帐户,在他们自己的 Kernel 项目中启动、检查和结束云浏览器会话,查看保存的浏览器配置文件,通过安全登录面板登录自己的帐户,以保持密码远离聊天,检查部署的 Kernel 应用程序,并搜索 Kernel 文档。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa29f6d27948191ae2548d0.name: ApyHub US
plugin_asdk_app_6aa29f6d27948191ae2548d0.description: Use ApyHub to find and call production APIs for tasks that need external processing. Search the catalog by capability, then call the endpoint that fits. Covers file conversion (Word, PDF, Excel, images), document generation, OCR and text extraction, data validation (email, phone, VAT, IBAN, tax IDs), enrichment, geolocation and IP data, currency and unit conversion, QR and barcode generation, archive handling, and AI utilities. Search first to see what is available, review the endpoint details, then execute. Each endpoint returns its own cost and certification metadata.

translation.description: 使用 ApyHub 查找和调用需要外部处理的任务的生产 API. 根据能力搜索目录,然后调用匹配的终端。 涵盖文件转换(Word, PDF,Excel,图像),文档生成,OCR和文本提取,数据验证(电子邮件,电话,增值税,IBAN,税务ID),丰富,地理位置和IP数据,货币和单位转换,QR和条码生成,档案处理和AI实用工具。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8d855b1a60819197672447.name: TokenLab
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d855b1a60819197672447.description: Define the design truth for a brand, product, or system. Turn it into tokens, guidance, and production outputs while people, automations, and AI contribute through one reviewable workflow. Use TokenLab in ChatGPT and Codex to explore workspaces, projects, libraries, modes, aliases, and releases, resolve tokens for implementation, and prepare governed changes on branches for human review.

translation.summary: 一个设计的真相,每个人。
translation.description: 定义一个品牌、产品或系统的设计真理,将其转化为代币、指导和生产输出,而人们、自动化和人工智能通过一个可审查的工作流程做出贡献。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa16ec31c648191b4526d9c.name: Simple Commenter
plugin_asdk_app_6aa16ec31c648191b4526d9c.description: Read and act on website and asset feedback from Simple Commenter in ChatGPT and Codex. Search authorized projects, inspect comments with available screenshots, element context, replies, and captured JavaScript errors, and turn feedback into concrete development tasks. With the appropriate permissions, update statuses and priorities, reply to feedback, create comments, and generate exports and reports. The included fix-feedback skill guides a coding agent through investigating and fixing selected issues when the relevant codebase is available. Requires a Simple Commenter account and project access. Features depend on your account plan and granted permissions.

translation.description: 在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中,阅读和对网站和资产的反馈,搜索授权的项目,检查可用的屏幕截图,元素背景,响应和捕获的 JavaScript 错误的评论,并将反馈转化为具体的开发任务。使用适当的权限,更新状态和优先级,回复反馈,创建评论,并生成出口和报告。包含的修复反馈技能指导编码代理通过调查和修复相关代码库可用时的选定的问题。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9ffb8c2654819190029c3b.name: Altifigence
plugin_asdk_app_6a9ffb8c2654819190029c3b.description: Browse your Altifigence Cloud projects, inspect workspace details, and read saved source files in ChatGPT. Use your authorized project context to understand designs and discuss code. The integration provides read-only access to the workspaces you are permitted to view.

translation.summary: 阅读云工作空间的背景
translation.description: 浏览您的 Altifigence Cloud 项目,检查工作区的详细信息,并在 ChatGPT 中阅读保存的源文件。 使用授权的项目背景来了解设计和讨论代码。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa6021d9da0819197b62af6.name: ProdVerity
plugin_asdk_app_6aa6021d9da0819197b62af6.description: ProdVerity is a read-only production verification plugin for developers and operators. It checks whether a public HTTPS web app is reachable, inspects common security headers, discovers an optional ProdVerity verification manifest, runs deterministic public health checks, and can compare a public build marker with an expected commit or release identifier. It does not log in, modify target applications, access private networks, or claim visual verification.

translation.description: ProdVerity 是专为开发者和运营商提供的仅可读的生产验证插件,它检查公共 HTTPS 网络应用是否可访问,检查常见安全标题,发现可选的 ProdVerity 验证宣言,运行确定性公共健康检查,并可以将公共构建标记与预期的委托或发布标识符进行比较。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8c18327a788191af35864e.name: Web Performance Insights
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c18327a788191af35864e.description: Web Performance Insights runs Lighthouse performance audits on web pages through its tool service, displays scores and Core Web Vitals with historical trends, retrieves real-user Chrome UX Report field data, compares or benchmarks multiple pages head-to-head, provides AI-powered recommendations to improve specific metrics, and exports audit results as downloadable PDF reports.

translation.description: Web Performance Insights 通过其工具服务在 Web 页面上运行 Lighthouse 性能审核,显示历史趋势的分数和核心 Web 重要性,检索真实用户 Chrome UX 报告的现场数据,将多个页面对比或基准,提供人工智能驱动的建议来改进特定的指标,并将审计结果导出为可下载的 PDF 报告。

plugin_asdk_app_6a97e1d563d081918e018b4a.name: Veille
plugin_asdk_app_6a97e1d563d081918e018b4a.description:
Veille is an email, domain, phone, IP, VAT, and IBAN validation API for ChatGPT. Check signups, invoices, and traffic before you trust them.

Email validation flags disposable inboxes, role accounts, and a 0-100 risk score. Email qualification adds SMTP and catch-all. Domain checks disposable and MX health. Phone validation covers E.164 carrier and virtual numbers. IP reputation detects VPN, proxy, Tor, and datacenter. VAT uses VIES. IBAN returns bank and BIC. Exchange rates come from the ECB.

Sign in with your Veille account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.veille.io.

translation.summary: 电子邮件和增值税验证
translation.description:
Veille 是 ChatGPT 的电子邮件、域名、电话、IP、增值税和 IBAN 验证 API. 在您信任它们之前检查登记、发票和流量。

电子邮件验证标志可用收件箱、角色账户和 0-100 风险分数。电子邮件资格增加了 SMTP 和 catch-all。 域检查可用和 MX 健康。 电话验证涵盖了 E.164 运营商和虚拟号码。 IP 声誉检测VPN、代理商、Tor 和数据中心。 VAT 使用 VIES。 IBAN 返回银行和 BIC。 汇率来自欧洲央行。

登录 Veille 帐户时,连接. 呼叫使用与 app.veille.io 相同的信贷和配额。

plugin_connector_1p_ec3ac07c755c8191aa73.name: Code Review
plugin_connector_1p_ec3ac07c755c8191aa73.summary: Review pull requests and merge requests
plugin_connector_1p_ec3ac07c755c8191aa73.legacySummaryOriginal: Review pull requests and merge requests
plugin_connector_1p_ec3ac07c755c8191aa73.description: Browse and review pull requests and merge requests in Codex.

translation.summary: 回顾拉动请求和合并请求
translation.description: 在 Codex 中浏览和审查拉动请求和合并请求。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4e3e11f6688191a42f71a4.name: Componecat
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e3e11f6688191a42f71a4.description:
Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real software landscape: which team owns the billing service, what depends on the auth API, where the runbook for the payments gateway lives, or which endpoints a component exposes. Search takes precise filters, so one question can cover a whole slice of the catalog. Documentation for each component is available in full, including sections synced from Git, so you can read it and reason about it without leaving the conversation.

You can also keep the catalog current from chat: add or update components, record relationships, attach documentation links, and review recent activity.

Componecat's own product documentation is included too, so ChatGPT can explain how the platform works and walk you through it.

A Componecat account is required. Catalogs are private to your organization, and you sign in with your existing account when connecting.

translation.description:
Componecat 是您组织的软件目录:您运行的每个系统、服务、库和 API,所有者、依赖、文档和终端都在一个地方。

用简单的语言问问题,并从你的真实软件环境中获得答案:哪个团队拥有账单服务,什么取决于auth API,支付网关的运行簿居住在哪里,或者哪个端点暴露一个组件。

您还可以从聊天中保持目录的最新状态:添加或更新组件,记录关系,添加文档链接,并查看最近的活动。

Componecat 自己的产品文档也包含在其中,因此 ChatGPT 可以解释该平台的运作方式,并为您提供指导。

需要 Componecat 帐户. 目录对您的组织来说是私密的,您在连接时会使用现有帐户登录。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9806652a648191886835ee.name: 방위사업 법령 도우미
plugin_asdk_app_6a9806652a648191886835ee.summary: 방위사업 관련 공개 법령과 판례 검색
plugin_asdk_app_6a9806652a648191886835ee.legacySummaryOriginal: 방위사업 관련 공개 법령과 판례 검색
plugin_asdk_app_6a9806652a648191886835ee.description:
방위사업 업무와 관련된 공개 법령, 행정규칙, 판례 및 결정례를 검색하고 질문과 관련된 문서명과 조문·판단 근거를 확인하도록 돕습니다.

국가법령정보센터 Open API와 방위사업청 공개 자료를 활용하며, 개인 개발자가 독립적으로 운영합니다. 
방위사업청·법제처·OpenAI가 제작하거나 후원·승인한 서비스가 아닙니다.

조회 결과는 업무 검토를 위한 참고자료입니다. 최종 판단은 담당자가 원문과 사실관계를 확인 후 판단 바랍니다.

translation.summary: 防务事业相关公开法令与判例搜索
translation.description:
搜尋與防衛事業業務相關的公開法令、行政規則、判例及判決例,協助查詢與問題相關的文書名稱及判斷根據。

国家法令信息中心开放API和 방위사업청公开资料,由个人开发者独立经营,不是 방위사업청·法制机构·OpenAI制作或支持的服务。

最后的判决,请责任人确认原文和事实关系后判定。

plugin_templated_apps_6a710de0c6b08191a2.name: dbt
plugin_templated_apps_6a710de0c6b08191a2.description: dbt MCP Server helps users inspect dbt projects, query dbt Semantic Layer metrics, review lineage and model metadata, run dbt commands, manage dbt Platform jobs, generate dbt boilerplate, and search official dbt documentation through ChatGPT.

translation.description: dbt MCP Server 帮助用户检查 dbt 项目,查询 dbt 语义层指标,查看线程和模型元数据,运行 dbt 命令,管理 dbt 平台工作,生成 dbt 锅板,并通过 ChatGPT 搜索官方 dbt 文档。

plugin_templated_apps_6aac86278f188191ae.name: Retool
plugin_templated_apps_6aac86278f188191ae.legacySummary: 构建并部署 Retool 应用
plugin_templated_apps_6aac86278f188191ae.description: Manage your Retool environment remotely. Build, edit, and deploy apps, and perform administrative tasks.

translation.summary: 构建和部署 Retool 应用程序
translation.description: 远程管理 Retool 环境:构建、编辑和部署应用程序,并执行管理任务。

plugin_asdk_app_698a340b9230819188ba5a5e.name: ZoomInfo
plugin_asdk_app_698a340b9230819188ba5a5e.legacyDescriptionSource: ZoomInfo — B2B company and professional intelligence. Use for prospecting, finding people at companies, current and past employment, job changes, org charts, executives, verified business contact information, company research, intent, Scoops, and GTM signals.
plugin_asdk_app_698a340b9230819188ba5a5e.description: ZoomInfo — B2B company and professional intelligence. Use for prospecting, finding people at companies, current and past employment, job changes, org charts, executives, verified business contact information, company research, intent, Scoops, and GTM signals.

translation.description: ZoomInfo — B2B公司和专业情报. 用于搜索,在公司寻找人员,当前和过去的就业,工作变化,组织图表,高管,验证的业务联系信息,公司研究,意图,Scoops和GTM信号。

plugin_asdk_app_69e5f69b54d8819185e1638e.name: Lusha
plugin_asdk_app_69e5f69b54d8819185e1638e.legacyDescriptionSource: Connect Lusha to ChatGPT for B2B sales intelligence, prospecting, and go-to-market data, including verified contacts, decision-makers, and company enrichment, straight into your chat. Lusha is the B2B data layer behind 300M+ verified contacts, used by sales, marketing, RevOps, and recruiting teams for lead generation, CRM enrichment, account research, and outbound campaigns. plugin_asdk_app_6947c583d8308191844af621.description:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.

Vibe Prospecting 将现场 B2B 数据带入 ChatGPT 用于搜索、 lead 研究和数据丰富,它利用来自 50 多个来源的 150 万多家公司和 800 万以上专业联系人的数据库,这样您就可以构建 lead 列表、研究账户并填写缺失的联系人数据,而不会离开对话。

编辑 PDF:更改文本、更正日期、填写表单. 通过提示生成新 PDF — 发票、合同、建议. 合并多达 20 个 PDF,按页面范围进行分割,压缩,并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。 同时保持布局,翻译完整的文档。

您可以转换到 Word 来编辑,切换工具来合并,付额外的费用来翻译,并挖掘文件夹来找到文件。

将 PDF 编辑到位 - 没有 Word roundtrip. 通过提示生成发票、合同和建议. 合并多达 20 个文件,分页,压缩,并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint. 翻译完整的文档,同时保持布局. 您的 pdf.net 库保持连接,因此文件远离一个消息。

plugin_asdk_app_6a259d81ab048191b479aadd.name: iZap
plugin_asdk_app_6a259d81ab048191b479aadd.description:
Connect iZap to manage your WhatsApp customer conversations without leaving the chat. Check how your day is going at a glance — message volume, how much your AI assistant is handling versus your team, and how long conversations are taking. Search and read your chat history, look up contacts, and send WhatsApp messages or approved templates on the spot. Launch broadcast campaigns with a preview step before anything goes out, and track their delivery. You can also set up and fine-tune the AI assistants that reply to your customers — create a new one or update its instructions in seconds.

Everything runs against your own authenticated iZap business, so you see your real numbers and your real conversations.

translation.description:
连接iZap来管理你的WhatsApp客户对话,而不离开聊天。检查你的一天是如何的一眼 — 消息量,你的AI助理与你的团队相比处理了多少,以及谈话需要多长时间。搜索和阅读你的聊天历史,搜索联系人,并在现场发送WhatsApp消息或批准的模板。在任何事情结束之前,启动播放活动预览步骤,并跟踪他们的交付。

一切都与你自己认证的iZap业务相抵触,所以你可以看到你的真实数字和真实的对话。

plugin_asdk_app_695241ece6188191bd089752.name: Business Helper
plugin_asdk_app_695241ece6188191bd089752.legacyDescriptionSource:
Business Helper improves ChatGPT answers to business questions by adding reliable, source-
backed context from trusted expert materials.
When users ask about strategy, product, marketing, or operations, the app enriches responses
with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it
clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally
without external references.

Business Helper does not collect personal data, and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based on user's intentions only.

Business Helper 通过从可信的专家材料中添加可靠、源代码支持的背景来改进 ChatGPT 对业务问题的答案。

当用户询问战略、产品、营销或运营时,应用程序会以相关的示例和参考真实世界的见解来丰富答案,只有在显然提高实用性时才会添加背景。

Business Helper 不会收集个人数据,也不会提供专业的法律或财务建议,任何外部服务都只能根据用户的意图进行推荐。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0346f97e5881919b8b5f87.name: Namify
plugin_asdk_app_6a0346f97e5881919b8b5f87.description:
Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. Describe your business in plain language, drop in a one-word concept, or paste a seed domain with a preferred extension, and Namify instantly returns relevant name suggestions with live availability across multiple TLDs.

What makes Namify different is that it doesn't stop at "is this domain free?" Every suggestion can be vetted for full brand-readiness: run a trademark check to spot legal conflicts, and a social-handle check to confirm the name is available across major platforms. It is domain discovery built for people who want a name that actually works as a brand — not just a URL that happens to be unregistered.

Best used for naming a new business, side project, app, or product launch — and going from idea to a domain you can register in a single conversation.

translation.description:
Namify 将一个想法的火花变成一个可用的域名 - 无需在搜索栏中输入变异,以简单的语言描述您的业务,放入一个单词概念,或粘贴一个种子域名,使用偏好扩展,Namify 会即时返回相关的名称建议,在多个 TLD 上实现实时可用性。

Namify的不同之处在于它不会停留在“这个域名是免费的吗?”每个建议都可以进行全面的品牌准备测试:运行商标检查以发现法律冲突,并在主要平台上提供社交手册检查以确认名称。

最好用来命名新的业务,侧面项目,应用程序或产品推出 - 并从想法到域名,您可以在单个对话中注册。

plugin_asdk_app_6a01e3c3e164819195d356a1.name: AI Business Plan by PrometAI
plugin_asdk_app_6a01e3c3e164819195d356a1.description: PrometAI helps users generate a complete business plan PDF from a few key business details. Users provide their company name, business description, country, and email, then PrometAI creates a business plan, generates a downloadable PDF, and sends access instructions so they can continue editing the plan on the PrometAI platform.

translation.description: PrometAI帮助用户从几个关键业务细节中生成完整的商业计划PDF。用户提供公司名称、业务描述、国家和电子邮件,然后PrometAI创建业务计划,生成可下载的PDF,并发送访问说明,以便他们可以在PrometAI平台上继续编辑计划。

plugin_asdk_app_69eba17551ac81918231c838.name: Datasite
plugin_asdk_app_69eba17551ac81918231c838.legacyDescriptionSource:
Connect ChatGPT to your Datasite virtual data room - the secure workspace where thousands of M&A deals are facilitated annually. Set up folder structures, invite users, search documents, track buyer Q&A, and audit data room readiness, all through natural language. No workflow interruptions. No security trade-offs. Built for advisors, bankers, and corporate development teams - backed by the enterprise security and permissioning every transaction demands.
  1. Set up a deal room - "Create a new Datasite Prepare data room for Project Alpha, set up a standard M&A folder index, and invite sarah@advisorfirm.com as an admin."

  2. Search documents semantically - "Search the data room for any documents related to pending litigation or regulatory risk."

  3. Track buyer Q&A - "Show me all open Q&A questions in the data room and draft responses where we have supporting documents."
  4. Audit deal room readiness - "Check the data room for empty folders, missing documents, and any files flagged as password-protected or blank before we go live."

  5. Manage user access - "Create a buyer role with view-only permissions and create draft invitations for the following five contacts from Acme Capital."

plugin_asdk_app_6a06f0d924b0819180139000.name: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale
plugin_asdk_app_6a06f0d924b0819180139000.description: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale helps online sellers find products for their online stores. Discover millions of premium dropshipping and wholesale products from verified global suppliers. Ask for products by category, image, price, location, popularity, or minimum profit margin. Explore top-selling items, add products to your store, check orders and performance, and learn about Syncee in ChatGPT.

translation.description: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale 帮助在线销售人员为他们的在线商店找到产品. 发现来自经过验证的全球供应商的数以百万计的优质 dropshipping 和批发产品. 根据类别,图像,价格,位置,受欢迎程度或最低利润率寻找产品。 探索最畅销的项目,将产品添加到您的商店,检查订单和性能,并了解 ChatGPT 中的 Syncee。

plugin_asdk_app_69c5b2ccfe248191a3d511fe.name: Zendrop
plugin_asdk_app_69c5b2ccfe248191a3d511fe.description: Zendrop helps ecommerce merchants manage dropshipping operations from ChatGPT. Users can search the Zendrop catalog, add and import products to connected stores, inspect store, order, billing, and performance data, update fulfillment and tracking settings, preview fulfillment costs, and confirm guarded order fulfillment, cancellation, address, and product-linking workflows.

translation.summary: 管理 Dropshipping 操作系统
translation.description: Zendrop 帮助电子商务商家从 ChatGPT 管理降货操作,用户可以搜索 Zendrop 目录,将产品添加到连接的商店中,检查仓库、订单、发票和性能数据,更新履行和跟踪设置,预览履行成本,并确认受保护的订单履行、取消、地址和产品链接工作流程。

plugin_asdk_app_69dd1d0f73b48191ac4fadf2.name: Seismic
plugin_asdk_app_69dd1d0f73b48191ac4fadf2.legacyDescriptionSource:
The Seismic MCP Connector for ChatGPT enables secure integration between ChatGPT and Seismic, allowing ChatGPT to generate accurate, Seismic-specific responses using approved sales and enablement content.

Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the connector provides authentication and scope-based access control, ensuring only authorized tools and content are available within ChatGPT.
To configure access, users must install the MCP Connector for ChatGPT app from Seismic Exchange, where tenant admins define scopes and permissions that control which Seismic capabilities are exposed.

Once configured:

ChatGPT connects to Seismic through the MCP server

Only approved tools and content are accessible

Responses are grounded in trusted, compliant materials

Without proper installation and scope configuration, Seismic tools will not be visible in ChatGPT.

plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.name: iubenda
plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.legacyDescriptionSource:
Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language. Run cookie scans to detect trackers, then update your policies to match as your site changes.
Built for founders, agencies, and developers who need to meet GDPR, ePrivacy, US state privacy laws, and privacy requirements across markets, without the manual overhead.

plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.name: Ashby
plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.summary: Analyze and act on hiring data
plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.legacySummaryOriginal: Analyze and act on hiring data
plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.description:
Ashby in ChatGPT gives you instant access to your pipeline, candidate profiles, open jobs, interviews, and transcripts. Ask questions, uncover hiring trends, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the chat. Ashby connects ChatGPT to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth. Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.

Try prompts like these:
“Summarize our current engineering pipeline, highlight bottlenecks, and identify at-risk candidates.”
"Consider [Candidate Name] for our open Staff Engineer role and move them to the recruiter screen stage."
“Generate a debrief summary for [Candidate Name] using interview feedback, scorecards, and recruiter notes.”
“Analyze time-to-fill trends across sales roles and summarize where delays are occurring.”

translation.summary: 分析和采取行动招聘数据
translation.description:
Ashby in ChatGPT 讓您立即存取您的管道、候選人個人資料、開放工作、面試和轉錄資料. 提出問題、發現招聘趨勢,並採取行動,通過添加筆記、移動階段或直接從聊天發送電子郵件。 Ashby 通過安全的使用者級 OAuth 將 ChatGPT 連接到您的實際招聘資料。 每個要求和行動都尊重您的現有權限,您的數據保持保護。

尝试以下提示:“总结我们当前的工程管道,突出瓶颈,并识别风险候选人”。“考虑(候选名称)为我们的开放人员工程师角色,并将其移动到招聘人员屏幕阶段”。

plugin_asdk_app_6973948b122081919e8ef74f.name: AWeber
plugin_asdk_app_6973948b122081919e8ef74f.description: The AWeber MCP connects your AI assistant to your AWeber account, letting you manage email marketing through natural language. Instead of logging into AWeber, you can ask your assistant to manage subscribers, draft emails, analyze campaigns, and more — all through simple conversational requests.

translation.description: AWeber MCP 将您的 AI 助理连接到您的 AWeber 帐户,允许您通过自然语言管理电子邮件营销,而不是登录到 AWeber,您可以要求您的助理管理订阅者,编写电子邮件,分析活动等等 - 所有这些都是通过简单的对话请求。

plugin_asdk_app_69dff98d3f78819180890780.name: Constant Contact
plugin_asdk_app_69dff98d3f78819180890780.description: Go from email idea to a polished, ready-to-send campaign with the Constant Contact app. Describe the email you want, and the Constant Contact app will generate the HTML and render a live preview. Not quite right? Give feedback in chat, make edits, and preview again until it's exactly what you want. When you're ready to send, connect or create a Constant Contact account to import your email and reach your audience.

translation.summary: 首页 > 预览 > 发送
translation.description: 从电子邮件的想法转移到通过 Constant Contact 应用程序进行精细的,准备发送的活动。 描述您想要的电子邮件,而 Constant Contact 应用程序将生成 HTML 并提供实时预览。 不是很正确吗? 在聊天中提供反馈,进行编辑,并再次预览,直到它完全是您想要的。

plugin_asdk_app_699893175c08819192759ab4.name: Best Lawyers
plugin_asdk_app_699893175c08819192759ab4.description: Search for lawyers by practice area and location. Use the Best Lawyers directory to find peer-recognized attorneys by specialty (e.g. Corporate Law, Personal Injury), city, state, and country. Optionally filter to Lawyers of the Year. Results are based on Best Lawyers’ peer-review process.

translation.description: 根据实践区域和地点搜索律师 使用最佳律师目录,以专业(例如:公司法、人身伤害)、城市、州和国家等方面寻找公认的律师。

plugin_asdk_app_6a211a11248081918af1b295.name: Teamtailor
plugin_asdk_app_6a211a11248081918af1b295.description: Teamtailor Public MCP lets authorized users search recruiting workspace data, inspect jobs, candidates, questions, organization structure and meeting records, and update job configuration, application questions, interview kits and skills from ChatGPT using the user's Teamtailor permissions.

translation.description: Teamtailor Public MCP 允许授权的用户搜索招聘工作区数据,检查工作、候选人、问题、组织结构和会议记录,并使用用户的 Teamtailor 权限更新工作配置、应用程序问题、面试套件和技能。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6a8fe3c4948191b45865bf.name: Apartments.com
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a8fe3c4948191b45865bf.description:
Search millions of rental listings on Apartments.com directly from your conversation. Tell the assistant what you're looking for — city, neighborhood, price range, bedrooms, pet policy, amenities — and get curated results with photos, pricing, and availability in seconds. 

From a single chat you can explore floor plans, check unit availability, review fees and lease policies, get neighborhood insights, estimate affordability, schedule a tour, or contact a property directly.

No forms, no tab-switching, no scrolling through pages. Just describe your ideal home and let the assistant do the searching.

translation.description:
在 Apartments.com 上搜索数以百万计的租赁清单,直接从你的对话中找到。告诉助理你正在寻找什么 - 城市,社区,价格范围,卧室,宠物政策,设施 - 并在几秒钟内获得照片,价格和可用性。

从一个聊天中,您可以探索地板计划,检查单元的可用性,审查费用和租赁政策,获得邻居的见解,估计价格,安排旅游,或直接联系房产。

没有表单,没有窗体切换,没有页面滚动,只需描述你的理想家园,让助理完成搜索。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa01081c414819196e58fc4.name: Arcads
plugin_asdk_app_6aa01081c414819196e58fc4.description: Arcads helps users create and edit advertising videos, images, speech, and music in their workspace. Users can browse brands, actors, voices, and collected competitor ads; upload reference media; generate assets with supported models; and trim, combine, caption, translate, animate, or enhance existing media. AI analysis and prompt building support creative preparation. Processing runs as saved jobs and may consume workspace credits.

translation.description: Arcads 帮助用户在工作空间中创建和编辑广告视频、图像、语音和音乐。用户可以浏览品牌、演员、声音和收集的竞争对手广告;上传参考媒体;使用支持的模型生成资产;以及剪辑、组合、标签、翻译、动画或增强现有的媒体。

plugin_asdk_app_6a28d089f0cc8191b65dff43.name: Atria
plugin_asdk_app_6a28d089f0cc8191b65dff43.description: Atria helps users research advertisers and ad-library creative, compare connected ad-account performance, and use Radar to identify creative to scale or improve. Users can organize reference ads in shared boards, maintain their own brand profiles and competitors, read or produce video transcripts, generate brand-based ad images, and save notes in Atria. Transcription, image generation, and Radar recommendations can consume workspace AI credits.

translation.description: Atria帮助用户研究广告商和广告库创意,比较连接广告帐户的性能,并使用雷达来识别创意以扩展或改进。用户可以在共享板中组织参考广告,维护自己的品牌和竞争对手,阅读或制作视频转录,生成基于品牌的广告图像,并在Atria中保存笔记。

plugin_asdk_app_69cdf9990c90819185974d87.name: LinkedIn Ads
plugin_asdk_app_69cdf9990c90819185974d87.legacyDescriptionSource:
LinkedIn Ads helps advertisers turn every marketing dollar into business growth by making ad set performance easier to understand and act on. Understand what’s working. Build confidence. Make smarter marketing decisions—right where you already plan and analyze. Connect your LinkedIn Ads account with ChatGPT to get started.
