plugin_asdk_app_696cff9a48cc8191b5c0e3c7.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

translation.description:
“宠物项目联合创始人AI”是您的市场研究助理。

它将帮助您通过来自可信市场研究服务的真实数据来验证产品想法. 没有更多的猜测或幻觉. 而不是依靠简单的LLM-只答案,您将使用CATGPT解释的原始市场数据作为清晰的见解。

您不需要之前的营销经验. 您只需要问一个问题,应用程序为您构建了一个市场研究计划。 该计划将包括从第三方服务收集数据。 您将通过使用哪些服务和在那里运行哪些查询进行指导。 使用推荐的服务后,您将其数据复制并粘贴回应用程序,并从ChatGPT获得明确的解释。

您可以得到答案的疑问示例: - “我对应用程序X有一个想法.是否有足够的需求来证明构建它?” - “人们在寻找什么,当他们想要Y?” - “我对应用程序Z的目标用户是谁?他们使用的平台是什么?” - “我建立了一个应用程序W。

目前,支持以下服务: - SparkToro - 观众情报(你的用户是谁,他们读了什么,他们跟随谁) - Ubersuggest - 关键字需求和SEO指标 - AnswerThePublic - 真实的搜索问题和语法

免责声明: - 此应用程序不会自动收集推荐的市场研究服务的数据。 该应用程序有助于构建这些服务的搜索查询并报告结果的数据。 但是您将需要自己访问和使用这些服务。 我们不会自动从这些服务中收集数据。 - 此应用程序不提供推荐的市场研究服务的付费订阅。 您根据他们的使用条款使用这些服务。 - 此应用程序目前支持有限的服务集: SparkToro, Ubersuggest和 AnswerThePublic. 只有这些服务可以在市场研究期间被推荐。 请记住,在互联网上有其他良好的市场研究服务,我们只是没有支持它们。 您可以通过电子邮件(电子邮件:developer@propetcounderfounder.ai)添加新服务 - 为了获得最佳体验,建议您在桌面上

plugin_asdk_app_6a288e8ae66881919a04a607.description:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

translation.description:
Postbeam 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 LinkedIn 内容工作流,这样您就可以在不离开聊天的情况下编写、审查、安排和分析帖子。

一旦连接到你的Postbeam帐户,ChatGPT会直接与你的真实帖子,你的写作指导和你的业绩数据一起工作. 将聊天框变成你实际运行你的LinkedIn存在和策略的地方。

草案在你的声音,从你的真实工作:请 ChatGPT 写一个帖子,它吸引你的 Postbeam 内容培训,你的使命,观众,格式规则和内容来源,所以每个草案听起来像你,而不是通用。

编辑,组织和管理你的队列:审查你最新的草案,提取任何单个帖子,并编辑其副本或标题 - 所有通过聊天。你可以添加媒体:图像,视频或卡鲁塞尔帖子。

当你准备好时批准和安排:当草案准备好时,ChatGPT可以批准它并计划在特定时间发布到你连接的LinkedIn。

了解什么工作: 询问什么工作,并从您的缓存分析中获得答案:帐户级总数(印象,反应,评论,重新分享,追随者获得,会员达到)与每日趋势,加上30天,90天或365天窗口的每条邮件中断。

ChatGPT 可以列出您可以访问的每个帐户,以便机构和团队能够在客户或团队成员之间切换,并保持每个人的草案,批准和分析清晰分开。

plugin_asdk_app_6952abb0d70881919c298489.description:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
- Get instant responses from our network of tens of thousands of Digital Twins - AI representations of real people, each owned, trained, and validated by the person they represent

What you can use OriginalVoices for
- OriginalVoices brings real human intelligence into ChatGPT - turning every conversation into an opportunity to understand and act on authentic audience perspectives.
- Test messaging, copy, or creative concepts with your target audience
- Understand what people care about and why it matters to them
- Get feedback on landing pages, product ideas, or campaign strategies
- Create content and ads that resonates with specific audiences
- Compare perspectives across different demographics or segments
- Conduct qualitative research without the wait

How it works
- Tag OriginalVoices in ChatGPT
- Describe your target audience (e.g., "parents of toddlers in the UK," "Gen Z interested in sustainability," "small business owners")
- Share what you want feedback on - a question, a URL, an idea, copy you've written - anything
- OriginalVoices identifies relevant Digital Twins and gathers their responses. Individual perspectives are returned directly in ChatGPT, giving you real human context to inform decisions and shape outputs.
- Get started with the OriginalVoices ChatGPT App today - and bring real human insight into your AI workflows.

translation.summary: 获得任何主题的人类洞察力
translation.description:
人类智力层为AI。

OriginalVoices 讓 ChatGPT 即時獲取真正的人類觀點 - 因此,您可以根據目標受眾的想法,感受和價值觀進行決策和 AI 輸出。

不要猜测或依靠假设,而是直接从ChatGPT中获得真实的人的真实反馈,分享想法,测试消息,验证概念,或探索对任何受众来说重要的是什么 - 并使用这些见解来了解你的受众,通知更好的决定,并创建更有针对性的AI输出。

借助OriginalVoices,您可以: - 定义任何目标受众 - 分享任何东西 - 问题,链接,副本,产品概念,竞选想法 - 从我们数万名数字双胞胎的网络中获得即时响应 - 真正的人的AI代表,每个人都由他们代表的人拥有,训练和验证

您可以用 OriginalVoices 来做什么 - OriginalVoices 将真正的人类智能带入 ChatGPT - 将每个对话变成理解和采取真实观点的机会 - 测试与目标观众的消息,复制或创意概念 - 了解人们关心什么以及为什么对他们重要 - 获得定位页面,产品想法或竞选策略的反馈 - 创建与特定观众共鸣的内容和广告 - 比较不同人口群体或细分的观点 - 无需等待进行定性研究

它是如何工作的 - 标签 OriginalVoices在ChatGPT - 描述你的目标受众(例如,“英国小孩的父母,”“Z代感兴趣的可持续性,”“小企业主”) - 分享你想要的反馈 - 一个问题,URL,一个想法,你写的副本 - 任何东西 - OriginalVoices识别相关的数字双胞胎,并收集他们的回应。

plugin_asdk_app_6994f3546cec819184a464f0.name: LegalZoom
plugin_asdk_app_6994f3546cec819184a464f0.legacyDescriptionSource:
LegalZoom provides reliable legal information to help you start and run your business. Use the app to ask questions, discover relevant LegalZoom resources, and receive guided next steps for common legal tasks.

What you can do:

  1. Understand business formation basics (LLC vs. corporation, common filing steps)
  2. Get help navigating contracts (what to include, when to use which agreement)

Important: This app provides legal information and educational content—it does not provide legal advice and is not a substitute for a lawyer. If you need advice for your specific situation, consider speaking with an attorney.

plugin_asdk_app_695ba18f3294819196bbe3bd.name: Brand24
plugin_asdk_app_695ba18f3294819196bbe3bd.legacyDescriptionSource:
Bring your Brand24 insights directly into ChatGPT.

The Brand24 app in ChatGPT gives you instant access to social listening insights through simple conversations. Instead of digging through dashboards, exporting reports, or manually analyzing mentions, you can ask ChatGPT questions about your brand, competitors or campaigns and get answers based on your Brand24 data.
Whether you're a marketer, PR specialist, agency, or analyst, Brand24 app helps you turn online conversations into actionable insights in seconds.
What can you ask ChatGPT?
"What's the current sentiment around my brand?" - Instantly understand how people feel about your brand and identify the topics driving positive or negative conversations.
"Summarize my project from the last 30 days." - Get a concise overview of key trends, spikes in mentions, sentiment changes, and the most important discussions.
"Compare my brand with competitors." - Analyze share of voice, sentiment, reach, and discussion volume across multiple brands without building reports manually.
"What caused this spike in mentions?" - Quickly identify the events behind sudden increases in visibility.
Brand24 app makes ChatGPT more than just an AI assistant - it becomes a powerful source of real-time brand, market, and competitor intelligence powered by your Brand24 projects.

plugin_asdk_app_6a27216254c88191b7b96690.name: Lattice
plugin_asdk_app_6a27216254c88191b7b96690.description:
Performance management doesn't happen just in performance management software. It happens every day in 1:1s, in Slack, in the doc you're drafting at 9pm, and increasingly in the AI assistant you open before your email. Lattice MCP connects every signal you've already collected (reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and weekly updates) into ChatGPT, so the agent you already use can finally see your team the way you do.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your actual people data. Draft an accurate review in 90 seconds. Submit it without leaving the conversation. Outline the calibration story before justifying it in the meeting. Because Lattice MCP respects your existing Lattice permissions, every answer is scoped to exactly what you'd see in-product.

For AI-native organizations with adoption initiatives already in motion and other MCP connectors running in their stack, Lattice MCP is the missing piece. Bring your reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and updates into the same chat your managers are already prompting in. Draft from the full picture. Submit the result back to Lattice without ever leaving the conversation. That's the round-trip no other best-in-class Performance Management tool completes today.

translation.description:
性能管理不仅仅发生在性能管理软件中,它每天发生在1:1秒钟内,在Slack中,在你晚上9点编写的文档中,以及在你在电子邮件之前打开的AI助手中,越来越多。

问一个问题,得到一个基于你实际的人数据的答案。在90秒内设计一个准确的评论。 提交它而不离开对话。 在在会议上证明它之前概述校准故事。

对于 AI 原生组织,其采用倡议已经在进行中,以及其他 MCP 连接器在其堆栈中运行,Lattice MCP 是缺少的部分。将您的评论、1:1s、反馈、目标和更新带到同一个聊天中,您的管理人员已经提出了建议。

Search for companies and people that match your ideal customer profile, then verify emails and phone numbers, find LinkedIn profiles, and organize the results into lists. Draft and launch multi-step email and LinkedIn sequences, review replies from your inbox, and check campaign and conversation analytics.

Enginy connects to your existing workspace, so you can work with the contacts, companies, lists, and campaigns your team already has, and keep everything in sync with your CRM. An Enginy account is required.

translation.description:
Enginy 帮助 B2B 销售和展望团队构建领先名单,丰富联系人,并从 ChatGPT 运行宣传活动。

尋找符合您的理想客戶資料的公司和人,然後驗證電子郵件和電話號碼,尋找LinkedIn資料,並將結果組織成列表。

Engine 连接到您的现有工作区,这样您就可以与您的团队已经拥有的联系人、公司、列表和活动一起工作,并与您的 CRM 保持同步。

plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.name: SurveySparrow: Forms & Surveys
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.summary: Build and run forms or surveys
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.legacySummaryOriginal: Build and run forms or surveys
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.description:
Create surveys and forms, distribute them to respondents, and analyze the results — all within a single ChatGPT conversation using the SurveySparrow app.

What you can do:
- Design surveys and forms for any use-case (NPS, feedback, employee engagement, and more)
- Publish surveys to your SurveySparrow account and distribute them via email, SMS, or WhatsApp
- Review live response counts and track survey activity across your account
- Analyze responses and surface patterns or key themes from collected data

Example prompts:

1. Build a survey
"Create an NPS survey for customers who purchased in the last 30 days with a rating scale and an open-ended follow-up question"

2. Edit a survey
"Add a required email field and make question 5 more concise"

3. Publish a survey
"Publish this survey to my SurveySparrow account so it's ready to collect responses"

4. Share a survey
"Send this NPS survey to my customer list via email"

5. Check response activity
"How many people have completed the customer feedback form?"

6. Track your survey library
"How many NPS surveys are active right now?"

7. Analyze responses
"Group the responses by common themes and show me the top 3 insights"

Requirements: An active SurveySparrow account is required to use this app.

translation.summary: 构建和运行表单或调查
translation.description:
创建调查和表格,将其分发给受访者,并分析结果 - 使用 SurveySparrow 应用程序进行单一的 ChatGPT 对话。

您可以做些什么: - 设计用于任何用例的调查和表单(NPS、反馈、员工参与等) - 将调查发布到您的SurveySparrow帐户并通过电子邮件、SMS或WhatsApp分发 - 查看现场响应计数和跟踪整个帐户的调查活动 - 分析来自收集的数据的响应和表面模式或关键主题

快速的例子:

1. 构建调查“为在过去 30 天内购买的客户创建 NPS 调查,使用评级尺度和开放式后续问题”

2. 编辑调查“添加必要的电子邮件字段,让问题5更简洁”

3、发布调查“将此调查发布到我的SurveySparrow帐户,以便准备收集回复”

分享一份调查“通过电子邮件将此NPS调查发送到我的客户列表”

检查响应活动“有多少人填写了客户反馈表?”

跟踪您的调查库“目前有多少NPS调查活动?”

分析答案“按常见主题组合答案,给我看三大见解”

要求:需要一个活跃的 SurveySparrow 帐户才能使用此应用程序。

plugin_asdk_app_69aa1c0bff9c8191a188ab4d.name: LicitaLAB
plugin_asdk_app_69aa1c0bff9c8191a188ab4d.description:
LicitaLAB permite encontrar, analizar y entender compras públicas de forma rápida y estructurada.
La plataforma extrae información clave desde documentos de licitación, incluyendo requisitos técnicos, plazos, montos y criterios de evaluación, facilitando la comprensión de cada oportunidad sin necesidad de revisar archivos extensos.
Los usuarios pueden explorar oportunidades, revisar documentos asociados y tomar decisiones informadas en menos tiempo. Además, pueden hacer preguntas en lenguaje natural sobre oportunidades específicas, proveedores, compradores y sobre el uso de la plataforma.
LicitaLAB está diseñada para profesionales y organizaciones que participan en compras públicas y necesitan evaluar múltiples procesos de manera eficiente, reduciendo el tiempo de análisis y mejorando la calidad de sus ofertas.

translation.description: LicitaLAB允许快速和结构化地查找、分析和理解公共购物。平台从招标文件中提取关键信息,包括技术要求、期限、费用和评估标准,以便在不需要审查广泛的档案的情况下理解每个机会。用户可以探索机会,审查相关文件并在更短的时间内做出知情的决定。

plugin_asdk_app_699f0262e45c8191ba7faa3e.description: Faire helps retailers and boutique owners discover wholesale products for their stores. plugin_asdk_app_69f1473ac6f08191ad6e06a4.name: Arcade

plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.name: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence
plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.description: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.

Sales reps looking for fast answers about target accounts in real time
Marketing teams enriching leads and refining personas
RevOps and Enablement teams embedding GTM intelligence into workflows
AI product teams building agent-powered workflows

Availability

This integration is available to Demandbase customers with the appropriate Demandbase licenses and entitlements.

To request access, please contact your Demandbase Customer Success Manager (CSM).

For technical support, contact support@demandbase.com.

plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.description:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane account at adplane.ai.

plugin_asdk_app_6a605cbc508481918272ea7e.name: Review Buddy- draft AI replies
plugin_asdk_app_6a605cbc508481918272ea7e.description:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more people to visit, call, or buy.

The app is easy to use. Paste a review, choose the style you want, and generate a reply in seconds. There is no need to search for templates or wonder what to say. The app helps you find the right words quickly.

Use it for positive reviews, negative reviews, five-star reviews, one-star reviews, first-time customers, regular customers, complaints, compliments, questions, and everything in between. Every review is different, and every reply should feel personal.

Keep your brand voice consistent. Whether your business is fun, formal, warm, or simple, you can create replies that match your style. This helps customers recognize your business and builds a stronger connection over time.

The app also helps reduce stress. Many business owners worry about saying the wrong thing, especially when responding to unhappy customers. Instead of starting from scratch, you get a thoughtful draft that you can review and adjust before posting.

Fast replies can make a big difference. Customers like knowing they have been heard. A quick response shows that your business cares about feedback and wants to improve. Even a short reply can leave a lasting impression.

Whether you receive a few reviews each month or many every day, this app helps you stay on top of them. Save time, reply with confidence, and give every customer the attention they deserve. Better conversations lead to better relationships, stronger trust, and a better reputation. Start writing smarter review replies today and spend less time typing while making every customer feel heard.

plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.name: Beamtrace
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.summary: See how AI ranks your business
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.legacySummaryOriginal: See how AI ranks your business
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.description:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to ChatGPT for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.

Scribble sends real handwritten cards. A machine holds an actual pen and writes each card and envelope in ink, then we stamp it and put it in the post anywhere in the United States. Nothing is a printed font.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7afe588ab08191833eda9f.description:
Dreambooth Studio runs self-service photobooths, the kind you find at
weddings, events and malls. This app answers questions about them in chat.

Thinking of starting one? Ask what hardware you need, which cameras and
printers work, how the plans are priced, what each print costs in paper
and ribbon, or how payments and payouts work. Answers come from the
Dreambooth documentation, and none of it needs an account.

Already running booths? Connect your account and ask how a booth did last
weekend, what you earned this month and how much of it was cash, whether a
booth is online right now, how many AI credits are left, or how much media
a booth has produced. A sentence back, instead of opening the dashboard.

Connecting your account is the only thing it changes. After that it only
reads: it cannot edit a booth, issue a refund, move money or delete
anything, and it sees only the account you sign in with. Your booths,
never another operator's.

When a figure leaves something out it says so. Cash and voucher income
never reaches the wallet ledger, so income is reported from the sessions
themselves rather than handed to you as a partial total.

Lightbringer helps technology companies manage the patent process end to end, combining an AI-native platform with qualified patent attorneys on our team. Capture innovations while working on technical solutions, find and enrich existing disclosures as your ideas develop, get automated feedback on clarity and completeness, and search and summarise innovations, patent documents and accessible meeting notes or transcripts. Attorney-led services are available through the Lightbringer team; the plugin supports the connected workflows described above.

“Register this innovation without requesting patent preparation”
“Find our adaptive-fins disclosure and add what we learned today”

plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.name: Qualisend
plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.legacyDescriptionSource:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.
It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.
On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

plugin_asdk_app_6a99ed098c7481919d72739e.name: GadgetOS
plugin_asdk_app_6a99ed098c7481919d72739e.description:
GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold this month and get the real figure. Ask what is running out and get the items below their reorder level with a suggested quantity. Ask about one IMEI and get that exact handset: in stock or sold, its cost and its price, when it arrived and when it left, and the warranty left on it. Ask what is on the repair desk and get every claim with its status, customer, device, days open and estimate. Ask whether a customer's phone is still under warranty and get the determination from the sale date — or, where no warranty period was ever recorded, that fact stated plainly instead of a guess.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: create a device, change a price, a rack location or a reorder level, receive stock or one serialized unit, log an expense, add a supplier, raise a draft purchase order, record a customer's payment against what they already owe, book a device in for repair, and move a claim along to inspecting, estimate pending, approved, repairing, ready or delivered.

It searches a shared reference catalog of phones, laptops and accessories, so adding a product inherits the right brand, category, specifications and official image rather than starting from a blank row.

Everything is scoped to the single shop the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data.

Rejecting or refunding a warranty claim needs a manager PIN, and there is no tool for it — that stays in the app on purpose.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5fd24c21a08191a71ebc80.description:
PuraFi turns a conversation into a finished expense report.

Drop receipts into chat as photos, PDFs, or plain descriptions and PuraFi keeps a running list: merchant, date, category, and amount, organized by month or trip. Describe a drive ("office to the Hartford client and back") and PuraFi figures out the actual driving distance and applies the current IRS mileage rate, including the mid-year rate changes your spreadsheet missed.

When you're ready, PuraFi puts everything into a polished PDF report, plus files your finance team can open straight in Excel or QuickBooks. It double-checks every line for the things that get reports bounced back: missing details, forgotten attendees, duplicate charges. Then it sends the report to your approver with a one-click review link. No account or app needed on their end. After you send it, PuraFi tracks where your report stands (pending, approved, or rejected) and counts how many days you've been waiting, so asking "how much am I owed?" always has a real answer.

Use it for:

• Turning receipt photos and PDFs into organized expenses
• Logging business mileage at the current IRS mileage rate
• Building expense reports as PDF, Excel, or QuickBooks-ready files
• Sending expense reports to your manager for one-click approval
• Tracking approval status and how long you've been owed

Try: "File my expenses from this trip" - "Log my drive to the client site and back" - "Make my expense report and submit it to my manager" - "How much am I owed?"

From a pocketful of receipts to a submitted, tracked expense report, without ever leaving the conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_6a48cc28fd6881918b950cd5.name: ecoExperten Energieausweis
plugin_asdk_app_6a48cc28fd6881918b950cd5.description:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

plugin_asdk_app_6a73449598d0819188d577a5.name: Sellergoo
plugin_asdk_app_6a73449598d0819188d577a5.description:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

This plugin lets you ask about those numbers in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets. Ask what last month really made after fees, which SKUs are thin on margin, what a marketplace actually deposited in your bank account, or which products run out of stock first.

READ-ONLY
This plugin can only look. It cannot place, cancel, refund, reprice or change anything — not in Sellergoo, and not in any shop or marketplace you have connected. Every tool it exposes is read-only, and the access you grant it carries no permission to write. It reads figures that already belong to you, in answer to questions you ask.

WHAT IT CAN ANSWER
• Profit — sales, units, refunds, fees, cost of goods, ad spend, overhead, gross and net profit, margin and ROI for a period, combined and per channel.
• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.
• Orders — any date range, paginated, with each order's sales and marketplace fees.
• Products — per-SKU sales, units, margin and profit for a period, ranked by sales.
• Payouts — the settlements marketplaces and payment providers actually paid out, with the amounts grouped by line type.
• Inventory — stock on hand, 30-day sell-through and days of cover per SKU, one sales channel at a time.
• Alerts — stock-outs, low stock, thin margins, lost Buy Box, price changes and negative reviews.
• Channels — which shops are connected and when each last synced.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Sellergoo account (sellergoo.com). You sign in once and approve the connection; nothing is copied or pasted by hand. The answers are only as complete as the accounts you have connected — a brand-new account returns empty figures rather than errors, and you can always ask which account is being read.

Sellergoo works with Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Stripe, plus QuickBooks for accounting and UPS and FedEx for shipping. Walmart is planned and not available yet. Money is reported in euro.

INDEPENDENT PRODUCT
Sellergoo is made by Wolfsohn Handel (Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn, Einzelunternehmen, Germany). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or certified by Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Stripe, Intuit, UPS or FedEx. Those names appear only to say which of your own accounts Sellergoo can read for you.

YOUR DATA
The figures returned are commercial: totals, fees, SKUs, stock and payouts. Order records carry no buyer names, addresses, e-mail addresses or payment details. Nothing returned here is used to train any model. You can cut the connection off at any moment in Sellergoo under Settings → API keys; it stops working immediately, with no grace period.

Documentation: https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
Privacy: https://sellergoo.com/privacy · Terms: https://sellergoo.com/terms
Support: info@wolfsohn.de

plugin_asdk_app_6a6cf7506ec88191b19e91e1.description:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.

plugin_asdk_app_6a95f81c026081918845945f.description:
Everlaw provides a secure, standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows OpenAI to connect to Everlaw and work with live matter data on behalf of an authenticated user.

Through the connector, a connected agent can understand a user’s Everlaw project structure, translate natural-language requests into Everlaw search logic, retrieve responsive documents and document text, and analyze metadata and Bates driven result sets. The connected agent can also support natural-language reporting and analysis workflows, while Everlaw remains the governed evidence layer and system of record for case materials, metadata, and work product.

Access to Deep Dive via this connector complements search and retrieval tools, as well as Everlaw’s native Deep Dive experience. It is intended to support broader, semantic, evidence-backed questions while preserving Everlaw’s permissions and the integrity of the underlying matter record.

The connector is designed to operate within the user’s existing Everlaw permission level. Every request is authenticated and authorized against the user’s Everlaw permissions, so the agent can access only the projects, documents, and data that user is already permitted to view. Deep Dive will also be available through the connector, allowing a user to query Deep Dive over eligible Everlaw project data and retrieve evidence-backed results without changing the underlying matter record.

Using the connector, an agent can:

Use Deep Dive to ask broader investigative questions and return evidence-backed results, once the Deep Dive tools are available.

Convert a natural-language request into a structured Everlaw search. 

Generate structured reports about project contents, document volumes, custodians, dates, Bates ranges, and other returned data. 

Search by document text, metadata, Bates or Control number, binder, coding, redactions, productions, processing criteria, and other supported terms. 

Identify the metadata fields, datasets, and processed uploads available in a project. 

Retrieve matching documents with Bates numbers, metadata, review links, document-text links, and extracted values. 

Summarize and analyze retrieved documents or result sets in natural language.

plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.name: GIS Cloud
plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.legacySummary: 创建地图与 GIS 分析
plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.legacyDescriptionSource:
GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries.
This app lets you work with your GIS Cloud account in plain language, no GIS expertise or clicking through menus required.

Ask ChatGPT to build and edit maps, create and style layers, add or query features, run spatial analysis, design mobile data collection forms for field teams, import datasets, and generate reports. It covers the full GIS workflow, from field capture to mapping, analysis, and reporting.

What you can do:
  * Create, update, and organize maps and layers
  * Add, edit, and query features and attribute data
  * Run spatial analysis and compute statistics on your data
  * Build and manage Mobile Data Collection forms for field teams
  * Import files and manage datasets
  * Generate reports from your geospatial data
You stay in control. GIS Cloud uses a propose-and-confirm model: changes are proposed before anything is written to your account, and destructive actions are clearly flagged. Access is scoped to your account through secure OAuth, with read-only operations separated from writes.

Works with your existing GIS Cloud account. New to GIS Cloud? Sign up free at giscloud.com.

plugin_asdk_app_6a8ebd56a408819189228d0b.name: InsightfulPipe
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ebd56a408819189228d0b.description:
InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.

Paid advertising: Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads. Analyze spend, campaign performance, conversions, and other available metrics. You can also conduct competitor research using supported public advertising libraries.

SEO and site health: Access Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for search performance, SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks. Additional tools include website crawling, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Retrieve insights from Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

Social media and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram accounts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages and profiles, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and WordPress. Supported connections can also schedule, publish, and reschedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

E-commerce and email: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp.

InsightfulPipe can combine information from normally separate platforms. For example, ask ChatGPT to compare advertising spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue across your authorized accounts.

You can also connect your own data sources, including BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, with per-connection read-only or full-access permissions. Other supported sources include Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, and Slack. Custom REST APIs can be connected using supported OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

Read and write capabilities are exposed separately. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts, while write actions require the necessary permissions and user confirmation. All tools operate within the access granted through each connection.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, data, and actions depend on the services connected by each user and the permissions they grant.

plugin_asdk_app_6a63863d58c081918f626f59.name: Homesage.ai
plugin_asdk_app_6a63863d58c081918f626f59.description:
Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

Ask about any US residential address and get property investment metrics, an automated valuation (AVM), comparable sales with after-repair value (ARV), and an AI-assessed property condition, including analysis of listing photos or your own images. The Price Flexibility Score, a Homesage.ai signature signal, predicts how negotiable a seller really is.

For investors, Homesage.ai projects fix-and-flip returns, renovation costs with room-by-room breakdowns, and both long-term and short-term rental economics such as cash flow, cap rate, NOI, and cash-on-cash return.

Screen entire markets with ZIP-level sold data and Market Outlook scores, or search the national property database with investor filters for price, condition, equity, distress signals, and more.

Additional tools cover solar potential and AI roof analysis, mortgage and lien records, pre-foreclosure status, location risk flags, and owner skip-tracing for outreach.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.

plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.name: Keenable SELECT
plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.description:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.

Web search returns abstracts, paywalls, and citations that cannot be checked. Redpine returns the relevant chunk of the document.

Provenance by default. Every result carries its publisher, title, publication date, and a resolvable identifier such as a DOI. Licensed content and open-access content are labeled separately, so the two are never confused inside an answer.

You see the price first. Any search can be previewed for free. ChatGPT/Codex sees the title, source, and a snippet of every result, plus the exact cost to unlock them, then asks before spending anything. Unlock the three results that matter instead of the 30 that came back. The same results re-fetch free for seven days. Discovery, schema inspection, previews, and balance checks are always free.

Built for questions where being wrong is expensive. Clinical decisions, systematic review, research engineering, and any analysis that has to survive a source check.

An account can also hold data integrations beyond literature. ChatGPT/Codex reads what that account is entitled to at runtime rather than assuming a fixed tool list.

Compensation flows back to the rights holders. New accounts get free queries. Credits are bought on the Redpine dashboard, and the connector never handles payment details: it shows the price and asks before anything is charged.

Requires a Redpine account. Sign-in is OAuth on first use.

Enrow looks up and verifies professional contact details for specific, named business contacts, using the Enrow account of the user.

• Find a professional email address from a full name and a company name or domain, one at a time or in bulk?

Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS and iMessage, and voice calls, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, handles its own calls and texts, and keeps a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations. plugin_asdk_app_6a844c160294819182f94c6f.name: NoPressure
plugin_asdk_app_6a844c160294819182f94c6f.description:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.

plugin_asdk_app_6a96d5e9880c8191aa2a97ec.description:
Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner's approval before it is sent.

It is built so the mailbox is left exactly as you would have left it yourself. Replies carry the threading headers, so they nest inside the conversation in the recipient's client rather than starting a new one. Reading a message does not mark it as read. Exactly one copy of anything sent is filed in Sent. Moving a message keeps its flags and its original date. Nothing you read is stored: mail, calendar and contact content passes through the server in memory and is never written down.

Destructive actions are labelled as destructive, and it refuses rather than guesses. It will not delete a folder that still holds messages, and it stops to ask before replying to an address that differs from the visible sender. The company behind it, BSolve IT Limited, holds Cyber Essentials certification.

plugin_asdk_app_6a1cfe08d3a081919ed00f61.legacyDescriptionSource:
Audit a whole reference list in one request - up to 25 entries, each checked for fabrication and retraction, returned as a per-entry verdict table. Verify whether a single citation is real - it cross-checks the claimed title and authors against the actual record at the identifier, catching the common pattern where a real DOI is paired with a fabricated or mismatched title.
Resolve a DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv ID, ISSN, or ADS bibcode into a clean, formatted citation in Vancouver, APA, AMA, IEEE, CSE, or any of 10,000+ CSL styles. Check whether a paper has been retracted, corrected, or had an expression of concern raised. Works in Codex too: ask the coding agent to verify the references in a manuscript or .bib file while it works. Results show in a citation card with the verdict, the formatted reference, and the source identifier. $0 - no account and no API key required.

plugin_asdk_app_6a282d986ad08191be4c6e6b.name: Lurna
plugin_asdk_app_6a282d986ad08191be4c6e6b.description:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

plugin_asdk_app_6a236f34c44481918d60669a.description:
SkinKnowledgeBase is a public skincare knowledge website and AI-accessible reference layer for answering skincare and skincare-product questions with source-backed context.
For people, it offers readable pages about skincare questions, ingredients, products, concerns, side effects, cited sources, and product comparisons. For AI assistants, it provides read-only MCP access to the same public knowledge structure, so answers can include canonical SkinKnowledgeBase URLs, citations where available, product facts, ingredient context, comparison caveats, and clear uncertainty when source information is limited.

It is useful for shoppers, researchers, content teams, and AI assistants that need grounded skincare context instead of vague beauty claims.

plugin_asdk_app_69986d8a54148191b61b53c4.name: Metronome: Music tempo+beat
plugin_asdk_app_69986d8a54148191b61b53c4.description:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

plugin_asdk_app_6a616525e168819184dcc838.description:
Turn what you're learning into a quiz you can actually play.

Paste a short note, add fuller notes, name a subject, share a supported public webpage, or ask ChatGPT to use relevant text it can read from an attached file. Trivana Study creates one unlisted 5-, 7-, or 10-question practice quiz with automatic scoring, an AI host, and a play link for you or your study group.

Short note seeds may be supplemented with verified, well-established subject knowledge so there is enough material for a complete round. Fuller notes and supported webpages remain grounded in the supplied source. If you ask to use only the supplied material, Study keeps that strict boundary and may ask for more material.

Answer a warm-up in ChatGPT, then open the full quiz—players need no account. Sofia hosts by default, or choose from 8 personalities in 10 supported languages. If Save & track scores appears, you can claim the quiz and keep plays, scores, and replays.

Unlisted means anyone with the link can play, but the quiz is not automatically featured publicly. For attached files, ChatGPT may send extracted or condensed text; Trivana does not receive the raw attachment. Built for lecture review, class revision, exam and certification practice, and quick checks of what actually stuck.

plugin_asdk_app_698272fdaeb88191b2668d2e.name: GovQuery
plugin_asdk_app_698272fdaeb88191b2668d2e.legacyDescriptionSource:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.

Data sources currently include:
  * Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
  * Department of Justice press releases
  * Executive orders (last six presidents)
  * Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.

New data sources are added regularly.

You can register for a free account at: 【7†https://www.programintegrity.org†www.programintegrity.org】 (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (【8†https://www.programintegrity.org/faq†www.programintegrity.org】).

The result is a more continuous workflow from discovery to draft, with less friction and fewer wasted cycles.

Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed profiles and seabed acoustic parameters.

Every location accepts a place name ("outside Halifax", "Strait of Hormuz") as well as coordinates. Every simulation result carries a replication bundle (sound-speed profile, bottom parameters, bathymetry transect, grid) and a run id whose files are downloadable, plus a link that opens the run visualized in the Clairwave web platform with no sign-in.

Typical uses: sonar and hydrophone planning, marine-mammal noise exposure screening, aquaculture noise monitoring, teaching ocean acoustics, checking a ship's audibility at a receiver, and exploring how season and seabed change propagation. No account is required. Compute calls share a platform-wide budget of about 20 per minute. Results are climatology-based and are not a substitute for in-situ measurements.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.name: VoteMapper
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.description:
Ask about a US election — the 2026 midterms ahead, or any presidential election since 1788 — and get an answer with a date on it.

For 2026: the consensus competitiveness rating for any of the 100 Senate seats and 435 House districts, a consensus of Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball, along with which races are genuinely in play and what forecasters have changed their minds about since the last update.

The part a chat assistant cannot do on its own is the arithmetic. Describe a scenario in plain language — "Republicans hold every toss-up but lose Maine" — and VoteMapper resolves it against the ratings in effect and returns a full chamber map you can argue with. Click any race to reassign it and the tally follows. The Senate has 65 seats that are not on the 2026 ballot and are already counted; getting that right is the difference between a real answer and a confident wrong one.

For history: every presidential election from 1788 to 2024, as a map rather than a paragraph. Compare two elections and see which states changed hands, trace one state's whole voting history and current streak, or reassign states to ask what a different outcome would have meant. Multi-way elections like 1860 and 1912 come back whole rather than flattened into two parties.

You can also check a sealed VoteMapper forecast. A prediction declared in the app is verified here by fingerprint and scored against published race calls once results land — over called races only, so an uncalled race is never counted as a miss.

VoteMapper is a simulator. It reports no live vote counts, returns or called races, and its historical data holds electoral votes, not popular-vote totals. Every answer carries the date its data was published, both parties are treated symmetrically throughout, and the connector takes no position on any race.

Read-only and stateless: no account, no sign-in, nothing written, nothing retained between requests.

Existing Anki decks import whole (.apkg with cloze, hints, images, audio, LaTeX, typed answers, and nested decks), and everything exports back to Anki or CSV at any time.

What ChatGPT can do once connected: list your decks and due counts, create decks and cards, start and run a study session, reveal answers, submit grades, edit or delete cards, and adjust daily new-card limits.

A free Flash account is all you need. Flash has no ads, no tracking, and no third-party analytics.

plugin_asdk_app_6a8399a0bccc819185d57048.name: Pendar
plugin_asdk_app_6a8399a0bccc819185d57048.description:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa7ad131c4c81918373561a.name: PartnerProf - Quanntum Core
plugin_asdk_app_6aa7ad131c4c81918373561a.description:
PartnerProf is a unique tool that provides a deterministic answer to a fundamental question: does at least one feasible state exist within a locally defined reality governed by highly complex dependencies and constraints in a high-dimensional space?

Before committing resources to complex computation or a quantum problem, PartnerProf can determine whether a desired state, result, transition, or next step is feasible at all under the currently defined conditions.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.

Built for privacy and legal teams confirming compliance, marketers checking client sites, and developers managing cookie banners. The connector covers consent management, cookie scans, and compliance checks in plain conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_6a80320b4aec8191ba59af3c.description:
Decionis is an execution-authority layer for AI agents. Before an agent takes a consequential action, Decionis evaluates the proposed action against organization policy and determines whether it may proceed, must be held, or requires additional authority.

When human approval is required, Decionis can request verified approval through Presence and re-evaluate the action using the resulting signed evidence. Every evaluation produces a verifiable Decision Dossier and cryptographic evidence for audit and accountability.

Use Decionis to govern agent-initiated payments, refunds, commerce operations, enterprise workflows, infrastructure changes, and other high-impact actions.

Decionis authorizes execution; it does not perform the downstream action. Payments, transfers, trades, orders, and system changes remain the responsibility of the connected executor.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6fc95ba1f0819190aa1d20.description:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.

Supported countries and assets are governed by your KYC outcome and MoonPay's licensing in your jurisdiction.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6163dea5748191a30a6472.description:
Trusted private market intelligence, right inside your conversation.

Crunchbase MCP brings private market data and predictive signals into the AI tools and agents you already use. Built for investors, go-to-market teams, product builders, and anyone else who needs answers, not just search results.

Ask in plain English. No code, no technical training. The MCP figures out the filters, fields, and connections you might not have known to ask for, and returns a complete, sourced answer. Most other MCP servers only offer raw search and list data.

Supercharge your workflow. Identify high-growth companies, run diligence in seconds, and act on opportunities before other firms catch on, or give your customers foresight into market movements directly in your product, without the engineering lift.

Build lists you can return to. Save companies as you find them. A search today becomes a pipeline you monitor over time.

Predictions you can act on. Forecasts of what a company is likely to do next such as: funding, acquisition, IPO, growth, shutdown, or headcount cuts, plus an estimated current valuation. Every prediction carries a confidence tier, so you can rank an entire market by likelihood instead of reading profiles one at a time. Powered by 15M+ predictions refreshed weekly.

Why Crunchbase? The only dataset combining the aggregated activity of 80M users, 1,000+ public sources, and 600k+ data team members, VC partners, and subject-matter experts.

plugin_asdk_app_696f6caca330819182455857.description:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.
